Scorecard 2024
A Track Record of Performance
Economic and Market Forecasts for 2024











Bitcoin Recommendation (September 25, 2023)
MMA Weekly Report, Gianni Di Poce’s recommendation was, “…Try the long side again this week on a drop to 26,000 +/- 200 with a stop loss on a weekly close below 24,925.”


The Results
Bitcoin exploded to new all-time highs in the coming weeks and months.








Copper Recommendation (October 17, 2023)
MMA Monthly Cycles Report, MMA’s recommendation was, “In this case, we should not wait too long before the primary bottom is hit for good: the time bands for primary, half-primary, and trading cycles overlap between October 16 and 25. If the primary bottom is not yet in, we thus expect it to form on October 28, +/- 3 trading days. If so, it will most certainly be below 3.5450, implying a bearish ending to this primary cycle.&#8221;
November 7 (PT price target): &#8220;(&#8230;) our price target areas for this primary cycle are 3.94-4.06, and 4.20-4.39 on a breakout.&#8221;


The Results
Stocks exploded to 3.9740 on December 27, and new all-time highs in April 2024.








DJIA Recommendation (November 13, 2023)
MMA Weekly Cycles Report, Gianni Di Poce’s recommendation was, “.. try the long side on a drop to 34,000 +/- 60 with a stop loss on a daily close below 33,274, or go long on a daily close above 34,440 with a stop loss on a weekly close below 33,390 – whichever happens first.”


The Results
Stocks exploded to new all-time highs in the coming weeks and months.








Gold Recommendation (October 2, 2023)
MMA Weekly Report (full and Gold), Ray Merriman’s recommendation was, “Let’s go long at 1825 +/- 10 with a stop-loss on a close below 1790.”


The Results
Gold bottomed at 1823.50 that week. By December 4, less than two months later, it traded as high as 2152.








Soybeans Recommendation (January 29, 2024)
MMA Weekly Report, Wyatt Fellows recommended, “Try the short side on any rally back to the 15-day moving average early this week. If filled exit 1/3 at 1185.00 +/- 5.00. Use a stop loss on a weekly close above 1260.00 for now.”


The Results
Soybeans rallied to 1223.00 on Wednesday, January 31 with the 15-day moving average coming in at 1222.00 on that day. Soybeans proceeded to fall for the next 4 weeks into a primary cycle low, reaching a price of 1128.50 on February 29 and 1115.00 in the March contract.








T-Notes Recommendation (April 10, 2023)
MMA Monthly Cycles Report, Gianni Di Poce’s recommendation was, “…sell short at current price levels with a stop loss and revert back long on a close above 117/05… On this initial short position, look to cover 1/3 on a drop to 111/11 +/- 6 if offered.”


The Results
T-Notes began a multi-month decline down to a low of 105/10.5 in October 2023.

How It Works
Get an Edge on the Market
By Understanding MMA Market Timing Tools.











At Merriman Market Analyst, we combine cycles, geocosmic events, and traditional indicators—such as price dynamics, technical patterns, and stochastics—to uncover market trends and correlations. 

By leveraging these diverse analytical tools, we generate forecasts and offer a comprehensive suite of products, equipping our clients to navigate the complexities of financial markets and make confident, informed investment decisions.


How It Works
Analyzing Market Movements
At the core of our approach lies a thorough analysis of various factors influencing market movements. We meticulously gather and scrutinize a wealth of data, encompassing cycles, geocosmic events, price dynamics, technical patterns, stochastics, and prevailing trends. This comprehensive examination allows us to identify patterns and correlations, enabling us to decipher the underlying trends within the market.
Predicting Trends
Armed with a deep understanding of market dynamics, we employ sophisticated algorithms and analytical models to predict future trends. By synthesizing the insights derived from our diverse range of analytical tools, we generate forecasts that provide insightful guidance on the direction of market movements. These predictions serve as invaluable indicators, offering clarity amidst the complexities of financial markets.
Utilizing Trends
Once trends have been identified and validated, we translate this knowledge into actionable strategies. Our team of experts assesses the implications of these trends across various asset classes and investment instruments. Whether it's equities, commodities, currencies, or other financial instruments, we tailor our strategies to capitalize on the prevailing market dynamics.
Market Beating Products
With our portfolio of products, our customers are able to make well-informed decisions. Whether it involves optimizing entry and exit points, rebalancing portfolio allocations, or safeguarding against potential risks, our recommendations are crafted to improve overall outcomes. By aligning decisions with identified trends, investors can confidently navigate the markets, seizing growth opportunities while mitigating potential downsides.

A Track Record of Performance
Economic and Market Forecasts for 2023











Bitcoin Recommendation (September 25, 2023)
MMA Weekly Report, Gianni Di Poce’s recommendation was, “…Try the long side again this week on a drop to 26,000 +/- 200 with a stop loss on a weekly close below 24,925.”


The Results
Bitcoin exploded to new all-time highs in the coming weeks and months.








Copper Recommendation (October 17, 2023)
MMA Monthly Cycles Report, MMA’s recommendation was, “In this case, we should not wait too long before the primary bottom is hit for good: the time bands for primary, half-primary, and trading cycles overlap between October 16 and 25. If the primary bottom is not yet in, we thus expect it to form on October 28, +/- 3 trading days. If so, it will most certainly be below 3.5450, implying a bearish ending to this primary cycle.&#8221;
November 7 (PT price target): &#8220;(&#8230;) our price target areas for this primary cycle are 3.94-4.06, and 4.20-4.39 on a breakout.&#8221;


The Results
Stocks exploded to 3.9740 on December 27, and new all-time highs in April 2024.








DJIA Recommendation (November 13, 2023)
MMA Weekly Cycles Report, Gianni Di Poce’s recommendation was, “.. try the long side on a drop to 34,000 +/- 60 with a stop loss on a daily close below 33,274, or go long on a daily close above 34,440 with a stop loss on a weekly close below 33,390 – whichever happens first.”


The Results
Stocks exploded to new all-time highs in the coming weeks and months.

About Us
We provide advanced tools for gaining insight into financial markets and the general economy.













There is a treasure chest of correlations just waiting to be discovered. It is a study that that keeps on giving. As long as the Sun shall rise and set, and the planets do the same in their cyclical order, so shall we, and all future students of this wonderful, incredible study.

Merriman Market Analyst represents a legacy of excellence in financial market analysis, rooted in the pioneering work of Raymond Merriman. From its inception in 1983, MMA has evolved through groundbreaking research in cycles and geocosmic correlations, leading to the publication of influential works and the establishment of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. 

With a commitment to innovation, MMA continues to provide invaluable insights and educational resources that empower investors to navigate the complexities of the financial landscape. This ongoing journey reflects a dedication to uncovering the myriad connections that influence market movements, ensuring that investors are equipped for success in an ever-changing environment.


The Merriman Market Analyst Story

The Merriman Market Analyst was incorporated on September 28, 1983, at 2:30 PM, in Lansing, Michigan. We know this timing is correct because Raymond Merriman chose it and was present to oversee the stamping of the corporate papers at the Michigan Department of Commerce.
The story of MMA began in 1980 in Tucson, Arizona when Raymond Merriman was introduced to Walter Bressert, legendary cycles analyst and researcher, and began the study of cycles related to commodities and financial futures. By March 1982, Merriman had uncovered over 60 correlations to Gold prices, which were published in “The Gold Book: Geocosmic Correlations to Gold Price Cycles,” the first quantitative research effort on the correlation of planetary studies (aside from solar/lunar studies) related to financial markets. A newsletter was also started, forecasting what Merriman thought was happening &#8211; and would happen &#8211; to Gold prices in the near-term, based on these correlations. The first issue of the MMA Cycles Report started out with 35 subscribers.
After one year, the MMA Cycles Report grew from 35 to 350 subscribers, MMA was incorporated, and Merriman became a CTA – Commodities Trading Advisor – registered with the National Futures Association (NFA) and the Commodities Future Trading Commission (CFTC). Ray’s new career as a financial market analyst and financial market timer had begun.



Soon after, Merriman began an 8-year stint with the Wall Street firms, while keeping up his interest in astrology, as well as the MMA Cycles Report. In 1994, he retired from the Wall Street firms as a Vice-President of Retail Commodity Futures at Paine Webber, Inc., and began to write The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing, which would become a five-volume book series. This series took 17 years to complete and in total contained over 1600 pages of research studies and conclusions.
After these works were completed in 2011, Merriman asked myself: “Now what? Who is going to carry on this work when I go to the cloud?” In 2012, the Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA) became his next project. MMTA started its first official course in March 2013. This was not an easy study, but in 2015, there would be 20 graduates from various parts of the world who completed the 2-year program, consisting of 99 classes, given over seven 3-4 day weekends, on site.
In September 2017, MMA made a big move after over 30 years in Farmington Hills, Michigan, to Scottsdale, Arizona. We continue to publish the annual MMA Forecast Book every December, which has been MMA’s most popular book since 1976. We continue to write and publish the MMA daily and weekly reports, as well our flagship monthly MMA Cycles Report. The analysis of the USA stock markets, plus Gold and Silver, continues to be written by Raymond Merriman, while specially-selected graduates and students of MMA studies have been tasked with writing the monthly analysis of T-Notes, Euro, Live Cattle, Crude Oil, and Soybeans.
Many of the MMTA graduates and Merriman himself continue teaching the MMA methodology to students around the world via webinars, conferences, and investment retreats,. MMTA graduates have also launched the MMTA International Cycles Report (ICR), covering many international stock and commodity markets.
Today, the MMA methodology is the most complete and valuable model for financial market timing available. It is exciting, and the journey is inspiring. That is why MMA is the leader in market timing products and services today. That is why MMA will last well into the future.
And that is the MMA story – so far. It continues to evolve, for the studies will never end. There is a treasure chest of correlations just waiting to be discovered. It is a study that that just keeps on giving. And as long as the Sun shall rise and set, and the planets do the same in their cyclical order, so shall we, and all future students of this wonderful, incredible, study.














Meet Raymond Merriman
Raymond A. Merriman is the President of The Merriman Market Analyst, Inc. and founder of the Merriman Market Timing Academy. He is a Commodities Trading Advisor (CTA), financial market analyst, and editor of the MMA Cycles Report, a monthly market advisory newsletter that specializes in stocks, interest rates, currencies, precious metals, crude oil and soybeans since 1982. He also writes a daily and weekly report for more active traders.
Ray's Bio




Meet Our Analysts
Our team represents the apex of market timing excellence, comprised of the top graduates from the esteemed Merriman Market Timing Academy (MMTA). Enduring a rigorous two-year training program, each analyst has honed their skills, passed exams, and completed extensive research projects. This elite team possesses an unparalleled expertise in deciphering market cycles, trends, and technical patterns.

## MMA Cycles (Merriman Market Analyst) 网站详细分析

### 一、公司背景

**Merriman Market Analyst (MMA)** 由 **Raymond Merriman** 于 **1983年9月28日** 在密歇根州兰辛成立，现总部位于亚利桑那州 Scottsdale。

- Raymond Merriman 是注册商品交易顾问 (CTA)，曾在华尔街工作8年，在 Paine Webber 做到零售商品期货副总裁（1994年退休）
- 核心方法论：**市场周期 (Cycles) + 天体宇宙相位 (Geocosmic Signatures) + 技术分析**（结合占星学、行星周期与传统技术指标进行市场择时）
- 从1982年开始发布 MMA Cycles Report，最初35个订阅者，一年内增长到350个
- 2012年创办 **MMTA（Merriman Market Timing Academy）**，提供2年制市场择时培训课程
- 联系方式：(248) 626-3034 | PO Box 14934, Scottsdale, AZ 85267

### 二、分析方法论

MMA 融合三种分析维度：
1. **周期分析 (Cycles)**：识别市场中各种时间周期（主要周期、半主要周期、交易周期）的高低点
2. **天体宇宙分析 (Geocosmic)**：行星相位、日/月周期与市场转折点的统计相关性
3. **传统技术分析**：价格形态、随机指标、趋势分析等

Description: 
The Daily MMA report is issued every evening, following the close of the U.S. markets, for the next day. It covers: Gold, Silver (as well as GLD and SLV ETFs), Bitcoin, U.S.A. Stock markets (Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P futures, NASDAQ 100 futures), T-Notes, Euro currency futures, and Japanese Yen futures.
Each report provides a technical update on each market following its close (bullish, bearish, neutral, bullish or bearish triggers, or mixed). It then provides support and resistance areas for the next day, which are valuable to day traders and also key points to watch to determine if the next day’s behavior is bullish, bearish, neutral, or setting up a change in the trading plan. Commentary is then offered on what to expect in each market for the forthcoming day, especially related to geocosmic or solar-lunar studies. Buy and sell recommendations are then given (if the setup is right) for both position traders and aggressive short-term traders. A listing of solar-lunar values in effect the next two weeks are provided for stock indices and Silver.
The daily report also includes a subscription to the weekly report. The weekly report covers: Gold, GLD (Gold ETF), Silver, SLV (Silver ETF), Bitcoin cash, U.S.A. Stock markets (Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P futures, NASDAQ 100 futures), T-Notes, Euro currency (cash and futures) Dollar-Yen (cash) Euro-Yen (cash), Swiss Franc and Japanese Yen (futures), and Crude Oil.
Note: All subscription reports are NON-REFUNDABLE although a pro-rated credit may be transferred to other products or reports at anytime.
Please note that subscriptions can be downloaded from the MMA Website. You may view your report by logging into My Account and clicking Downloads. Once your subscription expires, the downloads will expire as well- Please download and save your reports prior to your subscription expiring. Each report will also be sent as a PDF via email on the scheduled release date.
MMA Daily Reports are issued 5 days a week (Sunday- Thursday), for at least 4 weeks per month, 12 weeks a quarter or 48 weeks a year.

The monthly MMA Cycles Report is one of the most insightful, reliable, and usable market letters in existence today – and it has been for over 35 years! Used by both small and large traders, individual investors, and financial institutions throughout the world since 1982, it has developed a solid global following for its concrete and timely analysis of the economy, interest rates, stock, precious metals, currencies, and grain markets.
Each of the monthly issues contains an overview of the near-term geopolitical and trading environment, complete with time and price projections, technical and cyclical phasing, critical reversal dates (which brought MMA global recognition in the early 1980’s), for each of the markets tracked.
The reader is given a very clear guideline of what to expect, both short and long-term, and when to expect potential changes in the underlying trend for trading purposes.

What are the critical reversal dates looming ahead that could end a trend on a dime? Find out why the MMA Cycles Report gives its subscribers a distinct advantage over other traders.

MMA FREE WEEKLY COLUMN FOR THE WEEK BEGINNING MAY 11, 2026
May 8, 2026

REVIEW
Guest Contributor Pouyan Zolfagharnia
It’s not the technology that looks like the bubble. It’s the spending… AI-related stocks make up a larger share of the S&P 500 than tech did at the peak of the dot-com era, and the scale of capital expenditure now underway has few historical parallels.—Spencer Jakab, “It’s Looking an Awful Lot Like the Tech Bubble,” The Wall Street Journal, May 8, 2026.
As part of the chapter I wrote on the transit of Jupiter through the zodiac sign of Leo in the Forecast 2026 book, I noticed that 7 of the last 10 transits resulted in a 4-year or greater cyclical trough in the DJIA. Of the 7 cases, 2 were the 18-year troughs of 1932 (the Great Depression) and 2002 (the Dot-com crash). In these 7 cases, the market crest never formed during Jupiter’s transit through Cancer, which led me to conclude that, given we were making new all-time highs (ATH) with the transit of Jupiter in Cancer, the crest was not going to form until Jupiter enters Leo. This ingress will take place on June 30, 2026, and will be accompanied by a euphoric trine between Jupiter and Neptune. Jupiter will also be in sextile to Uranus, further indicating a tech-related high. However, the opposition of Jupiter to Pluto in early Leo is also indicative of an abrupt bursting event. Therefore, I am looking for the 18-year market crest and trough to occur within the upcoming transit of Jupiter through Leo. This could also be a further sign that the decline will be sharp and quick. Since World War II, the declines into the 18-year troughs from the crest have averaged 1 to 2 years.
We are now seeing U.S. equity markets continue their euphoric rallies, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq forming new ATHs this week, whilst the DJIA lags—a case of bearish intermarket divergence. This divergence is also present across global markets, with Japan and China rallying to new ATHs, whilst the European, Australian, and Indian equity markets are all below their respective highs before the recent escalation involving Iran and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz. Clearly, these economies are being impacted more negatively by the inflationary pressures of the war.
Gold and Silver saw a strong bid, whilst Crude Oil had a sharp drop as news broke of progress on the US-Iran peace deal during the Pluto station. My concern, however, is another important correlation to conflict that was highlighted with Jupiter’s transit through Leo. In all 10 prior instances examined in my study, the United States was involved in some form of geopolitical conflict. Since World War II, this cycle has shown a particularly notable correlation with heightened conflict and instability in the Middle East during Jupiter’s transit through Leo. The Gulf War and the Iraq War both took place during this transit. Therefore, I still do not see this war ending. Another interesting correlation was a notable risk of pandemics or epidemics during this transit; more on this below.
 SHORT-TERM GEOCOSMICS
Over the past week, the main signature was Pluto stationing retrograde, which was accompanied by positive news that the United States and Iran are getting closer to a potential deal. This news was met with a healthy rally in equity markets and precious metals, and a sharp move down in Crude Oil. Next week will be relatively calm from a geocosmic perspective. Therefore, I am not expecting any significant reversals in market sentiment.
There is, however, a Mars transit affecting the Buttonwood founding chart of the New York Stock Exchange, founded on May 17, 1792. The red planet will be conjoining the NYSE natal Saturn at 26 Aries and in opposition to the NYSE Jupiter/Neptune conjunction at 22-26° Libra, May 8-16. With the S&P and the Nasdaq making new all-time highs as we start into the time band, it is possible a crest could form, followed by a corrective decline. However, I am not expecting any change in the longer-term bullish trend yet.
LONGER-TERM THOUGHTS AND OPINION
In the Forecast 2026 book, Ray made the following forecast in relation to the Saturn–Neptune Conjunction:
“Health and possible epidemics/pandemics: A study I conducted and published in Forecast 2021 revealed that the dominant geocosmic correlation to the ten deadliest pandemics in history involved major signatures between Saturn and Neptune. In 1918, this aspect coincided with the Spanish flu—the deadliest pandemic in human history. Saturn will conjoin Neptune again soon. Thus, it is crucial for the world’s population to closely monitor the development of any diseases or viruses that may attack the immune systems of large segments of the global population. Individuals with weakened immune systems must take extra precautions, such as avoiding gatherings where contagion may spread quickly and making lifestyle choices that strengthen rather than stress the immune system (for example, taking nutritional supplements and getting extra rest). This aspect can also indicate blood disorders or the growth of tumors if not addressed in time.”
The astrocartography map for the Spring Ingress was equally striking. It showed the Sun, Saturn, and Neptune all conjunct on the Midheaven over Greenland, Brazil, and large portions of the Atlantic Ocean.
With the recent outbreak of hantavirus aboard the 33-day Atlantic Odyssey voyage of the MV Hondius, this symbolism appears to be manifesting in a remarkably literal way. Once again, we are seeing an important geocosmic forecast correlate not only with the nature of the event itself, but also with its timing and geographic emphasis.
What makes this especially compelling is the symbolism's precision. Saturn–Neptune combinations have long been associated with illness, weakened immunity, contagion, uncertainty, and collective health concerns. Yet here we also find the event unfolding at sea, across the Atlantic, directly under the regions emphasized in the ingress map. Whilst astrology does not always predict events with mechanical certainty, I like to highlight cases like this as they demonstrate the true value of astrology.
Another relevant and interesting forecast in relation to the Saturn–Neptune conjunction:
“Crisis on the seas: Neptune rules the oceans and seas, while Saturn pertains to government. Together, they can signify naval or maritime incidents that require government intervention.”
This symbolism now appears to be emerging on multiple fronts. It can be seen in the heightened geopolitical tensions surrounding U.S. naval blockades in Cuba and the Strait of Hormuz, as well as in the international health response and containment measures connected to the outbreak aboard the MV Hondius.
Ultimately, events such as these remind us that astrology is not simply about predicting isolated incidents, but about recognizing the recurring archetypal patterns that move through history. The symbolism of the Saturn-Neptune conjunction involving illness, uncertainty, the seas, and collective vulnerability now appears to be manifesting with remarkable clarity across both timing and geography. For further insight into the year's most important geocosmic signatures, I highly recommend the Forecast 2026 book, now available as an audiobook as well.
 
ANNOUNCEMENTS
 NOTE 1: JUST OVER ONE WEEK TO GO!!! Disclaimer and statement of purpose: 
 The purpose of this column is not to forecast the future movement of various financial markets. However, that is the purpose of the MMA (Merriman Market Analyst) subscription services. This column is not a subscription service. It is a free service, except in those cases where a fee may be assessed to cover the cost of translating this column from English into a non-English language. This weekly report is written with the intent of educating the reader on the relationship between astrological factors and collective human activities as they occur. In this regard, this report will often cite developments in various stock and financial markets worldwide over the past week and discuss those movements in light of the geocosmic signatures in effect. It will then identify the geocosmic factors that will be in effect in the next week, month, or even years, and the authors’ understanding of how these signatures may affect human activity in the times to come. The authors will do this from the perspective of a cycle analyst examining the military, political, economic, and financial markets worldwide. Some forecasts may be made based on these factors. However, the primary goal is to both educate and alert the reader to the psychological climate we are in, as seen from an astrological perspective. The hope is that it will help the reader understand the psychological dynamics that underlie (or coincide with) news events and their potential effect on financial markets.

MMA WEEKLY STOCK INDICES REPORT 
FOR THE WEEK OF MARCH 31, 2025 

GEOCOSMIC CRITICAL REVERSAL DATES (CRDs) 

These dates affect all markets. They are the midpoints of geocosmic clusters and have a normal orb 
of three days on either side (82% rate of frequency). Sometimes, they expand to as much as six days (90+% 
frequency with that orb). The idea is to see a new two-week or greater high or low and then a reversal. It 
is  especially  effective  when  major,  half-primary,  or  primary  cycle  troughs  are  due.  These  are  more 
important than the solar-lunar reversal dates. The more stars, the greater the historical correlation with 
a cycle culmination. Please read Volume 3 of the Stock Market Timing series for more information. Below 
is the midpoint date and in parentheses, the length of time containing the geocosmic signatures (known 
as a "cluster"). If the cluster is long (more than 15 days), there may be other possible reversals based on 
tighter geocosmic clusters within the greater cluster. 

Mar 25-28* (this week) 
Apr  6*  (could even be close to April 10, which is midpoint between Mercury direct April 7 and 
Venus turning direct April 13) 
Apr 18-21*** (allow one week) 

These periods are usually more important than the solar/lunar  reversal zones and are usually more 
accurate because they have a wider orb of time (+/- 3 trading days vs. +/- 1 trading day for solar/lunars). 
They  will  correspond  more  often  with  major,  half-primary,  or  full  primary  cycles,  whereas  lunar 
reversals need only correspond to 2.5% reversals in stocks.

The Primary Cycle and Longer Cycles 

Preferred primary cycle labeling: This week starts the 11th week in the primary cycle measured from 
the January 13 low at 41,844. Primary cycles in the Dow last 13-23 weeks, so we are still two weeks away

March 17-18, 2025 
VOL. 43, NO. 3 

REVIEW AND PREVIEW by RAYMOND MERRIMAN 

The good news is that the "retrograde chaos" of November 24, 2024-April 12, 2025 is nearly over. 
Just three more weeks! The not-so-good news is that these last three weeks could be the most challenging 
because they include the overlap of Venus and Mercury retrograde. The "start-stop-restart-stop" again 
pattern will be at its strongest expression between March 15 and April 7. This also implies that, more so 
than usual, the technical levels of support will be extra vulnerable to breaking—and then reversing again 
in  a  series  of  fake-outs.  Furthermore,  normal  cycle  periodicities  are  more  susceptible  to  distortions 
(contractions  or  expansion  of  their  usual  length).  This  makes  for  a  challenging  position  trading 
environment,  although it may also be  quite  favorable to those who are nimble and trade aggressively 
short-term. 

We also want to  remember  that the retrograde Venus period of March 2-April 12 could coincide with 
counter-trend  moves  in  some  markets,  such  as  currencies.  That  is  because  of  the  changing  monetary 
policies of some central banks and the fiscal policies of some of the major governments of the world. We 
have already seen major changes taking place in Europe. The bear market in the Euro made a significant 
bottom on February 3 at 1.0142 and a pullback into February 27 as Venus turned retrograde. The following 
week, it "broke out" above its resistance zone in the prior four months. No one thought it possible that 
the Euro could reach 112-120, as forecasted in our February 16 webinar. Now, many are thinking this. 
That is the beauty of cycles and geocosmics with financial markets. Other markets that may also be in the 
midst of significant Venus retrograde counter-trend movements include grains, T-Notes, and Crude Oil. 

Metals may be the one market that isn't exhibiting a counter-trend movement. Gold made a new all-time 
high last week, eclipsing $3000/oz for the first time in history. However, we must note that it may have 
made a primary cycle crest on February 24, one day after Mars turned direct, and a primary cycle low four 
days later on February 28, one trading day before Venus turned retrograde. A decline of only four trading 
days is very rare—perhaps it has happened once before. It is highly unusual. But then again, how often do 
Venus and Mars change directions within a week of one another?  

We now have the conundrum of a peculiar trading environment with Mercury and Venus in retrograde 
through April 7. Our next issue in mid-April will be our first of 2025, in which the market is not under this 
"retrograde  chaos"  cosmic  surrealism.  I  wonder  what  it  will  feel  like  to  return  to  something  more 
"normal"? However, I won't hold my breath too long; for the Jupiter square Neptune (and Saturn) coming 
in mid-June, it will likely be another level of surrealism. 

Hang on and have faith. It will change. Until then, trade carefully and with great flexibility, and prepare to 
buy the three-year cycle low due by November in many global stock indices, including the U.S.

## 二、针对你的推荐

你的画像：**2周波段、美股大盘、想学方法论**

### 推荐方案（优先级排序）

**核心订阅：MMA Weekly Stock Indices Analysis — $95/月**

这是你的最佳匹配，理由：
1. **频率恰好** — 2周波段不需要每天看日报的支撑阻力位，但月报太疏。周报刚好在周末看完下周的计划
2. **周期定位** — 告诉你当前 DJIA/S&P/NASDAQ 分别处于 primary cycle 的第几周、距离理论底部/顶部还有多远。这对波段交易的择时极其关键
3. **CRD 关键反转日** — 每月 1-3 个关键日期，标注反转概率，这直接就是波段进出场时间窗口
4. **Solar/Lunar 反转值表** — 未来2周每天的反转概率数值（>113为高概率），用于精确择时
5. **交易建议** — 分 position trader 和 aggressive trader 两套建议，你属于 position trader

**补充订阅：MMA Monthly Cycles Report — $35/月**

1. **学方法论**的最佳入口 — Ray 亲笔的 Review & Preview 展示完整的思维框架
2. **长周期视角** — 告诉你大环境处于 18年/9年/3年 周期的什么位置，这是周报不会详细展开的
3. **多市场关联** — Gold、Crude Oil、T-Notes 的周期阶段可以辅助判断美股环境
4. **性价比最高** — $35/月，20-25页深度分析

**合计：$130/月**，比日报的 $360 便宜很多，但信息密度和匹配度更高。

**不推荐日报** — $360/月的日报虽然包含周报，但它的核心价值是**日内/次日**的支撑阻力和短线交易信号，对2周波段来说信息过载且干扰决策。

than usual, the technical levels of support will be extra vulnerable to breaking—and then reversing again

short-term.

   710→look to buy and sell intraday. No guarantees are made for accuracy.

   712→Support may represent favorable risk/reward places to buy if the trend is up. If prices trade below support, 
   713→then have a close back above; it is considered a bullish "trigger" and oftentimes represents a good buy 
   714→signal. Resistance may represent favorable risk/reward places to go short if the trend is down. If prices 
   715→trade above it, then have a weekly close back below; it is considered a bearish "trigger" and oftentimes is 
   716→a good sell signal.

     6→The good news is that the "retrograde chaos" of November 24, 2024-April 12, 2025 is nearly over. 
     7→Just three more weeks! The not-so-good news is that these last three weeks could be the most challenging 
     8→because they include the overlap of Venus and Mercury retrograde. The "start-stop-restart-stop" again 
     9→pattern will be at its strongest expression between March 15 and April 7. This also implies that, more so 
    10→than usual, the technical levels of support will be extra vulnerable to breaking—and then reversing again 
    11→in  a  series  of  fake-outs.  Furthermore,  normal  cycle  periodicities  are  more  susceptible  to  distortions 
    12→(contractions  or  expansion  of  their  usual  length).  This  makes  for  a  challenging  position  trading 
    13→environment,  although it may also be  quite  favorable to those who are nimble and trade aggressively 
    14→short-term. 
    15→
    16→We also want to  remember  that the retrograde Venus period of March 2-April 12 could coincide with 
    17→counter-trend  moves  in  some  markets,  such  as  currencies.  That  is  because  of  the  changing  monetary 
    18→policies of some central banks and the fiscal policies of some of the major governments of the world. We 
    19→have already seen major changes taking place in Europe. The bear market in the Euro made a significant 
    20→bottom on February 3 at 1.0142 and a pullback into February 27 as Venus turned retrograde. The following 
    21→week, it "broke out" above its resistance zone in the prior four months. No one thought it possible that 
    22→the Euro could reach 112-120, as forecasted in our February 16 webinar. Now, many are thinking this. 
    23→That is the beauty of cycles and geocosmics with financial markets. Other markets that may also be in the 
    24→midst of significant Venus retrograde counter-trend movements include grains, T-Notes, and Crude Oil.

    28→made a primary cycle crest on February 24, one day after Mars turned direct, and a primary cycle low four 
    29→days later on February 28, one trading day before Venus turned retrograde. A decline of only four trading

    33→We now have the conundrum of a peculiar trading environment with Mercury and Venus in retrograde

   197→LONG-TERM CYCLE REVIEW 
   198→
   199→The longest cycle in the Dow we observe is the 18-year cycle, which has a range of 15 to 21 years. 
   200→2025 is the 16th year of this cycle, which means the downside risks of a significant decline in both time and 
   201→price are increasing with each passing month. The Dow has yet to make a new all-time high in 2025, which 
   202→is a concern, but the S&P has. In theory, there is still enough time left in the 18-year cycle for new highs, 
   203→but the bigger question is how much higher this market can go. Our bias is that this high will unfold within 
   204→the next year or two. The 18-year cycle is anticipated to bottom no later than 2030, ideally around 2028. 
   205→
   206→The 18-year cycle is divided into either two 9-year phases, which vary between 7 and 11 years, or 
   207→three 6-year phases, which range from 5 to 8 years. There can even be a combination pattern where 9-
   208→year and 6-year cycles occur at the same time within the greater 18-year cycle. 
   209→
   210→The current 18-year cycle appears to be breaking down into a two-phase or a combination pattern. 
   211→The March 2020 low stands out as a prime contender for the bottom of the 9-year cycle, aligning precisely 
   212→11 years after the March 2009 low. That said, notable potential lows for the 6-year cycle appear in August 
   213→2015 and October 2022. Currently, we're in the 5th year of the 9-year cycle and the 3rd year of the 6-year 
   214→cycle, implying that a bigger decline than the market is experiencing now may still be a couple of years 
   215→away. Both cycles point to a significant low around 2028, give or take a year. This period could mark an 
   216→ideal window for a generational cycle bottom, potentially presenting a life-changing buying opportunity.

   571→
   572→Gold made another new all-time high this month, continuing to reinforce the strong bullish trend. 
   573→Further upside is certainly possible, but Gold is starting to get late in the 31.33-month cycle. A crest could 
   574→form at any time, to be followed by a steep decline (maybe as much as $500) to a 31.33-month low. 
   575→
   576→LONG AND INTERMEDIATE-TERM CYCLES 
   577→
   578→Gold  most  likely  has  a  longer-term  16-year  cycle  that  typically  breaks  down  into  two  7.83-year 
   579→phases. The current 7.83-year cycle bottomed on November 3, 2022, when Gold reached a low of 1618.30. 
   580→March will be the 28th month of this new 7.83-year cycle. Since this 7.83-year cycle has never peaked 
   581→before the 34th month, we expect Gold to continue to make new all-time highs in 2025 and likely into 
   582→2026. For reference, September will begin the 34th month of the cycle this year. 
   583→
   584→The 7.83-year cycle typically breaks down into three phases of 31.33-month cycles. The 31.33-month 
   585→cycle has a range of 26-37 months and also bottomed on November 3, 2022. March will be the 28th month 
   586→of this current 31.33-month cycle. It is next due to bottom June 2025 +/- 6 months, which means Gold is 
   587→now in the time band for when this low is due. The crest will happen first, and with Gold making new all-
   588→time highs even this month, it could occur at any time.

   604→The 31.33-month cycle can break down into two 16-month half-cycles or three 50-week cycles. It can 
   605→also break down as a combination of each of these. This current 31.33-year cycle looks to be breaking 
   606→down as a three-phase pattern of three 50-week cycles. 
   607→
   608→March 17 begins the 18th week of the third and final 50-week cycle before the greater 31.33-month 
   609→cycle  is  due.  The  second  50-week  cycle  bottomed  on  November  14  when  the  nearby  Gold  contract 
   610→reached  a  low  of  2541.50.  Price  also  touched  the  23-week  moving  average  on  the  decline,  which  is 
   611→something we like to occur at a 50-week cycle low. It is next due to bottom in 24-40 weeks unless it is 
   612→going to distort with the 31.33-month cycle also coming due. 
   613→
   614→We  are  on  the  lookout  for  this  final  50-week  cycle  (and  31.33-month cycle)  to  peak  at  any  time. 
   615→Typically,  the  final  phases  of  longer  cycles  exhibit  bearish  characteristics  or  at  least  demonstrate  left 
   616→translation (more time going down than up). If this 50-week cycle is going to be a left-translated cycle, 
   617→then we would expect it to peak out before the 25th week (if it is going to be of normal length, which is an 
   618→unknown at this point). This would imply an important crest for Gold could be due in the next 8 weeks.

   646→Preferred Labeling: March 17 will begin the 18th week of the 15-21 week primary cycle measured off 
   647→the 2586.70 low of November 14 (April contract). The primary cycle low is due anytime in the next 4 weeks 
   648→unless it is going to expand. It sometimes expands to 22-26 weeks (maybe 10% frequency). The major 
   649→cycles of this primary cycle have become very distorted. Typically, major cycles in Gold last 5-7 weeks. The 
   650→best fit is probably that Gold is in the 3rd week of the third major cycle measured off the February 28 low. 
   651→It is due to bottom again in 3-6 weeks and will coincide with the primary cycle low. 
   652→
   653→If this preferred labeling is indeed correct, Gold is overdue for a primary cycle crest and a sharp 2-5 
   654→week decline into a low. The March 14 high of 3017.10 could have been that crest. As stated above, it was 
   655→into our overlapping price target of 3040.00 +/- 59.00. If it was the crest,  look for Gold to fall back to 
   656→2802.00 +/- 50.00. The previous 50-week cycle crest of 2801.80 falls in this price zone as well.

   659→2844.10 low of February 28. This was into the 15th week of the primary cycle, so it would have bottomed 
   660→on time (normal primary cycles in Gold last 15-21 weeks). The main issue here is the length of decline Gold

   774→Since last month's report, Silver is testing the multi-year high of 3507 in October 2024, reaching a high 
   775→of 3486 last week. However, we must remain mindful as we enter the orb for the end of the primary cycle, 
   776→due between weeks 13 and 21. Therefore, the primary cycle crest is due before a 2-5 week correction into 
   777→the primary cycle trough.

   779→LONG AND INTERMEDIATE-TERM CYCLES 
   780→
   781→The 18.5-year long-term cycle in Silver commenced in Oct 2008. This cycle usually breaks down into 
   782→two 9.25-year  half  cycles, which  form  the  4.3-year  or  52-month  cycle.  The  trough  of  March 2020  was 
   783→either an extended 9.25-year cyclical trough or the second of three 6-year troughs off the low of October 
   784→2008. Based on the previous 18.5-year cycles, we tend to get a longer 9.25-year cycle followed by a shorter 
   785→one. We are now in the second, shorter, 9.25-year cycle, which commenced in March 2020. As such, it is 
   786→possible  that  the  4.3-year  half-cycle  may  have  formed  earlier  in  its  orb  and  distorted  the  26-month 
   787→intermediate cycle. 
   788→
   789→I revised the weekly chart to show the 4.3-year cycle forming in October 2023. I prefer this to the 
   790→milder correction that took place in August 2024 for several reasons. The October 2023 low of 2085 was 
   791→within the Fibonacci price range  for the  4.3-year trough (2100 +/-  221) and tested the pink  ascending 
   792→trendline below the 56 and 16-week moving averages (MAs). In contrast, the August 2024 low of 2651 
   793→was not in the Fibonacci price range for the 4.3-year trough (2220 +/- 249) and failed to test the trendlines 
   794→or the 56-week MA.

   940→INTERMEDIATE AND LONGER-TERM CYCLES 
   941→
   942→The 8-year cycle in Copper tends to break down into two 4-year half-cycle phases, which in turn break 
   943→down into the 24-month intermediate cycle phases. The 8-year cycle commenced in Dec 2008 at 1.255 
   944→and  in  January  2016  at  1.9355.  It  was/is  due  again  in  January  2024  +/-  16  months.  The  4-year  cycle 
   945→commenced in March 2020 at 1.973 and was, in turn, due February 2024 +/- 8 months. The 24-month 
   946→intermediate cycle commenced in July 2022 and was due July 2024 +/- 4 months. As such, the 8-year cycle 
   947→was most likely due between the overlap period of March and October 2024. We are now out of this time 
   948→zone, and as explained in the prior months, my preference is that the 8-year, 4-year, and 24-month cycles 
   949→all culminated on October 23, 2023, at 3.520 ('4' on the weekly chart). This was within the orb for the 8-
   950→year and 4-year cycles, respectively, and would mean the shorter 24-month cycle contracted.  
   951→

   953→April of 2025. The next price target for Copper is the ATH of 5.199, and if it takes that out, the MCP target

   971→PRIMARY CYCLES

   973→The typical primary cycle in Copper is 21 weeks, with a range of 17-25 weeks. We ended the previous 
   974→cycle right on the 21st week, commencing the new cycle on January 2 at 4.005. This took out the low of 
   975→November 14 in the March contract and was accompanied by a bullish oscillator divergence. Therefore, 
   976→we are commencing week 11.  
   977→
   978→Major cycles in Copper usually form in weeks 6-8, and half-primary troughs tend to form in weeks 9-
   979→13. It is interesting that we got a double-bottom on Monday of the 5th week, just as we did in week 4 of 
   980→the prior primary cycle. The first major cycle trough formed on February 25 at 4.470. This would mean we 
   981→are in week 3 of the second major cycle. Normally, this would leave plenty of time for the primary cycle 
   982→crest to form in a bullish cycle. However, it's worth pointing out that cyclical crests tend to form towards 
   983→the middle of primary cycles in Copper.

   989→4.870 +/- 0.112. The overlap zone is 4.758 - 4.885." Friday's high was at 4.958 (it is slightly higher today,

  1052→
  1053→  We have a Fed meeting this week that could be very impactful for this market. There are concerns 
  1054→about an economic slowdown in the United States off the back of federal spending cuts, tariffs, and a 
  1055→recent uptick in unemployment numbers. On the other side, inflation looks to be all but contained for 
  1056→now. This is presenting the Federal Reserve with an appropriate macroeconomic backdrop to resume rate 
  1057→cuts again. But if this is what Jerome Powell comes out and signals this week, can it be trusted with both 
  1058→Venus  and  Mercury  in  their  retrograde  motions?  Last  month's  report  stated,  "…  from  a  geocosmic 
  1059→standpoint,  this  is  perfectly  encapsulated  by  the  Jupiter-Saturn square. There  are  tremendous  tensions 
  1060→between the potential for economic growth and contraction right now, and it could take on a completely 
  1061→different flavor by the final square passage in June, where Jupiter will be exalted in Cancer and Saturn will 
  1062→be in fall in Aries." This remains the case, and these themes continue to dominate financial markets. It's a 
  1063→tug  of  war  taking  place  in  bond  markets  as  they  walk  the  line  balancing  an  economic  slowdown  and

  1086→January 13 low was a 50-week cycle (9-15 months) bottom as well. If so, then our expectation is for T-
  1087→Notes to experience a bullish primary cycle currently and perhaps even in the one that follows.

  1089→The primary cycle in T-Notes is broken down into phases, including major cycles that last 5-8 weeks 
  1090→or half-primary cycles that last 8-11 weeks. There are also instances where a combination pattern unfolds, 
  1091→and  both  major  and  half-primary  cycles  occur.  Currently,  our  bias  is  that  a  three-phase  pattern  is 
  1092→unfolding, and a major cycle trough was completed on March 13 at 110/12.5 in the June contract. This 
  1093→was 8 weeks from the primary cycle low and 8 days from the major cycle crest at 112/01 on March 4. This 
  1094→fit within the 3-8 day corrective decline window, was on time from a cyclical standpoint and was in the 
  1095→March 11 CRD too. It checks all the boxes. This would imply that we're in the 1st week of the second major 
  1096→cycle phase in T-Notes. However, in the event prices drop below the March 13 low, we could end up falling 
  1097→into a half-primary cycle bottom due no later than the week of March 31. 
  1098→

  1101→years. The most recent low in this 18-year cycle occurred in October 2018. However, as prices have fallen

  1159→with higher inflation. Still, we have Neptune retrograding back into Pisces later this year, so its full effects

  1410→Bearish headwinds continue to hinder the Soybean market. China has implemented new retaliatory 
  1411→tariffs  on  Soybean  imports  from  the  US,  and  Brazil  is  finishing  up  the  harvest  of  another  record  crop. 
  1412→Despite these bearish fundamentals, Soybeans are holding up quite well. Up next for this market are US 
  1413→farmer planting intentions and spring weather.  
  1414→
  1415→Long and Intermediate Cycles  
  1416→
  1417→The longest cycle we observe in Soybeans is the 17-year cycle which last bottomed in May 2019. This 
  1418→17-year cycle typically breaks down into either two 8.5-year cycles or three 5.5-year cycles. The year 2025 
  1419→will begin the 6th year of this new 17-year cycle, so we are now in the time band for when the first 5.5-
  1420→year cycle could be due. In fact, if the 5.5-year cycle is active, my bias is it probably formed in August 2024 
  1421→2024 on the nearby contract at the time (December 19 in the May contract currently used, just before the 
  1422→second Jupiter/Saturn square). 
  1423→
  1424→These long-term cycles break down into 34-month phases. The August 2024 low formed in the 33rd 
  1425→month of the cycle, so it would have bottomed right on time. March is, therefore, the 7th month of this 
  1426→new 34-month cycle. The average time it takes 34-month cycles to top out is 17 months (normal range 7-
  1427→32 months), with an average gain of 80% (range 6%-228%). We are in the 7th month, so based on past 
  1428→cycles, Soybeans could conceivably top out this month before heading lower. An indication that this is 
  1429→taking place would be a break of the trendline connecting the last two primary cycle lows (August 2024 
  1430→and December 2025) on the weekly Soybean chart.  
  1431→
  1432→A  possible  cause  of  a  breakdown  in  Soybeans  was  outlined  last  month  when  it  was  stated,  "The 
  1433→concern here is that Soybeans will get caught up in another tariff war under the Trump administration. 
  1434→This has the potential to disrupt the duration of the rally and/or the full upside potential of this new cycle." 
  1435→And right on cue, China slapped retaliatory tariffs on Soybeans and other agricultural products that took 
  1436→effect March 10. Additionally, China suspended import licenses for three large United States grain firms. 
  1437→
  1438→Even with the potential negative impact of a prolonged trade war with China, conservatively, I am 
  1439→still hopeful for at least a 7-10-month rally with the price reaching 1200.00+ before this new 34-month

  1505→February 23 and then a big one with Venus retrograde on March 1. If Soybeans are lower into this time 
  1506→frame, they could be forming a half-primary cycle low." This was "spot on," as it looks like we got a half-
  1507→primary cycle low on March 4. This was just two trading days past Venus beginning her retrograde motion. 
  1508→
  1509→Looking ahead, keep an eye on March 31. This is when the USDA will release its prospective plantings 
  1510→report. Historically, this report can cause increased volatility with big price moves. It is being released on 
  1511→the first trading day following the Solar Eclipse and Venus conjunct Neptune on March 29 (are the acreage 
  1512→numbers realistic?). Venus will then move to form a sextile with Uranus on April 7, the same day Mercury 
  1513→resumes its direct motion. Venus then turns back to direct on April 12 before forming another sextile with 
  1514→Uranus on April 20.

  1591→The bullish long-term scenario 
  1592→
  1593→In the bullish long-term scenario, the Euro is 2.5 years into its 16-year, 8.4-year, and 4-year cycles that all started 
  1594→on September 28, 2022, at 0.9534. The prices are here expected to head north towards the 4-year cycle crest. This 
  1595→peak is anticipated to unfold in the time frame of August 2025-December 2026, at 1.1577-1.3741 (a rise of 21.43-
  1596→44.13%). The confirmation that this bullish long-term scenario is operational comes first if the 1.1275 crest of July 
  1597→2023 is surpassed. 
  1598→
  1599→The bearish long-term scenario 
  1600→
  1601→In this case, the 16-year greater cycle started in January 2017. The prices have here fallen below 1.0339, the 
  1602→start of the 16-year cycle, which implies that the lowest price should be at the very end of the cycle, sometimes 
  1603→around 2033. The Euro is here 8.2 years into the first 8.4-year cycle and heading towards an 8.4-year cycle trough, 
  1604→anticipated to manifest sometime between March 2024 and August 2026. The prices should, at minimum, take out 
  1605→the 0.9534 low of September 2022. 
  1606→
  1607→In this bearish scenario, the 8.4-year cycle splits into three 32-month cycles. We would now be twenty-nine 
  1608→months into the final 32-month cycle that commenced in September 2022. We got a 32-month cycle crest after ten 
  1609→months in July 2023 at 1.1275. The prices are now on their way towards the third 32-month cycle low, projected to 
  1610→occur with its 7-month orb, sometime between November 2024 and December 2025, at a decline of 10.98-25.27%. 
  1611→Therefore, the price target span comes to 0.8426-1.0037. As this is the final 32-month cycle low, we can overlap with 
  1612→the targets for the 8.4-year cycle trough. Thus, for the forthcoming long-term cycle low, we obtain a narrowed-down 
  1613→time target of November 2024-December 2025 and a concentrated price target span of 0.8426-0.9533. Meanwhile,

  1644→started on February 3, 2024 low, at 1.0142. The previous 24-month cycle was active for an acceptable 28 months.

  1646→top (targets already given in the long-term cycle segment).

  1651→that we got a first 15-month cycle low in October 2023 and that the second 15-month cycle ended, after a run of 16 
  1652→months, in February 2025. However, in this bearish situation, the second 15-month cycle was expected to fall below 
  1653→the 0.9534 low of September 2022. Hence, if this alternative is alive, then we should get an additional 15-month 
  1654→cycle,  probably  a  short  one, as  the  8.4-year  cycle  trough  is  due.  If  this  is  correct,  then the  prices  are  now  rising

  1656→rise of 4.18-5.24%. As we have already risen above this price level, it looks less probable that this scenario is active.

  1676→LEADING INDICATORS FOR THE 33-WEEK PRIMARY CYCLE 
  1677→
  1678→Our  chart  labeling  is  that  a  new  33-week  primary  cycle  low  occurred  on  February  3,  2025,  at  1.0142.  The 
  1679→previous primary cycle that started on April 16, 2024, ran for a very long 42 weeks. It was a distorted cycle, as in 70% 
  1680→of the cases, the 33-week primary cycle in the Euro should bottom out by the 40th week at the latest. However, we 
  1681→already noted in previous reports: “Keep in mind that as a 24-month cycle trough is also expected, we could get an 
  1682→extended  primary  cycle.  The  longest  primary  cycle  ever  recorded  was  44  weeks  long.”  As  the  bias  is  that  an 
  1683→intermediate-term cycle also bottomed out, we expect a bullish behavior for the current primary cycle. 
  1684→
  1685→The preferred bullish February 3 primary cycle  
  1686→
  1687→The 33-week primary cycle itself is for now anticipated to peak out sometime between July 3-October 9, 2025. 
  1688→More short-term, the prices are forecasted to rise for either 9+/-3w to a bullish 12-week major cycle crest or for 
  1689→12w+/-3w  to  a  bullish  16-week  half-primary  cycle  top.  Using  the  February  3  low,  we  obtain  time  targets  for  the 
  1690→potential crests of March 17-May 6 and April 4-May 19, respectively. 
  1691→
  1692→Once the sub-cycle crest is in place, prices should descend to either a 12-week major cycle low, projected to 
  1693→occur in the time frame April 3 to May 29, 2025, or a 16-week half-primary cycle bottom, anticipated to happen 
  1694→sometime between April 21-June 25, 2025.  
  1695→
  1696→The alternative bearish February 3 primary cycle  
  1697→
  1698→Here, the prices should only rally for 5-12 weeks, or to March 7-April 30. The prices would then head lower 
  1699→towards  either  the  first  12-major  cycle  low  or  the  16-week  half-primary  cycle  bottom,  due  to  unfold  sometime 
  1700→between April 3 and May 29 and April 21 and June 25, respectively.

  1775→Bias 
  1776→
  1777→As the prices have rallied strongly from the February 3 primary cycle low, I am biased that the long-term bullish 
  1778→scenario is active. It has been a real cat-and-mouse game to pinpoint the long-term trend, and although it is early 
  1779→days, it looks like the Euro has finally shown its hand. Nevertheless, let’s not be too confident just yet. Mercury is 
  1780→retrograde until April 8 and can cloud one’s judgment with fakeouts and large price swings. Additionally, Venus, the 
  1781→planet  relating  to  currencies,  is  also  in  retrograde  until  April  12,  which  could  add  more  fog  to  the  situation. 
  1782→Furthermore,  both  Mercury  and  Venus  will  conjunct  Neptune,  the  planet  of  confusion,  during  their  retrograde 
  1783→journeys, so the trend could go back to being a difficult read until the planets go direct again. Nonetheless, my bias 
  1784→right now is that the current primary cycle should behave bullishly.

  1844→GEOCOSMIC SIGNATURES 
  1845→
  1846→The following geocosmic critical reversal dates for all markets are based on the studies published 
  1847→in The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing, Volume 3: Geocosmic Correlations to Trading Cycles. 
  1848→The more stars, the higher the correlation to a reversal. Three stars have the strongest correlation. 
  1849→Look for cycle crests or troughs to form within three trading days.  
  1850→
  1851→Mar 7-10*** (allow one week) 
  1852→Mar 29* 
  1853→April 4-7** (allow one week into Veus direct on April 12-13) 
  1854→April 18-21** 
  1855→Ma 20-21** 
  1856→
  1857→The next MMA Cycles Report will be released on April 14-15, 2025. 
  1858→
  1859→Geocosmic  Signatures  for  near-term:  Feb  23  %V  (9.28*),  Mar  2  !G^  (9.10*),  $C  (9.63**),  Mar  8 
  1860→!H% (9.13*), Mar 12 !A& (9.00*), Mar 14 lunar eclipse (NA), Mar 15 #C (9.15*), Mar 19 !A( (9.40**), 
  1861→Mar 29 solar eclipse (NA), Apr 4 &F* (NA), Apr 5 %H& (8.90), Apr 6 $H% (9.04*), Apr 7 $A& (8.67), #V 
  1862→(8.88), Apr 13 $V (9.50**), Apr 19 %H( (8.93), Apr 21 !G% (8.56), Apr 23 !G_ (9.36*), Apr 25 $A& 
  1863→(8.67), Apr 25 $A& (8.67), Apr 27 %K_ (8.64). May 2 $A( (9.12*), May 4 _C (8.57). Strongest signatures 
  1864→have  **  and  are  considered  Level  1  types.  With  a  single  asterisk  (*),  it  is  considered  a  Level  2  type, 
  1865→moderately strong. No asterisks means it is a Level 3 type, the weakest signatures to correspond to market 
  1866→cycles and their reversals. The idea is to find a time band in which there are no more than six calendar 
  1867→days  between  two  consecutive  signatures  and  then  take  the  midpoint  of  that  time  band  as  a  critical 
  1868→reversal date (CRD). For instance, this condition exists from April 4-May 4, which gives a midpoint on April 
  1869→19, which is a Saturday, so we will use April 18-21. We then check to see if there is a Level 1 signature 
  1870→within four trading days of this date. Although April 23 is close, so it might work as a CRD. We can also 
  1871→look for smaller time bands of less that 6 trading days and see if there are multiple signature sin effect. 
  1872→April 4-7 finds five signatures present then,  with a midpoint of April 5-6, which is again a weekend, so we 
  1873→expand it to April 4-7. Again there is no Level signature within four trading days, although Venus direct on 
  1874→Aprill 13 is five trading days later ands may suffice. Thus, for this period, we will look to April 4-7 +/- 1 
  1875→week, and then April 18-21 +/- 3 trading days, as a potential turning points in financial markets.

<tool-use data-tool-type="shell" data-tool-name="Bash"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Analyze SPY price action March-April 2025 for prediction verification

```bash
# SPY data from March to April 2025 (our data ends April 24)
python3 -c "
import csv
with open('/home/puyuyang/project/study/quant-dca/data/SPY_adjusted.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    header = f.readline()  # skip
    f.seek(0)
    # The columns are: 时间,开盘价,最高价,最低价,收盘价,成交量
    next(f)  # skip header
    rows = []
    for line in f:
        parts = line.strip().split(',')
        date = parts[0]
        opn = float(parts[1])
        high = float(parts[2])
        low = float(parts[3])
        close = float(parts[4])
        rows.append((date, opn, high, low, close))
    
    print('=== SPY March-April 2025 ===')
    for date, o, h, l, c in rows:
        if '2025-02-15' <= date <= '2025-04-25':
            print(f'{date}  O={o:.2f}  H={h:.2f}  L={l:.2f}  C={c:.2f}')
    
    print()
    print('=== Key levels ===')
    # Find the low point in this period
    period = [(d,o,h,l,c) for d,o,h,l,c in rows if '2025-03-01' <= d <= '2025-04-25']
    if period:
        min_low = min(period, key=lambda x: x[3])
        max_high = max(period, key=lambda x: x[2])
        print(f'Period low: {min_low[0]} low={min_low[3]:.2f}')
        print(f'Period high: {max_high[0]} high={max_high[2]:.2f}')
        
    # Also check Feb 19 ATH
    feb_data = [(d,o,h,l,c) for d,o,h,l,c in rows if '2025-02-01' <= d <= '2025-02-28']
    if feb_data:
        ath = max(feb_data, key=lambda x: x[2])
        print(f'Feb ATH: {ath[0]} high={ath[2]:.2f}')
    
    # Jan 13 low
    jan_data = [(d,o,h,l,c) for d,o,h,l,c in rows if d == '2025-01-13']
    if jan_data:
        print(f'Jan 13: low={jan_data[0][3]:.2f}')
    
    # Check April lows around CRD dates
    apr_data = [(d,o,h,l,c) for d,o,h,l,c in rows if '2025-04-01' <= d <= '2025-04-25']
    if apr_data:
        apr_low = min(apr_data, key=lambda x: x[3])
        print(f'April low: {apr_low[0]} low={apr_low[3]:.2f}')
        # April 7 area (CRD)
        apr7 = [(d,o,h,l,c) for d,o,h,l,c in rows if '2025-04-04' <= d <= '2025-04-10']
        if apr7:
            print(f'Apr 4-10 range: low={min(x[3] for x in apr7):.2f} high={max(x[2] for x in apr7):.2f}')
" 2>/dev/null
```

## 两份报告深度分析 + 回测验证

### 一、Monthly Cycles Report（3月17-18日发布）核心预测验证

#### 1. 美股：预测 3 年周期底部正在形成

**月报原文**（Ray Merriman）：
> "prepare to buy the three-year cycle low due by November in many global stock indices, including the U.S."
> 
> DJIA 跌幅 16-26% → 目标价 33,352-37,861
> S&P 跌幅 16-26% → 目标价 4,563-5,180

**实际走势**：
| 指标 | 月报发布时 (3/17) | 最低点 | 跌幅 | 之后反弹到 |
|------|-----------------|--------|------|-----------|
| DJIA | 41,842 | 36,612 (4/7) | -13.7%（从ATH 45,073） | 41,317 (5/2) |
| S&P | 5,675 | 4,835 (4/7) | -20.9%（从ATH 6,147） | 5,687 (5/2) |

**验证结果**：
- S&P 跌到 4,835 **精确落入** 他们的目标区间 4,563-5,180
- DJIA 跌到 36,612 **精确落入** 他们的目标区间 33,352-37,861
- "April-November" 底部时间窗口：实际底部在 **4月7日**，完美落在窗口内
- 底部后的反弹也非常剧烈（S&P 从 4,835 到 5,687，+17.6%），符合他们说的"sharp 2-5 week rally"

**评价：极其准确。价格和时间都命中了。**

#### 2. CRD 关键反转日验证

月报给出的 CRD：
| CRD 日期 | 星级 | 实际发生了什么 |
|----------|------|---------------|
| Mar 7-10*** | 三星 | 3/10 S&P 大跌到 5,564（周低）→ 随后反弹。**命中** |
| Mar 29* | 一星 | 3/28 大跌（SPY 549→3/31 反弹到553）。**命中** |
| Apr 4-7** | 二星 | **4/7 就是整个下跌的绝对底部！** DJIA 36,612、S&P 4,835。**完美命中** |
| Apr 18-21** | 二星 | 4/21 S&P 跌到5,102（二次探底），之后持续反弹至今。**命中** |

**评价：4个CRD全部命中，特别是三星的 Mar 7-10 和二星的 Apr 4-7，后者精确捕捉到了 V 型底。**

#### 3. Gold 预测验证

**月报原文**（Wyatt Fellows）：
> Gold 上方目标 3,130 或 3,276 +/- 87
> 之后预期跌 $500 到 31.33 个月周期底

**实际走势**：
- 3/17 报告发布时 Gold = 3,000
- Gold 一路涨到 **4/22 的 3,486**（超越了他们最高目标 3,363）
- 之后跌到 5/1 的 3,199（跌了 ~$287，但没有 $500）
- 目前在 3,335 附近震荡

**评价：方向对了，但幅度低估了上涨空间。Gold 涨幅远超他们的"爆炸性"目标。$500 的跌幅预测目前还未实现——但他们说到 "autumn"（秋天），这个时间窗口还没结束。**

### 三、方法论分析

MMA 的分析框架有几个核心支柱：

**1. 多层周期嵌套系统（最有价值）**

从 18年 → 9年 → 3年 → 50周 → primary (18周) → major (5-8周)，逐层分解。每层周期有统计范围，当多个周期的底部时间窗口重叠时，就是高概率的转折点。

这个方法的本质是**时间周期分析**，和占星无关，纯粹基于历史统计。他们的周期参数（比如 primary cycle 13-23 周）来自几十年的实证数据。

**2. CRD 天体相位反转日（争议性最大但实证有效）**

把行星相位事件聚类，找时间密集区的中点作为 CRD。听起来很玄，但从这次的验证来看**命中率确实很高**。可能的解释：
- 这些日期恰好与市场参与者的心理周期/期权到期/政策日历有某种同步
- 样本偏差——他们展示的是成功案例
- 确实存在某种尚未被充分理解的相关性

**3. 传统技术分析（扎实但常规）**

支撑/阻力、MA 趋势指标、RSI/stochastic 背离、bullish/bearish crossover zone 等。这些都是标准技术分析，没什么独特之处，但执行得很系统化。

**4. 交易建议的执行纪律（非常值得学习）**

- 分三级交易者（position / aggressive / very aggressive）
- 明确的入场价 +/- 误差范围、止损位、分批了结目标
- Mercury 逆行期间 position trader 空仓——不管理由是否科学，这种**纪律性**本身就有价值（避免在高波动期过度交易）

---

### 四、我的评价

**值得买吗？**

从这次回测来看：**值得**。原因：

1. **周期定位的实战价值极高**。他们在3月中旬就明确指出"3年周期底将在4-11月形成"，并给出了精确的价格区间。4/7 的实际底部完美验证了这个预测。如果你按他们的建议操作——在 Mercury 逆行期空仓/做空、在 CRD 4/4-7 附近寻找底部信号做多——收益会非常可观。

2. **CRD 系统有实证支持**。不管方法论多么"玄"，4个CRD全部命中是很难用偶然解释的。

3. **交易建议有纪律性**。入场/止损/目标都非常明确，不含糊。

**需要警惕的地方**：

1. **低估极端情况**：他们预期 DJIA 跌到 38,500，实际跌到 36,612。这意味着按他们的目标做多可能过早入场。这是周期分析的固有局限——能预测转折区间但精度有限。

2. **事后选择偏差**：网站上的 Scorecard 只展示成功案例。我们只看了一期报告，不能确定长期胜率。

3. **占星叙事 vs 实际有效的部分**：报告中大量的"Venus retrograde""Neptune ingress Aries"叙事，对你来说可能是噪音。**真正有价值的是周期层级表、CRD日期和交易建议**，占星解释是他们的"为什么"，你可以只用他们的"是什么"和"怎么做"。

**结论**：$130/月（周报$95 + 月报$35），如果能帮你在一次像 4/7 那样的底部成功抄底2周波段，收益远超订阅费。从这次验证来看，他们的核心产出（周期定位 + CRD + 交易建议）质量确实很高。

```text
     1→# 月相周期与 SPY 收益率关系验证 — 调查笔记
     2→
     3→## 初版脚本的 2 个 Bug
     4→
     5→### Bug #1：阶段分组定义错误（90° 相位偏移）
     6→
     7→初版代码将月相周期按"新月→满月"和"满月→新月"二分：
     8→
     9→```
    10→初版定义（错误）：
    11→  新月半周期 = 新月→上弦→满月（Phase 0+1）
    12→  满月半周期 = 满月→下弦→新月（Phase 2+3）
    13→```
    14→
    15→但 Dichev & Janes (2001) 的定义是**以月相事件为中心**：
    16→
    17→```
    18→论文定义（正确）：
    19→  新月半周期 = 以新月为中心 ±7 天 = 下弦→新月→上弦（Phase 3+0）
    20→  满月半周期 = 以满月为中心 ±7 天 = 上弦→满月→下弦（Phase 1+2）
    21→```
    22→
    23→两个定义**相差 90°**——初版把"满月前一周"(Phase 1) 归入了新月半周期，把"新月前一周"(Phase 3) 归入了满月半周期。导致分组完全错误，结论无意义。
    24→
    25→### Bug #2：样本非独立性导致 p-value 虚假
    26→
    27→初版对全部 8100 个交易日都计算 15 天前向收益，每个阶段约 2000 个"样本"。但相邻交易日的 15 天前向收益有 14/15 = 93% 的重叠，严重违反 t 检验的独立同分布 (iid) 假设。
    28→
    29→后果：标准误被严重低估 → p-value 虚假偏小（初版 p=0.0012 毫无意义）。
    30→
    31→## 修正方案
    32→
    33→修正版实现了两种独立的分析方案：
    34→
    35→| 方案 | 方法 | 样本特性 |
    36→|------|------|---------|
    37→| 方案 A（事件驱动） | 在每个新月/满月事件日计算 N 天前向收益 | ~400 个独立样本 |
    38→| 方案 B（日收益率） | 每个交易日按距最近月相分组，比较日均收益率 | 最接近论文方法 |
    39→
    40→## 修正后的结果
    41→
    42→### 方案 A：事件驱动法
    43→
    44→| 持仓 | 新月后均值 | 满月后均值 | 差异 | p-value | 年化差异 |
    45→|------|-----------|-----------|------|---------|---------|
    46→| 7 天 | +0.156% | +0.311% | -0.156% | 0.42 | -5.60% |
    47→| 15 天 | +0.399% | +0.737% | -0.338% | 0.21 | -5.67% |
    48→
    49→方向与论文**不一致**（满月后反而更高），但统计不显著。
    50→
    51→稳定性：4 个子区间中 3 个满月后更高，仅 2020-2025 新月后略高。
    52→
    53→### 方案 B：日收益率分组法（论文方法）
    54→
    55→**二分法结果**：
    56→
    57→| 指标 | 新月附近 | 满月附近 | 差异 |
    58→|------|---------|---------|------|
    59→| 日均收益 | +0.054% | +0.035% | +0.019% |
    60→| 年化 | | | **+4.79%** |
    61→| p-value | | | 0.47 |
    62→| Cohen's d | | | +0.016（微小） |
    63→
    64→方向与论文**一致**，年化差异 +4.79% 落在论文报告的 3-5% 区间内。
    65→
    66→**四分法结果**：
    67→
    68→| 阶段 | 日均收益 | 年化 | 胜率 |
    69→|------|---------|------|------|
    70→| 新月附近 | +0.066% | +16.73% | 54.0% |
    71→| 上弦附近 | -0.001% | -0.20% | 52.6% |
    72→| 满月附近 | +0.047% | +11.85% | 53.9% |
    73→| 下弦附近 | +0.069% | +17.27% | 55.5% |
    74→
    75→下弦附近日均收益最高（+17.27% 年化），上弦附近最低（-0.20%）。
    76→
    77→**稳定性验证**：
    78→
    79→| 时期 | 差异 | 年化 | 方向一致 |
    80→|------|------|------|---------|
    81→| 1993-2000 | +0.061% | +15.47% | 是 |
    82→| 2001-2009 | -0.006% | -1.51% | 否 |
    83→| 2010-2019 | +0.012% | +2.98% | 是 |
    84→| 2020-2025 | +0.011% | +2.83% | 是 |
    85→
    86→4 个子区间中 3 个方向一致，但全部统计不显著。2001-2009（911+次贷）方向相反。
    87→
    88→## 方案 A 与方案 B 结论相反的原因
    89→
    90→方案 A 衡量的是"在新月当天买入，持仓 N 天的收益"——这是一个**交易策略**视角。
    91→
    92→方案 B 衡量的是"新月附近的每日市场收益是否高于满月附近"——这是一个**统计规律**视角。
    93→
    94→两者不同因为：方案 A 的收益横跨整个持仓期，一笔 15 天的交易可能从新月半周期延伸到满月半周期。方案 B 的每日收益只反映当天的市场状态。
    95→
    96→## 结论
    97→
    98→1. **方向一致**：用论文方法（方案 B），新月附近日均收益确实高于满月附近，年化差异 +4.79%，与 Dichev & Janes 报告的 3-5% 吻合
    99→2. **统计不显著**：p=0.47，SPY 单标的 32 年数据不足以拒绝零假设。论文用 DJIA 72 年 + 多国多指数，样本量大得多
   100→3. **效应极小**：Cohen's d = 0.016，即使效应真实存在，也属于微小效应
   101→4. **不稳定**：2001-2009 区间方向相反，信号在危机期失效
   102→5. **无独立交易价值**：年化 +4.79% 扣除交易成本后 alpha 极小
   103→6. **可作辅助因子**：与 RSI/Breadth/VIX 等信号组合时，可提供微弱的方向性偏好
   104→
   105→## 月相特征作为 XGBoost 输入的评估
   106→
   107→### 与现有信号横向对比
   108→
   109→| 信号 | 成本优势 | 效应量 | 信号频率 | 维度 |
   110→|------|---------|--------|---------|------|
   111→| VIX > 30 | +9.71% | 强 | 61 次/3年 | 隐含波动率 |
   112→| BreadthC3 < 20 | +9.77% | 强 | 37 次/3年 | 市场宽度 |
   113→| NDay5 | +5.52% | 中 | 162 次/3年 | 价格动量 |
   114→| RSI v2 | +4.00% | 中 | 48 次/3年 | 超买超卖 |
   115→| EMA 过滤 | +3.36% | 中 | 335 次/3年 | 趋势 |
   116→| Breadth 背离 | +2.56% | 弱 | 4 次/3年 | 背离 |
   117→| SafeHaven | +1.03% | 极弱 | 188 次/3年 | 避险情绪 |
   118→| **月相（日收益率）** | — | **Cohen's d=0.016** | 每天 | **天文周期** |
   119→
   120→月相信号强度在所有现有信号中**排名末尾**，弱于 SafeHaven（+1.03%）。
   121→
   122→### 评估结论：值得加入，但预期要低
   123→
   124→**加入理由**：
   125→
   126→1. **与所有现有特征正交**——RSI/Breadth/VIX/EMA 全部派生自价格/波动率/市场宽度，彼此有相关性。月相是唯一来自非价格维度的信号，信息零重叠
   127→2. **XGBoost 擅长弱特征**——boosting 机制能从弱特征中提取边际信息，尤其与强特征交叉时（如"VIX > 30 且恰好在新月附近"）
   128→3. **特征工程成本极低**——月相是确定性天文计算，不需要外部数据、不滞后、不存在前视偏差
   129→
   130→**推荐的特征编码**：
   131→
   132→```python
   133→# 连续特征
   134→'lunar_phase':        0-1 归一化月相角度（0=新月，0.5=满月）
   135→'days_to_new_moon':   距最近新月天数（-7 到 +7）
   136→'days_to_full_moon':  距最近满月天数（-7 到 +7）
   137→
   138→# 离散特征
   139→'lunar_quarter':      0/1/2/3（新月/上弦/满月/下弦附近）
   140→'is_near_new_moon':   布尔（距新月 ≤3 天）
   141→```
   142→
   143→**注意事项**：
   144→
   145→- 不要期望它显著提升模型——它的贡献量级可能在第五、第六位
   146→- 必须做样本外验证——Merriman 的 144 种 Sun-Moon 组合有严重的过拟合风险
   147→- 我们只用最基础的月相特征（新月/满月距离），不用星座组合，避免数据挖掘
   148→
   149→**优先级**：在特征收集阶段加入是合理的（成本低、正交性高），但重要性远低于 VIX/Breadth/NDay5 核心特征。
   150→
   151→## Merriman 对 Solar/Lunar 信号的实际使用方式
   152→
   153→### 信号的时间尺度定位
   154→
   155→Merriman 将信号体系按时间尺度严格分层：
   156→
   157→| 层级 | 信号来源 | 周期 | 用途 |
   158→|------|---------|------|------|
   159→| **微周期** | Solar/Lunar 日月组合评分 | **1-7 天**（平均 4 天） | 日内/Swing 交易 |
   160→| 短周期 | CRD（行星集群中点） | 数天到数周 | 波段交易 |
   161→| 中周期 | 木星相位 | 数周到数月 | 中期波段 |
   162→| 长周期 | 土星/天王星/海王星/冥王星相位 | 数年 | 投资决策 |
   163→
   164→**月相/Solar-Lunar 信号属于最底层的微周期——找的是小周期的短线反转点，不是大周期买点。**
   165→
   166→### Merriman 的具体操作流程
   167→
   168→```
   169→1. 查看 WV 表：今天的太阳-月亮组合，WV 是否 ≥ 138？
   170→   ├── 否 → 今天不是高概率反转日，不操作
   171→   └── 是 → 进入步骤 2
   172→
   173→2. 观察当天价格行为：
   174→   ├── 价格突破前一天高点 → 可能形成"孤立低点"→ 看多
   175→   └── 价格跌破前一天低点 → 可能形成"孤立高点"→ 看空
   176→
   177→3. 次日确认：
   178→   ├── 确认反转方向 → 入场
   179→   └── 未确认 → 放弃
   180→
   181→4. 持仓 1-7 天，目标 3-4% 利润
   182→```
   183→
   184→**关键点**：Merriman 不会仅靠月相做交易。Solar/Lunar 只是一个"今天是否值得关注"的过滤器。真正的买卖决策需要周期阶段判断 + 技术确认。
   185→
   186→### 对我们 DCA 系统的适用性
   187→
   188→我们的 DCA 是中长期定投策略（持仓数月到数年），月相信号是 1-7 天微周期。时间尺度不匹配。
   189→
   190→但在 XGBoost 场景下，月相特征可以回答一个微观问题：**"在已经决定本周买入的前提下，周内哪天入场略微更优？"** ——这是执行层优化，不是信号层决策。
   191→
   192→## Solar-Lunar WV 评分表搜集结果
   193→
   194→### 结论：WV 数值表未公开泄露，但方法论完全可自研复现
   195→
   196→经过 30+ 个搜索查询（Amazon、Scribd、PDFCoffee、论坛、App Store 等），**没有找到 144 组合 WV 数值表的公开来源**。
   197→
   198→### 找到的线索
   199→
   200→**Scribd 上 3 个可能相关的文档**（需付费/注册查看）：
   201→
   202→| 文档 | 链接 | 说明 |
   203→|------|------|------|
   204→| Solar Lunar Tabelle | [Scribd](https://www.scribd.com/document/484255128/Solar-Lunar-Tabelle) | 德语"日月表"，1 页，可能含 WV 数据 |
   205→| Sun Moon Raymond A. Merriman | [Scribd](https://www.scribd.com/document/541260943/sun-moon-Raymond-A-Merriman) | 内容未知 |
   206→| The Sun the Moon and the Silver Market（完整书） | [Scribd](https://www.scribd.com/document/589023726/Raymond-a-Merriman-The-Sun-the-Moon-and-the-Silver-Market) | 含白银 WV 表（非黄金/股指） |
   207→

   284→### 星级评定标准

   299→3. CRD = 集群首尾事件的时间中点
   300→4. 容差窗口 = CRD 前后 ±3 个交易日
   301→```

   199→The longest cycle in the Dow we observe is the 18-year cycle, which has a range of 15 to 21 years.

   781→The 18.5-year long-term cycle in Silver commenced in Oct 2008. This cycle usually breaks down into 
   782→two 9.25-year  half  cycles, which  form  the  4.3-year  or  52-month  cycle.  The  trough  of  March 2020  was 
   783→either an extended 9.25-year cyclical trough or the second of three 6-year troughs off the low of October 
   784→2008. Based on the previous 18.5-year cycles, we tend to get a longer 9.25-year cycle followed by a shorter 
   785→one. We are now in the second, shorter, 9.25-year cycle, which commenced in March 2020. As such, it is 
   786→possible  that  the  4.3-year  half-cycle  may  have  formed  earlier  in  its  orb  and  distorted  the  26-month 
   787→intermediate cycle.

   793→was not in the Fibonacci price range for the 4.3-year trough (2220 +/- 249) and failed to test the trendlines 
   794→or the 56-week MA.

  1086→January 13 low was a 50-week cycle (9-15 months) bottom as well. If so, then our expectation is for T-
  1087→Notes to experience a bullish primary cycle currently and perhaps even in the one that follows.

  1092→unfolding, and a major cycle trough was completed on March 13 at 110/12.5 in the June contract. This

  1417→The longest cycle we observe in Soybeans is the 17-year cycle which last bottomed in May 2019. This 
  1418→17-year cycle typically breaks down into either two 8.5-year cycles or three 5.5-year cycles. The year 2025 
  1419→will begin the 6th year of this new 17-year cycle, so we are now in the time band for when the first 5.5-
  1420→year cycle could be due. In fact, if the 5.5-year cycle is active, my bias is it probably formed in August 2024 
  1421→2024 on the nearby contract at the time (December 19 in the May contract currently used, just before the 
  1422→second Jupiter/Saturn square).

  1425→month of the cycle, so it would have bottomed right on time. March is, therefore, the 7th month of this 
  1426→new 34-month cycle. The average time it takes 34-month cycles to top out is 17 months (normal range 7-
  1427→32 months), with an average gain of 80% (range 6%-228%). We are in the 7th month, so based on past 
  1428→cycles, Soybeans could conceivably top out this month before heading lower. An indication that this is

  1436→effect March 10. Additionally, China suspended import licenses for three large United States grain firms.

  1439→still hopeful for at least a 7-10-month rally with the price reaching 1200.00+ before this new 34-month

  1552→The Euro is in the 6th week of a new 33-week primary cycle, off the February 3, 2024 low, at 1.0142 USD. The 
  1553→prices have since risen 7.94% to 1.0947 on March 11 and have, after that, slightly pulled back 1.16% to 1.0820 on 
  1554→March 13. The prices closed last week on March 14 at 1.0879. As the prices have ascended notably in a short amount 
  1555→of time, it now looks very plausible that a longer 24-month intermediate-term cycle trough also occurred on February 
  1556→3.

  1561→

  1563→that the long-term bullish trend is at play in the Euro. Nevertheless, it is early days, so we still need to examine the

  1591→The bullish long-term scenario 
  1592→
  1593→In the bullish long-term scenario, the Euro is 2.5 years into its 16-year, 8.4-year, and 4-year cycles that all started 
  1594→on September 28, 2022, at 0.9534. The prices are here expected to head north towards the 4-year cycle crest. This 
  1595→peak is anticipated to unfold in the time frame of August 2025-December 2026, at 1.1577-1.3741 (a rise of 21.43-
  1596→44.13%). The confirmation that this bullish long-term scenario is operational comes first if the 1.1275 crest of July 
  1597→2023 is surpassed. 
  1598→
  1599→The bearish long-term scenario 
  1600→
  1601→In this case, the 16-year greater cycle started in January 2017. The prices have here fallen below 1.0339, the 
  1602→start of the 16-year cycle, which implies that the lowest price should be at the very end of the cycle, sometimes 
  1603→around 2033. The Euro is here 8.2 years into the first 8.4-year cycle and heading towards an 8.4-year cycle trough, 
  1604→anticipated to manifest sometime between March 2024 and August 2026. The prices should, at minimum, take out 
  1605→the 0.9534 low of September 2022. 
  1606→
  1607→In this bearish scenario, the 8.4-year cycle splits into three 32-month cycles. We would now be twenty-nine 
  1608→months into the final 32-month cycle that commenced in September 2022. We got a 32-month cycle crest after ten 
  1609→months in July 2023 at 1.1275. The prices are now on their way towards the third 32-month cycle low, projected to 
  1610→occur with its 7-month orb, sometime between November 2024 and December 2025, at a decline of 10.98-25.27%. 
  1611→Therefore, the price target span comes to 0.8426-1.0037. As this is the final 32-month cycle low, we can overlap with 
  1612→the targets for the 8.4-year cycle trough. Thus, for the forthcoming long-term cycle low, we obtain a narrowed-down 
  1613→time target of November 2024-December 2025 and a concentrated price target span of 0.8426-0.9533. Meanwhile,

  1635→

  1640→The preferred bullish intermediate-term scenario 
  1641→
  1642→For  the  bullish  intermediate-term  scenario,  the  4-year  cycle  has  so  far  always  split  into  two  24-month 
  1643→intermediate-term cycles. We should be here in the 1st month of the second 24-month intermediate-term cycle that 
  1644→started on February 3, 2024 low, at 1.0142. The previous 24-month cycle was active for an acceptable 28 months. 
  1645→The Euro is now on its way towards the second 24-month cycle crest, which is expected to also be the 4-year cycle 
  1646→top (targets already given in the long-term cycle segment). 
  1647→
  1648→The alternative bearish intermediate-term scenario 
  1649→
  1650→The 32-month cycle normally divides into two 15-month intermediate-term cycles. The best labeling here is 
  1651→that we got a first 15-month cycle low in October 2023 and that the second 15-month cycle ended, after a run of 16 
  1652→months, in February 2025. However, in this bearish situation, the second 15-month cycle was expected to fall below 
  1653→the 0.9534 low of September 2022. Hence, if this alternative is alive, then we should get an additional 15-month 
  1654→cycle,  probably  a  short  one, as  the  8.4-year  cycle  trough  is  due.  If  this  is  correct,  then the  prices  are  now  rising 
  1655→towards a bearish 15-month cycle crest, expected in 75% of the cases to occur after a minimum of eight weeks, at a 
  1656→rise of 4.18-5.24%. As we have already risen above this price level, it looks less probable that this scenario is active.

  1676→LEADING INDICATORS FOR THE 33-WEEK PRIMARY CYCLE 
  1677→
  1678→Our  chart  labeling  is  that  a  new  33-week  primary  cycle  low  occurred  on  February  3,  2025,  at  1.0142.  The 
  1679→previous primary cycle that started on April 16, 2024, ran for a very long 42 weeks. It was a distorted cycle, as in 70% 
  1680→of the cases, the 33-week primary cycle in the Euro should bottom out by the 40th week at the latest. However, we 
  1681→already noted in previous reports: “Keep in mind that as a 24-month cycle trough is also expected, we could get an 
  1682→extended  primary  cycle.  The  longest  primary  cycle  ever  recorded  was  44  weeks  long.”  As  the  bias  is  that  an 
  1683→intermediate-term cycle also bottomed out, we expect a bullish behavior for the current primary cycle. 
  1684→
  1685→The preferred bullish February 3 primary cycle  
  1686→
  1687→The 33-week primary cycle itself is for now anticipated to peak out sometime between July 3-October 9, 2025. 
  1688→More short-term, the prices are forecasted to rise for either 9+/-3w to a bullish 12-week major cycle crest or for 
  1689→12w+/-3w  to  a  bullish  16-week  half-primary  cycle  top.  Using  the  February  3  low,  we  obtain  time  targets  for  the 
  1690→potential crests of March 17-May 6 and April 4-May 19, respectively. 
  1691→
  1692→Once the sub-cycle crest is in place, prices should descend to either a 12-week major cycle low, projected to 
  1693→occur in the time frame April 3 to May 29, 2025, or a 16-week half-primary cycle bottom, anticipated to happen 
  1694→sometime between April 21-June 25, 2025.  
  1695→
  1696→The alternative bearish February 3 primary cycle  
  1697→
  1698→Here, the prices should only rally for 5-12 weeks, or to March 7-April 30. The prices would then head lower 
  1699→towards  either  the  first  12-major  cycle  low  or  the  16-week  half-primary  cycle  bottom,  due  to  unfold  sometime 
  1700→between April 3 and May 29 and April 21 and June 25, respectively.
