   793→## The 3-Year Cycle
   794→
   795→The cycle that both the 9-year and 6-year cycles share is the 3-year cycle. Last year’s trading plan was built around the 3-year cycle trough that was expected between December 2024 and October 2025. And indeed, it did culminate within this time band on April 7, 2025, at 14,784 in the NASDAQ. It was a sharp and quick decline of 27% from the 3-year cycle crest that formed on December 16, 2024, at 20,205, and satisfied our criteria for a 3-year cycle low. We are now in the third and final 3-year cycle phase of the greater 9-year cycle. That same 3-year cycle is also the third and final phase within the current 6-year cycle. This means the current 3-year cycle is the last intermediate-term cycle phase within the current 18-year cycle. November 2025 starts the 8th month of the current 3-year cycle. This is a great example of why MMA’s “cycles within cycles” principle is so valuable. By tracking and breaking down the intermediate-term cycles, we can get a detailed read on the long-term cycles and their development and status. Since 1980, there have been 16 completed 3-year cycles observed in the NASDAQ. In 80% of the instances, the 3-year cycle in the NASDAQ has a normal length of 2.6 years or 31 months with a normal range of 26–36 months. Thus, the current 3-year cycle is due to bottom next between June 2027 and April 2028. This overlaps with the time band of the long-term cycles from June 2027 to August 2027, making this a high probability time band for the 18-year cycle trough, where most cycles overlap (the “hot zone”). Historically, in 80% of the cases, 3-year cycles have rallied between 10–37 months to their crest with an average of 26 months. As of this writing, the current 3-year cycle has been going up for 7 months from its start in April 2025 and will enter the time band for its crest to form in 3 months (beginning of 2026). By that time, the 6-year cycle will also have entered the time band for its crest. The 9-year cycle will enter the time band for its crest in October 2026, but let’s keep in mind that we are expecting a short 9-year cycle in which the crest could happen earlier than the historical time band.
   796→
   797→<!-- PAGE 116 END -->
   798→
   799→The appreciation of 3-year cycles has been between 55%–122% with an average of 99%. Based on these studies, the price target for the 3-year cycle crest is 29,600 with a range of 23,050–33,050. This falls right within the price target range for the long-term cycle of 21,700–49,400, narrowing down that range. The current 3-year cycle has appreciated over 60% so far from its starting low in April 2025 and has already entered the target price range. We can conclude that the 3-year cycle crest price target range is the one to focus on for the 18-year cycle crest as well. Once the crest is in, the historical range of decline from the crest to trough in 3-year cycles has been 1–14 months with an average of 6 months. The historical depreciation has seen a range of 11%–49% with an average of 30%. Moreover, from our studies, we know that the last phase of a greater cycle often retests the second phase low. In the case of the 9-year cycle, that would be the low of October 2022, which, from the current highs, would represent a 55–60% decline. In case of the 6-year cycle, this would be the low of April 2025, which, from the current highs, would represent a 35–40% decline.
   800→
   801→## The 50-Week Cycle
   802→
   803→The 3-year cycle in the NASDAQ further breaks down into three 50-week cycles, when it unfolds in a 3-phase pattern. Historically, in 80% of the cases, the 50-week cycle has a normal length of 50 weeks with a range of 35–65 weeks. If the 50-week cycles are on the longer side, then a 3-year cycle can also break down into two 50-week cycles, as in a 2-phase pattern. Another possibility is a breakdown into a combination pattern, in which we would see lows at the 1/3 and 1/2 intervals of the greater 3-year cycle. Measured from its start in October 2022, the previous 3-year cycle broke down in a 3-phase pattern with 50-week cycle lows in October 2023, August 2025, and the third and final low in April 2025. As of this writing in November 2025, the current 50-week cycle, measured from its start in April 2025, has progressed 30 weeks. The next 50-week cycle trough is due in March 2026, with a range of January 2026 – May 2026, when a 1/6 orb of the normal length is applied. If the orb of 15 weeks is applied, the 50-week cycle trough range increases from December 2025 to July 2026. The current 50-week cycle seems to be breaking down in a 3-phase pattern. Currently, we are only in the second phase of the 50-week cycle. Historically, in 80% of the cases, 50-week cycles have rallied between 22–65 weeks from trough to crest with an average of 43 weeks. Thus, we are already in the range for the crest. However, since this is only the first 50-week cycle in a new 3-year cycle and the first 50-week cycle usually exhibits bullish characteristics, I expect the crest to form within the second or third phase, which would be December 2025 through March 2026. The appreciation from trough to crest has historically ranged from 18%–73% with an average of 39%. Measured from the starting trough in April 2025, this gives us a price target range of 17,500–25,700 for the current 50-week cycle, which has also been achieved as of this writing. Once the crest is in, in 80% of the cases, 50-week cycles have declined from the crest to the trough for 4–38 weeks with an average of 13 weeks. The historical depreciation from the crest to the trough ranges from 8%–34% with an average of 18%. Thus, we anticipate an 8%–34% drop in the NASDAQ in the first half of 2026.

   811→Let’s first look at the critical reversal dates for 2026 that are specific to the NASDAQ. Critical Reversal Dates are high-probability market turning points identified through proprietary algorithms by Jonathan Jairaj and Wiebke Held, based on the correlation of market and planetary cycles in the NASDAQ for the past 40+ years. The methods to derive the CRDs are built upon The Ultimate Book on Stock Market Timing Volume 3: Geocosmic Correlations to Trading Cycles, by Raymond Merriman, and have been further enhanced to improve prediction accuracy for the NASDAQ. CRDs are ranked by correlation strength, with three-star CRDs signifying the highest probability for cycle crests or troughs to form. There are six three-star Critical Reversal Dates (CRDs) in 2026 for the NASDAQ: January 20 (+/– 4 trading days) March 22–25 (+/– 4 trading days) June 15 (+/– 4 trading days) July 20–25 (+/– 4 trading days) September 15–25 (+/– 4 trading days)

   849→## CONCLUSION
   850→
   851→In the longer-term picture, 2026 will likely witness the 18–year cycle crest. The price target range is 23,050–33,050, or if this is exceeded, up to 49,400 (extreme target). Once the crest is in, the decline into the 18-year cycle trough will start. This decline will likely last between 1–31 months or 1–15, if we take the narrower time band from the 18-year cycle phases (9- and 6-year cycles). The highest probability is for the 18-year cycle trough to occur in 2027 or 2028, with a narrower time band from February through August 2027 and a “hot zone” of June through August 2027. In the intermediate-term picture, a 50-week cycle crest is due in the first quarter of 2026 (if not already formed by December 2025) with a price target of 17,500–25,700. This crest will be followed by an 8–34% decline in the NASDAQ into the first 50-week cycle low of the current 3-year cycle. The time band for this low is December 2025 through July 2026, with a “hot zone” between January and May 2026. Watch the January 20, March 22–25, and June 15 CRDs closely during this time, as those deliver the highest probability time windows for the 50-week crest and trough to unfold. The 50-week cycle trough will be followed by another rally into the second half of 2026 that will likely last 22–65 weeks with an appreciation of 18%–73%, forming the crest of the second 50-week cycle in the current 3-year cycle. The July 15–25 CRD is the ideal geocosmic backdrop for this to happen. The question is whether this crest will exceed the first 50-week cycle crest or not, as at some point the 3-year cycle will likely turn bearish and start the decline into the 18-year cycle trough. My preferred scenario is that the crest of the second 50-week cycle will retest or slightly exceed the crest of the first 50-week cycle, forming a double top formation. This would signal that the 18-year crest is likely to unfold in Q2 or Q3, depending on how the cycle count develops after the first 50-week cycle trough. However, if the second 50-week cycle crest rises clearly above the first crest and prices continue trading higher, then the 18-year cycle crest is more likely to occur at the end of the second 50-week cycle. In that case, we would expect a retest by the crest of the third 50-week cycle, and an 18-week primary cycle crest would be expected later in 2026 (Q3-Q4). In this scenario, pay close attention to the September 15–25 CRD and the Venus retrograde period (October 3–November 14) for a sig nificant long-term cycle crest. All scenarios will continue to be reviewed and refined in the monthly MMA Tech Report. These conditions would represent a textbook long-term cycle crest with a classic double top formation formed by intermediate-term cycles. However, it is important to remember that the final phases of a greater cycle most often distort, and the pattern may not unfold in a perfect textbook manner. We are currently in the final phases of all long-term cycles, so the intermediate-term cycles may be shorter or longer than their normal length and range, or can even be skipped completely. Therefore, if we observe a decline greater than 34% in the NASDAQ, that would indicate the decline into the 18-year cycle trough is likely underway. In that event, traders and investors should be prepared to buy the long-term cycle trough of the 18-year cycle. Additionally, any intermediateterm cycle crest that develops in late 2025 or 2026 should be viewed as an opportunity for traders and investors to reduce exposure to the NASDAQ and the broader US stock market in anticipation of the decline into the 18-year cycle low.

   859→## REVIEW
   860→
   861→What an incredible year for Gold in 2025! At the time of writing last year’s Forecast 2025 book, we were in the time band for an intermediate low when it was written, “Gold is due for a second 10.5month cycle low by November 2024. The price target for this low could be between $2350–$2575.” Indeed, Gold bottomed out on November 14 at 2541.50. It then exploded to an all-time high of $4398 on October 20. This was above even our most optimistic price target mentioned last year, which was $3743 +/- 411. Since peaking, Gold is now in the process of correcting back into a 50-week and 31-month cycle low that is due ideally by the end of January 2026. If a bottom forms, then all eyes will be on whether or not Gold can eclipse that $4398 high in 2026.    862→
   863→## 16-YEAR CYCLE
   864→
   865→Gold likely has a 16-year long-term cycle, which aligns well with the lengths of long-term cycles in other financial and commodity markets. However, since we only have two observed instances of this cycle (three if you consider 1968 as a viable low, as I do), it will take many more years of data to confirm this. Until that happens, we will operate under the assumption that Gold has a 16-year cycle with a historical 2-year orb. It last bottomed in December 2015, placing 2026 in the 11th year of the current cycle. It is next due to bottom in 2029–2033. As we are past the halfway point of the longterm cycle, we need to be aware that a crest could form at any moment. It could even have occurred at the October 2025 all-time high of $4398, but this is not our current bias. What is interesting about the $4398 high is that it was very close to an exact doubling of the rise from the preceding 16-year cycle. Measuring from the double bottom lows of 1999–2001 to the 16-year crest of September 2011, Gold rallied $1667. If we double that amount and add it to the December 2015 16-year bottom of $1045, we get $4379. The October high of $4398 is within $20 of this price target, which means it needs to be given some serious consideration for being a 16-year high. Right now, our bias is that Gold will make further gains in 2026 before ultimately peaking out, but if Gold experiences a monthly close below $2541 before making a new all-time high, then the top for this 16-year cycle is probably in. Until that happens, the next upside price targets for this 16-year cycle are $5016 +/- 467, followed by $5410 +/- 515.
   866→

   868→
   869→## THE 7.8-YEAR CYCLE
   870→
   871→All cycles typically break down into two or three sub-cycles of approximately equal length. For Gold, the 16-year cycle predominantly breaks down into a two-phase pattern of 7.8-year cycles. This 7.8-year cycle is 94 months long and has a normal range of 84–104 months. Measuring from the start of this current 16-year cycle that bottomed in December 2015, we would have expected the first 7.8year cycle phase to bottom sometime between December 2022 and August 2024. Instead, it bottomed one month early (83rd month) in November 2022 at $1618. We might now consider the new normal range of these cycles to be 83–104 months. January 2026 will begin the 38th month of the second 7.8-year cycle phase measured from the November 2022 bottom. It is next due between October 2029 and July 2031 and will coincide with the next 16-year cycle low (notice the nice overlap of the time bands for both lows). The crest will happen first, and it was stated last year, “There have been seven 7.8-year cycles since 1968, and not one has peaked out before the 34th month. This implies that even higher prices for Gold are in store for 2025.” This proved to be even more than correct, with Gold surpassing all upside price targets. Last year also stated, “If we look at just the second phase 7.8-year cycles, which we are now in, these have topped out in the 35th month twice and also in the 41st month of the cycle. This gives us a general time period for a crest between October 2025 and April 2026 at the earliest.” So, we have another reason to consider that Gold may have formed a long-term top in October 2025, as this was the first month of the time band for when we expected a bearish 7.8-year crest to form. If not, then we expect a crest to form by April 2026, but it may spill over into May or June. Gold has already exploded through all of the normal upside price targets given in last year’s forecast. If the rally continues, as we suspect, then Fibonacci extension targets for a 7.8-year crest may be $5108 and $5352. These overlap nicely with the price targets given for the 16-year crest earlier. There is an even higher price target around $6600 using the highest range of historical per centage gains of 7.8–year cycles. But the preferred targets would be in the lower measured price target ranges just given. Once this 31-month cycle bottoms, we will then be able to narrow down possible upside objectives.

   874→
   875→## INTERMEDIATE TERM CYCLES
   876→
   877→Based on the fact that all cycles break down into two or three sub-cycle phases, the 7.8-year cycle could break down into either two 47-month cycles or three 31-month cycles. The predominant breakdown has been the three-phase pattern, so we are basing the current forecast on the assumption that this 7.8-year cycle will break down in this manner. January 2026 will begin the 38th month of the first 31-month cycle measured off the start of the current 7.8-year cycle in November 2022. With a normal range of 24–38 months, it is due to bottom by the end of January 2026 (if it hasn’t bottomed already in November or December). However, there is always a chance it could expand by a few months. The crest of this first 31-month cycle phase topped on October 20 at a price of $4398. This was a 172% gain and it was in line with the historical gains of this cycle. When looking at all 31-month cycle phases that immediately follow a 7.8-year low, all but one have been bullish (as this one has been), and they only decline for 1–4 months before bottoming. This supports the idea that a significant low in Gold should be in by the end of January, with an outside chance of it occurring as late as February 2026. A normal corrective price target for this coming 31-month low would be $2680–$3336. We would also like to see the 16-month moving average tested on the decline (currently around $3200 and rising), but given that this has been an extremely bullish cycle, Gold may bottom at a higher level than usual. At the very least, a 20% decline could be anticipated, which targets $3500 +/- $100. We would also prefer to see prices at least test the 16-month moving average, which stands at about $3200 in mid-November 2025 and rises about $100/mo. At whatever price the 31-month cycle ultimately bottoms, our bias is that new all-time highs are in store for 2026. The 31-month cycles can break down into two 16-month half cycles (with a range of 13–20 months) or three 10.5-month cycles with a range of 9–12 months (sometimes expanding up to 14 months). The 10.5-month cycle can be referred to as a 50-week cycle that carries an 8-week orb. Often, we will get a combination of two- and three-phased patterns. However, the current 31-month cycle is breaking down as a classic three-phase pattern of three 50-week cycles. The start of the third and final 50-week cycle was November 14, 2024, so it is due to bottom by the end of December 2025 unless it expands by a few weeks, which is a possibility given that the longer 31-month cycle is also due to bottom at the end of this current 50-week cycle. While the above outlines when, and at what price, we think this first 31-month cycle will bottom before ultimately continuing higher into 2026, we need to entertain the possibility that this 7.8-year cycle might instead display the less frequent two-phased pattern of two 47-month cycles instead. A clue that this might be happening is if Gold fails to even reach the 50-week moving average on this decline (currently around $3293 in mid-November 2025 and rising about 30/mo.) or fails to decline for even a month before making new highs past December. Such a shallow decline could still be a 50-week cycle low (47-month cycles contain four 50-week cycles and two 23.5-month half cycles), but it would mean that Gold would be rallying in the fourth and final 50-week cycle instead of the first 50-week cycle in a new 31-month cycle. Even in this scenario, we are expecting new all-time highs for Gold in 2026. However, if it is a 47-month cycle crest that is forming early in 2026, then we could also be looking at an extremely steep decline in the coming year as well. This is because a 47-month low would then be due February

   883→## GEOCOSMICS
   884→
   885→Saturn in aspect to a planet outside of its orbit has proved to be timely in ushering in a major high or low in the Gold market. Specifically, at all but one 7.8-year high or low, Saturn has been aspecting Uranus, Neptune, or Pluto within a reasonable orb of time around the occurrence. And, at the one instance where Saturn wasn’t making an aspect to Uranus, Neptune, or Pluto (March 2008 high), Saturn was still involved, as this was when the last instance of Jupiter in a waxing trine to Saturn took place. The reason this is so important for the coming year is that we will have Saturn forming a waning sextile to Uranus in January 2026, Saturn conjunct Neptune in February 2026, and Saturn forming a waxing sextile to Pluto in March 2026. This makes the first half of 2026 a very good time for the current 7.8-year cycle to top out. First up will be Saturn forming a waning sextile to Uranus, taking place on January 19, 2026. It will be the third and final pass of this aspect, with the first two having occurred on April 4, 2025, and August 11, 2025. What is interesting is that the previous occurrence of this aspect was in 1979–1980 and occurred in three passes as well. The first was September 16, 1979, and led to a 10.5-month cycle crest three weeks later. The second passage on February 17, 1980, was big for Gold. It coincided with a 16-year crest four weeks earlier when Gold hit an all-time high of $873 in January 1980. This high remained in place for the next 28 years until it was finally surpassed in 2008. The last pass occurred on July 4, 1980, and was followed by a primary cycle crest one week later. Based on historical pre cedence, it is within reason that we could see the final 50-week and also 31-month cycle low form within 4 weeks of January 19, 2026. We also need to acknowledge the fact that a 16-year cycle high did occur during the central time band of this aspect in the past, and did so with price moving in a parabolic-like manner. Something similar is occurring this time around with Gold having exploded to a high (so far) on October 20, 2025. This is also in the central time band of Saturn, forming a waning sextile to Uranus. While our bias is for new highs in Gold during 2026, the possibility that another 16-year high could be in by January 19, 2026, is certainly plausible too. As we move into February, Saturn will form a conjunction with Neptune on the World Point of 0° Aries. Neptune in Aries could usher in another inflationary wave to wash over the markets, which could propel commodity markets (like metals) higher. Gold also has shown to like Neptune and performs favorably when aspects involving Neptune are highlighted. Being that the conjunction between Saturn and Neptune is the middle of the three big aspects Saturn is forming to outer planets early in 2026, makes it a favored time to see a 7.8-year crest within 5 months of February 2026. It should also be noted that the last time Saturn entered the sign of Aries was in April 1996. A 7.8year crest occurred 2 months prior in February of that year. Might something similar happen when Saturn re-enters Aries on February 13, 2026? In March, Saturn will form a waxing sextile to Pluto on March 28. The last time this aspect was in effect was 1989–1990. At that time, there were three passages that took place, with the third one coinciding with a somewhat rare 47-month high within 8 days. Recall that a 7.8-year cycle can break down into two 47-month cycle phases. This sets a precedent that a phase of the 7.8-year cycle has peaked with this aspect in the past, so it’s possible the top of the second 31-month cycle could be around April +/- 1 month.

   889→## CONCLUSION
   890→
   891→Last year’s Forecast 2025 book concluded, “Gold is due for a 31-month cycle crest and trough in 2025. Once the crest of the 31-month cycle forms, Gold could fall 10–20% to a 31-month cycle low that is due anytime during 2025. Ideally, this low forms in the latter half of the year between July 2025 and December 2025.” As we close out 2025 and turn the calendar to 2026, Gold is following this script. Gold formed its 31-month cycle crest in October and is now immersed in a correction to a 31-month cycle bottom. This bottom is ideally due by the end of December 2025, but may extend into January 2026. The price target for this low is quite wide at $2680–$3336. Being that Gold has been so bullish (as it should be in the first phase of a new 7.8-year cycle), Gold may not drop as far as we might expect. Therefore, a more bullish price target for a low might be $3300–$3600. Once the 31-month low forms, we expect Gold to rally to new all-time highs in 2026. Determining a price target for the next 31-month cycle crest is difficult without knowing exactly where the bottom will form, but if it comes in around $3500, Gold could hit $5225 +/- 425 or even $6285 +/550. However, exceeding the October 20 high of $4398 will need to happen first. Gold likes to form double tops and double bottoms, so there is certainly a risk that the high for Gold in 2026 occurs not far from $4400. This would be the most bearish outcome for Gold in 2026. In either case, one of the most likely times for this high to form is February 2026 +/- 5 months. In the off chance that Gold satisfies the criteria laid out for a 47-month cycle crest forming instead in 2026, Gold could see an impressive decline into the second half of the year.

  1633→## MERCURY RETROGRADE PERIODS IN 2026
  1634→
  1635→There will be three Mercury retrograde periods between February 26 and November 13, 2026. They are: February 26–March 20 (2233°’ Pisces to 829°’ Pisces); June 29–July 23 (2615°’ Cancer to 1618°’ Cancer); and October 24–November 13 (2058°’ Scorpio to 502°’ Scorpio). During 2025, Mercury retrograde occurred in the fire signs of Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius. This created an atmosphere of exuberance, impulsiveness, and overconfidence that was mirrored in world affairs and the financial markets. Fire retrogrades are quick to spark bold proclamations and rash decisions, often with outsized consequences. A striking example came in April 2025, when President Trump’s sudden declaration of “Liberation Day” rattled markets around the world. That announce ment, made without the tempering of detail or diplomacy, sent shockwaves through global exchanges and highlighted how Mercury retrograde in fire can encourage impulsive statements with dramatic market repercussions. On June 13, we also witnessed Israel’s surprise attack on Iran, commencing the Twelve-Day War between the two nations. Mercury was not retrograde at that time, but it occurred in the year when the Trickster was retrograde in fire signs, thus highlighting the fiery nature of decisions in 2025. In 2026, the retrogrades move into the water signs of Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces, bringing an entirely different tone. Water retrogrades emphasize emotion, empathy, and sensitivity, shifting the focus away from impulsive confidence toward a more reactive and subjective climate. The world is already deeply embroiled in conflict on multiple fronts, and the prevalence of social media ensures that images of suffering and human cost reach global audiences instantly and relentlessly. Against this backdrop, Mercury retrograde in water signs will encourage leaders, institutions, and populations to view global events through an emotional lens, often appealing to sympathy, compassion, and even guilt. A more melancholic undertone is therefore likely to accompany this period. With retrogrades in water signs, all communication also comes under the influence of the rulers of these signs: the Moon, Neptune, and Pluto. The Moon will shape discourse with sentimentality and national pride, stirring populations with messages that evoke nostalgia, a sense of belonging, and a longing for security. Neptune brings ambiguity, fog, na ïveté, and the risk of outright deception; communications under its influence may be poetic or idealistic but often lack clarity or concrete detail, leaving room for confusion and misinterpretation. Pluto adds intensity, secrecy, and power struggles. Under its shadow, words may carry hidden agendas, veiled threats, or attempts at manipulation. Taken together, this suggests that communications from world leaders during 2026 may be emotionally charged, deliberately ambiguous, and, in some cases, deceptive or obscuring of truth. The shift will be most visible in negotiations and geopolitics. In place of fiery, declarative rhetoric, discussions are more likely to be framed as pleas for understanding, emotional appeals, and heightened sensitivities. This introduces fragility into diplomacy. Talks may stall or unravel not because of the substance of the proposals but because of perceived slights, mistrust, or emotional overreactions. Nations directly involved in warfare or humanitarian crises will find their narratives amplified, with sympathetic responses flowing more quickly, but also with polarization increasing when emotions cloud rational compromise. Leaders who thrive on emotional rhetoric may gain traction in this climate, but they also risk backlash if sentiment is not supported by practical solutions.

Mercury retrograde in water signs does not resolve conflict, but it does reframe how the world experiences and reacts to it.   1647→## VENUS RETROGRADE PERIOD IN 2026
  1648→
  1649→There will be one Venus retrograde period in effect in 2026, from October 3 to November 13, 2026. Venus will begin its retrograde motion at 829°’ Scorpio and move back to 2251°’ Libra on November 13, before returning to direct motion. The dance of Venus through the signs of Scorpio and Libra will have the greatest impact on individuals with strong placements in these signs, as well as on those with Venus retrograde in their natal charts. It is also worth noting that Venus retrogrades occur in nearly the same sign and degree every eight years. Venus, the goddess of love and beauty, traditionally rules harmony, attraction, wealth, and the arts, bringing balance and drawing people and nations into accord. In mundane astrology, she also shapes the tone of diplomacy, treaties, and alliances, while in finance, she governs currencies, banking, prosperity, and the appetite for luxury. When Venus turns retrograde, however, these themes become unsettled: alliances strain, markets question value, currencies wobble, and societies reassess what they truly cherish. It is a time when appearances fade, trust is tested, and both nations and individuals are called to re-evaluate what is worth keeping and what must be released. Whenever a planet is retrograde, the time is generally not favorable for initiating activities in the areas that planet rules. Therefore, October 3 to November 13 is not conducive to significant changes in appearance, relationships, or the purchase of goods or services intended to enhance one’s image. Major changes in hairstyle, cosmetic surgery (including procedures on the face or other areas meant to improve attractiveness), breast or lip implants, and liposuction are NOT generally advised during this time. Furthermore, one is advised against making important purchases for home or office furnishings or undertaking major renovations in one’s home, office, or building without first taking the time to make sure the same products or services are available elsewhere at a lower cost. With Venus retro grade in Scorpio, one might be prone to overleveraging with debt, but it may be wise to do a little homework before taking on debt or a leveraged position during this time. Venus retrograde is a time when lovers from the past may re-emerge, as a sense of nostalgia about previous relationships comes into one’s consciousness. However, these may not work out in the long run, so it is best to simply enjoy them for what they are and reminisce about the good times in the past without weaving complex webs regarding a future together. What Venus retrograde is excellent for, however, is reflection and re-evaluation. Old lovers or friends may resurface, giving a chance for closure or reconciliation. People often find themselves reassessing what—and who—they truly value. In finances, it is a fruitful time to review spending habits, renegotiate agreements, or reconsider investments. In creative and artistic pursuits, it can bring a revisiting of old projects or a reimagining of past inspirations. We saw an echo of this reflective quality in April 2025, when President Trump’s sudden “Liberation Day” announcement, in which he was reassessing the U.S. economic relationship with “friends and foes,” sent markets into turmoil. The declaration carried the dramatic, impulsive fire-sign tone of that year’s Mercury and Venus retrogrades in Aries, forcing investors and nations alike to pause, reconsider the true value of assets, and reassess the relationships and alliances underpinning financial and geopolitical stability. In this way, Venus retrogrades often serve less as moments of dramatic outward change and more as turning
  1650→

With Scorpio ruling over debt and Venus ruling money, it should come as no surprise to find that significant cyclical reversals tend to take place during this signature.   1661→## SPECIFIC TIMES OF THE YEAR BY SEASONS IN 2026
  1662→
  1663→by Pouyan Zolfagharnia, MMA Analyst In the ancient world, astrologers often relied on the seasonal ingress charts—moments when the Sun entered the cardinal signs—as powerful tools for forecasting. In ancient Persia, these days were not only seen as moments of celestial importance but were also regarded as sacred days infused with special energy. Astrologers would calculate the exact moment of the ingress, and people were encouraged to use this time for prayer and visualization of personal growth and a bet ter world. The spring ingress, for instance, was celebrated as Nowruz, the New Year—a tradition that continues to this day. Even now, many astrologers view the spring ingress as a symbolic “birth chart” for the year ahead. Interestingly, echoes of this ancient practice survive in modern culture, woven into our holidays and festivals. Christmas, aligned with the winter solstice, celebrates the coming of the “Son of God,” as the astrological “Sun of God” is reborn out of the year’s darkest night. Easter, near the spring equinox, celebrates resurrection and new life with the symbolic egg. The summer solstice has likewise been marked by celebrations of light, fertility, and abundance through ancient European traditions such as Midsummer or St. John’s Day. Halloween, just after the autumn equinox, aligns with the Sun’s passage through Scorpio, the sign of death and rebirth. Ancient cultures marked these turning points of the year not only because of their practical relationship with the Sun, the Earth, and the onset of the seasons but also because of the profound impact these shifts had on human life and survival. Astrologers, however, took the moment further, using the ingress as a celestial “snapshot” of the heavens at the precise moment of transition and interpreting it as an imprint of the energies destined to shape the months ahead. The chart itself changes depending on one’s location on Earth, which is why, traditionally, the ingress chart cast for the ruling capital of the world was given special weight. After all, the decisions made at the seat of power carry the greatest repercussions across the world. In this section of the book, we analyze the 2026 seasonal ingress charts for Washington, D.C. We then examine the major planetary aspects that occur throughout each season. This provides a collective psychological overview of what is happening in the United States and the world. From there, we deduce certain themes that may be highlighted in the political, economic, financial, and mundane realms. We then apply this ancient art to speculate on possible events or decisions that may relate to these highlighted themes. This year, we will also include the astrocartography chart to see which regions of the world are most likely to be activated during each period. We will also mention the national charts and the charts of global leaders that may be activated under important transits to help us speculate on which nations and leaders are likely to fall under the cosmic spotlight. Let’s begin with the winter solstice of December 21, 2025, which outlines the cosmic themes for the following three months.

  1679→## THE CAPRICORN INGRESS (WINTER SOLSTICE)
  1680→
  1681→The winter solstice for Washington, D.C., occurs on December 21, 2025, at 10:02 AM EST. The Sun (leader of the nation) is in the eleventh house of friends, alliances, hope, and prosperity. It forms a hard, separating square aspect to Saturn (lord, or ruler, of both the first and twelfth houses) and Neptune (lord of the second house of finances), which are in conjunction on the cusp of the second house. The Sun in the eleventh house suggests that the White House will be focused on alliances, party politics, lawmaking, and working closely with Congress and legislators. In the international arena, it is likely to be working closely with allies, building on ties and common interests. Saturn as lord of the first house represents the government or nation bound to economic issues (cusp of second house). Saturn tends to bring about restrictions, austerity, or a debt burden. Since it is also lord (ruler) of the twelfth house, Saturn could introduce a theme of hidden loss, sabotage, systemic decay, or waste. Together, these factors could represent the U.S. national debt burden. The second house can also represent the Federal Reserve, and the heavy presence of Saturn could indicate restrictions or pressure being placed on it by the government. Neptune in conjunction with Saturn further emphasizes the notion of manipulation, coercion, waste, inflation, and confusion, especially around the topic of finances and the economy, as Neptune is also lord of the second house. Neptune’s involvement blurs clarity, pointing to illusory wealth, deficits, or financial scandals. This energy can result in systemic decay or a drain on resources, which, in economic terms, can lead to inflation, a weakening U.S. dollar, or both. This could create the illusion of assets rallying to new all-time highs, accompanied by a false sense of hope (Sun in the eleventh house) that masks deeper structural decay while spurring speculation in high-risk assets.

  1689→The square from the Sun is indicative of friction and conflict between the aims of the president and those of the Federal Reserve Board (Neptune) and members of Congress (Saturn). Symbolically, there will likely be a political struggle rooted in the financial markets or monetary policy, and an erosion of trust and confidence in financial governance. On the public level, there may be frustration with Congress and legislators (the eleventh house) or with the president (Sun in the eleventh), who is unable to act effectively due to financial constraints (Saturn–Neptune in the second). The Ascendant in Aquarius suggests an undertone of reform, radical shifts, perhaps even upheaval, with an emphasis on doing things differently and breaking from established traditions. With Aquarius rising, the United States may appear contrarian, isolated, or disruptive in world affairs, driven by a strong focus on and investment in technology. The co-rulers of Aquarius are Saturn and Uranus. With Saturn on the cusp of the second house and conjunct Neptune, we have already noted that the key issues will center on the economy and the management of the nation’s resources and treasury. The Saturn–Neptune conjunction could also indicate the materialization of dreams related to technological goals that the president is pursuing to give the nation a leading advantage. Yet the position of Uranus is equally important, as it lies within orb of the fourth-house cusp, also known as the Imum Coeli (IC). Uranus on the IC adds a destabilizing undertone to the domestic foundation—upheaval in the homeland, volatility in housing, land, or infrastructure, and a restless public demanding change. The Moon, another indicator of the public mood, is poorly positioned in Capricorn (the sign of its detriment) and in the twelfth house. This further indicates public dissatisfaction, isolation, and a sense of powerlessness. The Moon, opposed by an exalted Jupiter in the sixth house, suggests the public’s dissatisfaction with a powerful institution that is supposed to be serving them. The nation may grow increasingly unsettled, driven by several factors. Uranus is at 28° Taurus and the IC at 1° Gemini, suggesting these events will take place later in the quarter. Therefore, the disruptive factors, while not an exhaustive list, may include the financial markets, natural disasters, farming or food supply, trade, or cyberattacks. With Uranus in the final degrees of the third house of trade and Mercury (the planet of trade) prominently placed in the tenth house—but in its detriment in Sagittarius—issues concerning trade deals are likely to remain prominent. In astrometeorology, Uranus is associated with high-pressure systems that bring cold air from the upper atmosphere or the Arctic Circle. Its location on the IC suggests strong and unusually cold winds hitting the East Coast from the north. The region is likely to experience below-normal precipitation and perhaps an Arctic outbreak bringing extreme cold, dry air, and biting winds. It is worth noting that the Saturn–Neptune conjunction brings together two slow-moving, low-pressure planets. The conjunction of these two planets may result in extreme weather patterns related to precipitation, with moisture concentrated in certain areas prone to flooding, while other regions experience drought. On the geopolitical stage, Aquarius rising gives the United States a disruptive, contrarian stance—more likely to break with allies, redraw alliances, or pursue unorthodox strategies. Fiscal strain (Saturn–Neptune in the second) could weaken America’s leverage in international finance, while internal instability may reduce its ability to project power abroad. Uranus on the IC also raises the risk of natural disasters or environmental shocks—earthquakes, severe storms, or infrastructure
  1690→

  1693→breakdowns—events that could not only destabilize the homeland but also reverberate through global markets and alliances. Looking at the astrocartography map, we see regions of the world where the Sun on the angles is brought to the foreground. The winter Sun (flanked by Venus and Mars) will be on the Midheaven (MC) over Greenland and Brazil, and on the IC of Japan, the Korean Peninsula, and Australia as the Capricorn ingress takes place. The ascendant will be over the U.S. West Coast and extend into central Canada, while the descendant will be over Western Europe, northeastern Africa, and the Red Sea. The most important outer planetary configuration will be the Saturn–Neptune conjunction, which is on the MC over the Middle East, the Red Sea, and Russia (Moscow). It is worth noting that the Sun and Mars will also be on the descendant over the Red Sea and Yemen. At the time of the winter ingress, transiting Saturn is at 25° Pisces and transiting Neptune at 28° Pisces. It is worth noting that 25° Pisces is a sensitive degree for both Ukraine and Russia, as each nation has its natal Chiron at 25°–26° Pisces at important junctures in its history. For Russia, Chiron was at this degree during the storming of the Winter Palace on November 7, 1917. Ukraine proclaimed its independence from both Bolshevik Russia and German influence several months later, on January 22, 1918, with Chiron at 26° Pisces. Ukraine again proclaimed its independence from the USSR on August 24, 1991, and in this chart Mars is in opposition at 25° Virgo. Chiron relates to the collective wound—an identity trauma, humiliation, loss, or an area where the nation feels perpetually vulnerable. Saturn represents authority, control, restriction, and karmic lessons. Therefore, the transit of Saturn over a nation’s natal Chiron is likely to force the nation to confront old wounds of historical trauma, humiliation, or unresolved identity crises. Saturn’s restrictive pressure can manifest as international isolation, sanctions, or blockages that remind the nation of painful vulnerabilities. The people may face austerity, shortages, harsh authority, or structural limitations. In opposition to Ukraine’s natal Mars, this transit reinforces aggressive military conflict, set backs, and logistical exhaustion. Ukraine may experience frustrated aggression, with its armed forces bogged down. Of course, we will not see the same explosive manifestation every 30 years as Saturn transits Pisces; what makes this transit distinctive is its conjunction with Neptune, which adds a cloud of confusion, idealism, propaganda, deception, disorganization, and disillusionment to the mix. The Saturn–Neptune conjunction will be exact at 0° Aries 45′ on February 20, 2026. Zero degrees Aries is the most sensitive point in the entire zodiac when it comes to global affairs. Events tied to this degree are more likely to resonate on the collective stage, affecting nations, leaders, and international relations. Transits to this point are frequently associated with geopolitical turning points, wars, and the emergence of new world orders. Looking at the natal charts of world leaders, the most powerful activation related to the Sat urn–Neptune conjunction appears to be that of Shigeru Ishiba, the prime minister of Japan. He has his natal Moon at 1° Aries, in opposition to his natal Jupiter at 1° Libra. This heavy conjunction on his natal Moon represents a personal and political burden of collective sacrifice, as he embodies the weight of a dissolving or restructuring moment in Japan. This signature suggests pressure from public discontent, uncertainty, or disillusionment regarding leadership. At the time of writing this report (September 2025), it comes as no surprise to find that Ishiba has just handed in his resignation due to public disapproval stemming from lingering scandals, distrust, and economic strain resulting from inflation, which is likely to worsen following the U.S.–Japan tariff agreement. He resigned days

While the Saturn–Neptune conjunction will affect the entire world, the Aries nations are likely to find themselves on the front pages during this period.

  1699→## SPECIFIC PERIODS HIGHLIGHTED IN THE WINTER
  1700→
  1701→The most important geocosmic event of the winter will be the triple conjunction of the Sun, Venus, and Mars, taking place in close proximity from January 6 to 9. On January 18, Mercury and the Moon will also join the stellium in the final degrees of Capricorn and early Aquarius. Venus is the planet of diplomacy, peace, values, treaties, and the arts. Opposing these energies, Mars is the planet of war, aggression, conflict, assertion, and action. Their conjunction often signifies an alliance formed under pressure or the eruption of social passions that have reached a boiling point. It initiates a synodic cycle in which collective desires (Venus) and drive (Mars) interact. The previous two occurrences of this synodic cycle were strongly marked by the Russia–Ukraine war. The Russian invasion took place on February 24, 2022, just days after the Venus–Mars conjunction of February 16, 2022, in the sign of Capricorn (Russia is considered a Capricorn nation). Capricorn emphasizes systems, governments, structure, and authority. Mars thrives under the discipline of Capricorn and is exalted in this sign; as such, a powerful Mars tends to overwhelm Venus here. The Venus–Mars conjunction in Capricorn is therefore suggestive of conflict over state power, military structures, and global order. The next Venus–Mars conjunction took place on February 22, 2024, in early Aquarius, within orb of Pluto. This period was marked by an intensification of the Russian offensive following the
  1702→
  1703→<!-- PAGE 192 END -->
  1704→
  1705→loss of Avdiivka, which was seen as a major gain for Russia. Aquarius rules collective ideals, revolutions, technology, and social movements. The Venus–Mars conjunction in Aquarius coincided with new forms of alliance, ideological clashes, and technology-driven conflicts such as cyberwarfare, AI geopolitics, and digital currencies. In February 2024, the war in Ukraine remained central but was increasingly framed in terms of international coalitions, sanctions, and drone or tech warfare. As we head into 2026, the prospect of peace seems increasingly remote. Another Venus–Mars conjunction will occur in a similar sector of the zodiac, leading us to believe that we will either see an intensification of the war or a reversal signature leading to peace. Under the shadow of the Saturn– Neptune conjunction over the world axis, my bias is toward the former. Therefore, we are likely to see a further escalation of warfare in Ukraine during this period. This is supported by the symbolism of the Sun, Venus, and Mars forming a conjunction with the explosive and purging energy of Pluto from January 19 to 27. On February 3, Uranus will station direct at 27° Taurus, near the malefic fixed star Algol, marking a potent turning point in global affairs. Uranus stations signal sudden shifts and awakenings, and Taurus governs material security, resources, and societal stability. With Algol’s influence, the potential for shocking, disruptive, or violent events is amplified—literal or symbolic “decapitations” of leadership, institutions, or systems are possible. Historical patterns at this degree underscore themes of sudden escalations in war and conflict, revolutionary uprisings, and abrupt shifts in power (e.g., the intensification of World War II in 1940– 42 and the Indian Rebellion of 1857). Even technological and social domains may be affected, as Uranus tends to bring unforeseen breakthroughs or disruptions. By February 5, Saturn will reach an exact opposition to the September 21, 2025, eclipse degree of 29° Virgo 05′. This eclipse stands out, as it formed within a one-degree orb of 0° Libra, which is one of the “World Points,” (0° of Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn). These points are pivotal in mundane astrology because they lie on the cardinal cross, marking the turning points of the sea sons and symbolizing new cycles of collective action. When eclipses or major transits activate these points, events tend to spill into the public sphere, influencing nations, governments, and global sen timent. They act as portals between private and collective experience, where individual or national developments gain worldwide visibility and impact. The eclipse potential tends to be triggered or released as the malefic planets (Mars or Saturn) transit this degree or form a hard aspect to it. Mars will form the first hard aspect on December 14, 2025, shortly before its ingress into Capricorn. However, as this is a square aspect, we would expect the Saturn opposition to have greater impact. Note that Saturn’s orbit is much slower, and that an orb of 2° can be applied. In practice, activations of the Aries “World Point” often coincide with political realignments, leadership changes, social movements, and historical turning points—moments when the energy of renewal and initiation (Aries) manifests tangibly in world affairs. One of the most important aspects of the year occurs on February 20, as the single passage of the Saturn–Neptune conjunction takes place. Refer to the earlier chapter on this aspect for a detailed analysis.

  1729→The spring (vernal) equinox for Washington, D.C., occurs on March 20, 2026, at 10:45 AM EDT. Once again, the Sun (symbolizing the leader of the nation) is in the eleventh house of allies and friends, only this time it is head-to-head with the theme of the Saturn–Neptune conjunction. In fact, there is a stellium of planets in Aries, as the ingress occurs within orb of a New Moon, further emphasizing the theme of new beginnings.   1730→

Taken together, these factors point to an ambitious but risky push by President Trump, involving executive actions that define the nation’s image. On the positive side, this could relate to technological investments in AI initiated by the White House; on the negative side, it could manifest as involvement in geopolitical conflict.   1737→Figure 20: Astrocartography map from Solar Fire The Winter 2025 Ingress Chart signaled financial issues related to trade, deficits, inflation, and structural weakness, as well as a president embroiled in internal conflict. These same themes are clearly spilling into the spring 2026 ingress chart as the Saturn–Neptune conjunction joins the Sun in Aries in the eleventh house. President Trump is thrust into congressional battles and tensions with the Federal Reserve on the domestic front, and into confrontation with traditional allies on the interna tional front, as he asserts dominance despite institutional weakness and financial decay eating away at the foundation. By the time of this ingress, Trump is entering his second year in office. Historically, this is the period when presidents face their steepest challenges—marked by waning political capital, increased pushback from Congress, and midterm primaries heating up. It is also the period most often accompanied by external crises testing foreign policy (about 80% of major U.S. foreign conflicts have historically begun within the first two years of a presidential term). The Sun is exalted in Aries, suggesting that Trump will be highly active, energized, and intent on asserting dominance in both domestic and foreign arenas. Yet the conjunction with Saturn (lord of the eighth, ninth, and tenth houses), in its fall, and Neptune (lord of the eleventh), suggests legislative struggles, loss of credibility, backroom dealings, erosion of alliances, and deception. The exalted Sun indicates that Trump will push his policies through regardless, but at the cost of destabilizing (Neptune) institutions (Saturn). The eleventh house could also point to alliances that Trump has developed with leaders in the tech world—ranging from Elon Musk, Peter Thiel, Sam Altman, and Jensen Huang to Mark Zucker berg—or to new alliances on the global stage with the heads of the Gulf States, such as Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani (Qatar), Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (Saudi Arabia), and President Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan (U.A.E.). It may even point to issues within the Republican Party. With the Moon in Aries, the public mood will be impatient, impulsive, frustrated, confrontational, and outspoken. The Moon is trapped between Venus and Chiron. Being within orb of a conjunction with Venus is usually favorable; however, in Aries, Venus is weak and in its detriment. As a result, there will be weak social cohesion, polarization, more aggressive values, and an inward-looking,
  1738→

Taken together, this indicates a wave of public discontent or protest, injury to national morale, and strained foreign relations. Therefore, the spring 2026 ingress chart indicates a volatile quarter in Trump’s second year. The exalted Sun empowers him to act boldly and visibly, but weakened Saturn, Mercury, and Venus suggest that his initiatives will be marred by institutional decay, miscommunication, and diplomatic friction. The public is restless, Congress is fractured, and alliances are strained by financial demands and hidden entanglements. In the markets, illusions may give way to strain: debt, deficits, and currency instability feature prominently in the U.S. economy, with trade disputes flaring. Geopolitically, covert or sudden shocks to U.S. leadership are possible (Uranus in the twelfth house), while foreign entanglements (military or ideological) risk escalation. This is a quarter of bold moves but dangerous overreach—when appearances of strength mask underlying fragility, and sudden disruptions (whether political, financial, or natural) could redefine the trajectory of Trump’s presidency and America’s global role. The American public (Moon) forms a T-square to this aspect, reflecting tension between the public mood and the president. People may feel misrepresented or manipulated, sensing a disconnect between spectacle and reality. This placement could also signal public pushback on issues related to youth (Moon in the fifth house), education, or health care (Moon in Virgo). Just above the horizon, Mars is applying to a conjunction with Uranus in the final degrees of the twelfth house and within orb of the ascendant. This is a troubling signature, suggestive of hidden enemies, sudden crises, disruptive attacks, sabotage, or cyberwarfare. Mars, as lord of the twelfth house, is indicative of hidden enemies and clandestine activities intended to cause mischief. Uranus, as lord of the tenth house, points to sudden shocks to the leadership or the president. This configuration could manifest as an assassination attempt, terrorist incident, health scare, military miscalcula tion, or intelligence crisis. It symbolizes a destabilizing shock undermining the national leader late in the summer of 2026. The Mars–Uranus conjunction is at 3° Gemini, which is within orb of a conjunction to the natal Moon (6° Gemini) of Ukraine (1918 chart), so this event may have repercussions for the Ukrainian people. With regard to global leaders, this conjunction is also within orb of a conjunction to the natal Moon of Vladimir Putin (2° Gemini) and the natal Mars of Ursula von der Leyen (president of the European Commission). It is also within orb of a hard aspect to planets in the natal charts of several European leaders, including Macron, Meloni, Starmer, Sánchez, and Duda. The Moon in Putin’s chart symbolizes the people, the homeland, emotional instincts, and public mood. With the Mars–Uranus conjunction on his natal Moon, we could see sudden unrest or volatility among the Russian people—possibly protests, strikes, or a rapid change in public sentiment. There is also the potential for an emotional or instinctive overreaction by Putin, leading to impulsive deci sions. The Moon also rules personal security and health, so it could signal instability in his personal life or well-being. For Ursula von der Leyen, this signature may activate her fighting spirit, prompting a sudden assertion of leadership or radical, unexpected decisions in defense or military policy. This could manifest as EU military coordination, sanctions, or swift, bold action, possibly in response to Russia or external shocks. In astrometeorology, Uranus and other high-pressure planets are suggestive of dry climates. The Mars conjunction will bring the extreme heat conducive to drought during an abnormally hot summer.

  1779→The summer solstice ingress paints a quarter of patriotic spectacle, media saturation, and eco nomic promises—centered on America250 and dominated by President Trump, who ties leadership to prosperity and national pride. But beneath the fanfare, Congress and alliances remain unstable, finances are fragile, and the public senses disillusionment. The most dangerous signature is the Mars– Uranus conjunction in the twelfth house near the ascendant, which could manifest as sudden disruption from hidden enemies, intelligence leaks, or foreign sabotage, threatening the leadership’s image. It could also signal a natural disaster disrupting the summer’s patriotic mood. The ingress chart spells trouble for the markets, as it shows Venus (markets) separating from an opposition to Pluto (disruptions). In the summer of 2026, there are two important geocosmic signatures pertaining to the markets: Jupiter will oppose Pluto (July 20), shortly after its ingress into Leo, and the North Node will enter Aquarius (August 18). Historically, the U.S. equity markets tend to experience a long-term correction when Jupiter is in Leo and the North Node transits Aquarius or Capricorn. While both signatures will remain in place through 2027, their activations occur in the summer, ushered in by the Pluto opposition. It is worth noting that the dot-com bubble burst in the year 2000 as Jupiter in Gemini (technology, communication, and the internet) formed an opposition to Pluto in Sagittarius (the World Wide Web). This time, Pluto is in Aquarius, a sign closely associated with advanced technology. Is there a bubble forming in artificial (Uranus) intelligence (Gemini)? The transit of Uranus through Gemini supports this outlook, as a boom–bust cycle is expected in this field. With the Jupiter opposition to Pluto, tension arises between expansion, optimism, and growth (Jupiter) and power, control, sudden change, and hidden forces (Pluto). Historically, this aspect correlates with financial excesses, speculative bubbles, ideological clashes, and the exposure of corruption, as well as struggles between elites and broader society. In the markets, it often brings turbulence, extreme swings, and episodes of overreach followed by correction. Overall, this signature implies increased volatility and dramatic societal or economic shifts. The Jupiter–Pluto opposition (on July 20 at 4° Leo–Aquarius) will come to the forefront as it is translated by the Sun–Moon opposition (Full Moon) of July 29 +/− 3 days. Between July and November, we are going to see a number of important signatures take place in the fire sign of Leo. On August 12, a Solar Eclipse will form at 20° Leo. On October 3, Mars will oppose Pluto from 3° Leo, and on November 3, Mars will trigger and reactivate the eclipse degree of 20° Leo. These Leo signatures are likely to activate the natal charts of the following world leaders and bring them—and, by extension, their countries—into the spotlight: Xi Jinping (China), Vladimir Putin (Russia), V olodymyr Zelensky (Ukraine), Donald Trump (United States), and Mohammed bin
  1780→

  1785→## SPECIFIC PERIODS HIGHLIGHTED IN THE SUMMER
  1786→
  1787→Summer starts out with the Sun square Neptune, June 21–25. The Cancer ingress will bring a sudden shift in the global mood, accompanied by confusion and disorientation. It will be quickly
  1788→

With Jupiter in Leo, the public mood may lift as we approach the America250 celebrations, which will dominate the media. July 4–7 will be an intense period, marked by powerful geocosmic signatures: Mars conjunct Uranus, followed closely by Mars trine Pluto and Neptune turning retrograde. Mars forming aspects to Uranus and Pluto are aggressive, explosive signatures that can be unsettling. This period may be dominated by shock and sudden events, and the markets will be susceptible to sudden reversals. We then enter a period dominated by outer planetary aspects going exact back-to-back from July 15 to 29. It will start with the Uranus–Neptune sextile, followed by the Uranus–Pluto trine, Jupiter–Pluto opposition, Jupiter–Neptune trine, Jupiter–Uranus sextile, and finally the Neptune–Pluto sextile. Toward the end of this two-week period, Mercury stations direct on July 23, and there is a powerful Full Moon that could act as a trigger for all these aspects on July 29. After February’s Saturn–Neptune conjunction, this is likely to be the next most significant period of the year. We would expect to see major reversals in the financial markets and significant decisions made regarding global affairs during this time. We will then move toward a Solar Eclipse on August 12. Since eclipses mark important beginnings and endings, it is possible that this marks a key date for the expression of the outer planetary activity from the final two weeks of July and may, in fact, have a wide two-week orb—from the Full Moon of July 29 until the Lunar Eclipse of August 28. The Solar Eclipse takes place at 20° Leo, with a path extending from Western Europe to North America. It is no surprise that the sign of Leo is prominent in the natal charts of many global leaders. Leo is on the ascendant in President Trump’s chart and on the Midheaven of Putin’s chart; President Xi Jinping’s natal Moon is in Leo; Zelensky’s IC and natal Moon are in Leo; and Taiwan’s Lai Ching-te has his natal Uranus at 19° Leo. The eclipse degree will be triggered by transiting Mars on November 3, 2026, which could mark the release of this eclipse’s energy. Nations likely to be impacted by this eclipse include France, India, Pakistan, and Bahrain. By August 18, the North Node enters Aquarius and will spend 18 months transiting this sign. It is worth noting that this is the signature that Louise McWhirter identified as the basis of her theory: “The major or primary trend of business volume and finance is clearly pointed out by the nineteenyear cycle of the North Node as it passes through the twelve signs of the zodiac… When the North Node enters Aquarius, the low point of business activity has been reached.” (McWhirter, 2008, p. 5) Given that transiting Jupiter is also in Leo for approximately 12 months from June 2026, we have two signals suggesting that the stock markets are likely to bottom during this period. We enter a tense period, susceptible to major shocks and disruptions, August 28–September 1. This window incorporates the Lunar Eclipse, Sun square Uranus, Mars square Saturn, and the first of three exact Jupiter–Saturn trines. The Jupiter–Saturn trine is important to the markets, as this signa ture has a high correlation with troughs in the world reserve currency that underpins all markets—the U.S. Dollar. The trines will be exact on August 31, 2026; April 3, 2027; and July 11, 2027. We expect the trough in the U.S. Dollar to form roughly in the middle, around December 2026 +/− 1.5 months. The last time we had this signature was in May 2008, when the U.S. Dollar formed a trough in March 2008. A loss of confidence in the U.S. Dollar is usually accompanied by panic in the financial mar kets. Therefore, this is the third important signature pointing toward trouble as we enter late 2026. The Sun–Uranus and Mars–Saturn squares are disruptive signatures that suggest a period of high tension. We may see public protests or aggressive acts. Be on the lookout for abrupt headlines, military flashpoints, market volatility, or natural disasters and extreme weather patterns. This period is
  1792→

Aries rising also places the people and leadership at the forefront. This is an active ingress, so events are likely to erupt rather than unfold gradually.   1832→
  1833→In general, we tend to see a seasonal correction in financial markets following the autumn ingress. An important double retrograde is taking place, involving Venus and Mercury in the sign of Scorpio, which we analyzed in depth in the retrograde section of this book. The first period that could result in a sudden reversal in the markets is therefore October 2–4, as Venus begins its retrograde, Mars forms an opposition to Pluto, and the Sun opposes Saturn. These signatures are aggressive and suggest a shock or sudden event disrupting the markets. Pluto, the ruler of Scorpio, is active throughout October and November. Pluto stations direct on October 15, and Venus goes on to form a square to Pluto as Mercury turns retrograde in Scorpio on October 24. This is a month traditionally associated with Halloween, and market psychology will be on edge and prone to fear. This unease may spill over into geopolitics, as many important acts of aggression have taken place during transits of Scorpio. November 3 (+/− one week) is an important date, as Mars transits 20° Leo, the same degree activated by the August 12 eclipse. Mars tends to act as a trigger, releasing stored eclipse energy. Western Europe is a potential focal point for significant events. Since the subsolar point lies over Iceland, this raises concern about volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, or tsunamis in the Arctic Ocean—or acts of aggression involving Greenland. This signature coincides with the midterm elections (November 3) and could correlate with acts of forced assertion, as Mars in Leo is suggestive of ego-driven arrogance. Alternatively, it could indicate a war signature—used as a distraction or a unifying force.

The right-hand page is a day-by-day calendar, showing the times that each aspect and planetary ingress takes place. The times in the calendar have been adjusted for the EST (Eastern Standard Time) zone. It is not adjusted for daylight savings time. ## 我的提取颗粒度建议

文档实际包含的预测可分为 **5 种类型**，对应不同的可验证性，建议按下表组织：

| 类型 | 说明 | 例子 | 可验证度 |
|------|------|------|---------|
| **A. 价位+时间双锁定** | 明确价位区间+时间窗口 | "DJIA 18年周期顶 49,400-57,750，特别关注 51,609-52,342 区域" | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **B. 时间窗口+方向** | 明确日期窗口+涨跌方向 | "USD/JPY 一季度回测 164±2 区间，全年冲 175-177" | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **C. CRD 关键反转日** | 仅日期窗口（±交易日） | "DJIA: 1/16-19, 2/27-3/1, 3/20-23..." | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| **D. 占星事件→市场反应** | 行星相位+预期市场反应 | "Feb 20 土海合相 → 长周期顶部 8 个月内" | ⭐⭐⭐ |
| **E. 地缘/领导人** | 国家、政治人物事件 | "Mars-Uranus 7/4-7 触发 Putin 本命月亮" | ⭐⭐ |

## 建议输出结构（单文件）

```
forecast_2026_predictions.md
├── 第一部分：核心预测速览表（A+B 类，可直接表格化对账）
│   每行：标的 | 时间窗口 | 预测内容 | 价位/方向 | 类型 | 状态
│
├── 第二部分：CRD 关键反转日总表（C 类）
│   按月份排列，跨标的合并：日期窗口 | 适用标的 | 触发占星事件
│
├── 第三部分：占星事件总表（D 类，ML 因子核心）
│   日期 | 占星事件名称 | 行星组合 | 历史平均影响 | 本次预期反应
│
├── 第四部分：分标的详细预测（按文档原顺序：DJIA / NASDAQ / Gold / Silver / T-Notes / DXY / USD-JPY / EUR / CHF / Bitcoin / Crude Oil / Grains）
│   每个标的下分：周期分析 / 价位预测 / 时间窗口 / 占星支撑 / 核心 Bias
│   每条预测：原文英文 + 中文翻译 + 简要分析
│
├── 第五部分：季节性窗口预测（Winter/Spring/Summer/Autumn 四季）
│   每季：核心占星事件清单 + 季度 CRD + 关键期间预测
│
└── 第六部分：地缘/领导人预测（E 类，单独归档）
```

## 几个关键决策需要你确认

1. **要不要 Type E（地缘/领导人预测）**？
   这部分跟金融市场没直接关系（如"Macron 面临挑战"、"Putin 本命月亮被触发"），但反映 MMA 的整体世界观。建议**保留但单独归类**，方便后续验证占星派系的整体准确率。

2. **价位区间是否拆分**？
   例如 DJIA 提到 "49,400-57,750"（整体范围）+ "特别关注 51,609-52,342"（窄区间），是写成一条还是拆成两条预测？建议**写成一条但保留两个字段**（宽区间/窄区间），便于后续打分时分级（命中窄区间 = 满分，仅命中宽区间 = 部分得分）。

3. **不生成单独文件**：建议**不要拆多文件**，单一 MD 文档+清晰目录锚点即可（方便 ML 解析、grep）。

4. **占星术语处理**：

   - 第一次出现时附中文解释（如"合相 conjunction = 同度数"），后文统一用术语
   - 关键宫位数字（11th house）保留+中文（"第十一宫（朋友/联盟）"）

However, several signs point to a struggle ahead as various economic data indicate the U.S. economy is starting to show signs of slowing down. Employment numbers are decreasing, while inflation remains stubbornly above the Fed’s targeted 2% level.    457→## THE LUNAR NODAL CYCLE AND THE ECONOMY BY SIGNS
   458→
   459→The outlook on the economy is based primarily on my research replicating the studies of the 18.6year Lunar Nodal cycle, first introduced by Louise McWhirter in her classic work titled McWhirter’ s Theory of Stock Market Forecasting (American Federation of Astrologers, 1938, Tempe, Arizona). In her research on the business cycle prior to 1938, she found that the U.S. economy often bottoms when the Moon’s North Node transits through Aquarius and peaks in the sign of Leo. This model worked quite well during her research period in the late 1930s. That is, the peak of the business cycle had a very strong correlation with the North Node in Leo, and a bottom frequently occurred when the Moon’s North Node was in Aquarius. Many financial astrologers still refer to this model, but there have been far fewer recessions since 1938 than there were before then. The date range for cycle lows and highs in the economy has expanded since McWhirter’s work in 1938. In my formal study of the 14 recessions in the U.S. since McWhirter’s book was published, the findings differ slightly from McWhirter’s original work. Instead of an economic low occurring near the middle of Aquarius, these new studies show that a recession is more likely to unfold within a 45° orb of 0° Capricorn, or 15° Aquarius through 15° Scorpio, as shown in the diagram below.
   460→

In the study of this nodal correlation with economic recessions since 1938, it was determined that “… a recession occurred in all five instances of the Moon’ s North Node’ s transit between 15° Aquarius and 15° Scorpio.” When you consider that over 40% of recessions since 1938 happened within only 25% of the signs, and that in all five cases of the Lunar Nodes being between 15° Aquarius and 15° Scorpio since then did indeed correspond to a recession, that seems noteworthy. Yet there were other interesting findings in this study. In seven of the 14 recessions since 1938, the Lunar North Node transited between 16° Pisces and 1° Scorpio. That is, half of the cases occurred when the Lunar North Node was in a 135° sector of the 360° zodiac. Also, six recessions occurred between 16° Pisces and 25° Scorpio, which covers an arc of only 111°. Thus, this may be considered the “hot zone” for a recession, which is now in effect from October 2025 through August 2031. The “hottest” of the “hot zone” could also be considered when the Lunar North Node is posited between 1° Pisces and 1° Sagittarius. Five of the recessions have overlapped during this sector of the signs, which projects out to June 2026–March 2031 in current time.

The Saturn–Neptune conjunction, for instance, has correlated with major recessions in the U.S. either during or shortly after (within one year) their conjunction. This 36-year cycle is again underway from the summer of 2025 through February 2026. If history repeats itself, we could expect a recession to unfold sometime between 2026 and the end of 2027. It is also quite possible there will be more than one recession during this hot zone period (July 2026–March 2031), as this time band will coincide with the balsamic phase of the Saturn–Uranus cycle. The balsamic phase of a planetary cycle covers the last 45° (waning semi-square) and is associated with a time when the dynamics of the cycle are usually in conflict. It is a time when the col lective realizes something is coming to an end. Matters of importance just aren’t working anymore, and something new has to begin. It’s a Pluto-like period, even though Pluto is not involved in the Saturn–Uranus balsamic period. But, as shown in the prior chapter, transiting Pluto at 3°–7° Aquarius is intensely involved with the Sun–Moon opposite Uranus in the Chart of Mankind (3°–7° of the fixed signs Taurus–Scorpio). Historically, the balsamic phase of the Saturn–Uranus cycle has relevance to the world and national economy, as multiple recessions often happen in this relatively short period, especially when near the onset of the waning semi-square. Saturn and Uranus will be in their last 45° waning semisquare phase from April 12, 2027, through January 12, 2028, though the entire balsamic period will last until summer 2032, when the two planets conjoin each other. The economy tends to struggle slightly before and during the semi-square time, but usually recovers smartly by the arrival of the conjunction, which will take place on June 28, 2032. As described in last year’s book, “… the last two times these two planets were in their waning semi-square aspect to one another were 1981-1982 and 1937. These were painful secondary reces sions to the even more serious recession depths of 1974 and 1932, respectively. The economy struggled during these periods but then recovered sharply going into—or coming out of—the conjunction.    491→## TRANSITS TO ITS FOUNDING CHART
   492→
   493→The Federal Reserve Act was signed into law by President Woodrow Wilson. The New York Times edition of December 24, 1913, reported that the Federal Reserve was created on December 23, 1913, at 6:02 PM, in Washington, D.C. According to its own website, www.federalreserve.gov, “It was created by Congress to provide the nation with a safer, more flexible, and more stable monetary and financial system.” Basically, it does this by managing two mandates: inflation and unemploy ment. Its job is to keep both low, and by doing so, the economy supposedly functions well. Those two functions are currently in conflict with one another. The labor market has not been growing as robustly in 2025 as it was in 2024. Part of the problem was that the Bureau of Labor Statistics underreported by more than 900,000 the number of jobs that were added in 2024 and 2025 than previously stated. The economy and labor market were not nearly as strong as thought, and subsequent reports supported that view. Hence, the Fed believed it was more important to stimulate the economy by starting a new round of lowering its benchmark Fed funds rate in the last quarter of 2025. This meant it was willing to risk that inflation would increase, even though
   494→

   496→
   497→it never fell to its preferred target of 2%. As rates fell, inflation began to creep up to 3% as this is being written. The Fed is now stuck—perhaps confused is a better word—as to what course of action to take. Does it continue to provide stimulus to a slowing economy with lower rates, as President Trump wishes? Or does it resume its fight to control inflation by raising rates? Or do nothing and see what happens? The transit of Saturn in hard aspect to natal points in the Fed chart indicates times of tighten ing or raising rates. Jupiter transits show when the Fed is in a more accommodative mood to lower rates and stimulate the economy. Neptune also leans toward lower rates but is often associated with poor judgment, uncertainty, or an unwillingness to take any action, one way or the other, regarding rate adjustments. The Aries V ortex finds both Saturn and Neptune conjoining on the Midheaven (MC) of the Fed chart and making a T-square to its Sun–Pluto opposition, while Jupiter transits back and forth over its Mars and Ascendant in opposition to its own Jupiter. This perfectly describes the Fed’s dilemma as we enter 2026. Jupiter wants to lower rates, Saturn wants to fight inflation, and Neptune isn’t sure what to do, for focusing on one part of its dual mandate means putting the other part at risk. In the meantime, the power struggle with the Executive Office continues to mount, with Saturn (authority and control) in hard aspect to Pluto (power). Transiting Jupiter will continue crisscrossing the Fed’s Ascendant and Mars, and opposing its Jupiter, through May 2026. That is when Jerome Powell’s tenure as Fed Chair ends. However, his term as a Fed governor continues until January 31, 2028. Will Trump terminate his role as Fed governor then as well? The Federal Reserve Act allows the president to remove members of the board only “for cause.” In June 2026, Jupiter (exaggeration and overacting) will conjoin the Fed’s natal Neptune, the planet of uncertainty and confusion. There is likely to be a lot of confusion after his term ends as Fed Chair. It should get very interesting as we approach that period in 2026. The drama doesn’t end, however, as 2026 finds transiting Pluto (coercion and force) conjoining the Fed’s natal Uranus (independence). This aspect comes within minutes of an exact conjunction in April–June 2026, before hitting its exact point with three conjunctions between February and December 2027. If the Fed is going to lose its independence, this might be the time. In fact, since an 18-year stock market cycle trough is due then—during which the DJIA could lose 35–65% from its all-time high—and the U.S. economy is in the Lunar Nodal cycle for a deep recession, the threat (or reality) of loss to the Fed’s independence could be the cause of a financial panic around that time. With Pluto, reforms and resolutions to conflicts are seldom easy. Yet reform and resolution to long-standing problems are the explanations offered for why the government has to take such draconian actions. With Pluto, change usually comes with a considerable amount of pain to the masses. In the meantime, Jupiter (accommodation) is in harmonious aspect to Mercury and Venus in the Fed’s chart in September 2026, so there may be another rate cut around that time. Saturn will also trine Mercury from June 2026 through March 2027, so there may be some stability then. However, it won’t dominate the powerful Pluto transit in conjunction with Uranus in the Fed’s chart, underlining the effort to possibly end the Fed’s independence.
