  1434→
  1435→## GRAIN MARKETS IN 2026
  1436→
  1437→by Wyatt Fellows, MMA Analyst
  1438→
  1439→## REVIEW
  1440→
  1441→Last year’s Forecast 2025 book left off with: “The bottom line here is that with ample grain stocks heading into 2025, and the unknown outcomes of the next administration’ s policies toward energy and trade, it will probably take a supply reduction event to significantly push grain prices higher in 2025. Just such an event is possible with the coming Saturn–Neptune conjunction, but its effect on the grain markets may not fully be felt until into 2026.” We did not get a major supply-reducing weather event last year, and President Trump decided to play another game of chicken with China on trade. This kept the grain markets largely range-bound but with a more downward bias in Corn and Wheat. On a positive note, all three major grains retested their August 2024 lows to some degree in 2025 and held. This is encouraging price action, and as we close out 2025, definite signs of life are emerging that could lead to some nice returns for this com plex after years of underperformance relative to other commodities and asset classes.
  1442→
  1443→## WEATHER
  1444→
  1445→The main event for the grain markets in 2026 is the conjunction of Saturn (restriction) and Neptune (water) taking place in the sign of Aries (fire) on February 20, 2026. In the past, significant highs in the grain markets occurred at the conjunctions and oppositions of these two outer planets, and mostly within 15 months of the exact aspect. These highs were usually a result of a significant drought taking place over a major grain-producing region of the world, which is a hallmark of Saturn in Aries (wildfires, eruptions, droughts). For Wheat, these areas would be China, India, and Russia. For Corn, it would be the United States, China, and Brazil. And for Soybeans, Brazil, the United States, and Argentina. Any widespread hot and dry conditions or lack of adequate rainfall in these parts of the world has the potential to light a fire (pun intended) under Corn, Soybeans, and/or Wheat this coming year. Aiding in the potential for a significant drought to develop somewhere in the world during 2026 and into 2027 is the fact that three outer planets (Jupiter, Saturn, and Neptune) will be in fire signs (Aries and Leo) during much of 2026 before fiery Mars adds to this energy when it enters the sign of Leo on September 27, where it will remain until November 25. To follow this alignment, there will be an even bigger collection of six planets in fire signs during the spring of 2027, when Venus and Mercury will join the party as they transit the sign of Aries during April and May 2027. That is a lot of heated energy potential in the sky at one time. On top of this, we will have the disruptive planet Uranus entering the air sign of Gemini at the end of April. We could see an increase in high winds or destructive storm activity during the 2026 growing season. During 2026, we will want to pay attention when Mars (and sometimes Venus) is making hard aspects with Jupiter, Saturn, and Neptune. As mentioned, these planets will reside in fire signs this year and could usher in changes in weather patterns to become more arid, hot, and dry. We should also pay attention to when Mars forms hard aspects to Uranus (unpredictable) and Pluto (destructive), as severe weather around these times could cause more localized events of crop damage.
  1446→
  1447→<!-- PAGE 166 END -->
  1448→
  1449→At the end of the day, weather and climate are fickle creatures. They are a construct of hundreds of variables, each continuously affecting the other and constantly changing the outcome. There is a reason why local weather forecasters get a bad rap for not being able to accurately predict the weather even seven days out—because it’s difficult. All we can do is look at the past and apply those possi bilities to the future. For 2026 and into 2027, the heavens are pointing to an elevated risk of adverse weather significant enough to affect crop production to a meaningful degree. That does not mean that it is going to happen by any means, but it is prudent that we are aware of the possibility.
  1450→
  1451→<!-- PAGE 167 END -->
  1452→
  1453→## CORN
  1454→
  1455→## REVIEW
  1456→
  1457→Corn peaked for the year at 504.50 in February 2025. This was not shocking, as last year’s Forecast 2025 stated: “I would look for Corn to at least test 475.00 at some point during 2025 with an eventual upside target of 540.00–600.00. A lot will depend on the growing season in North and South America as to how long and how high Corn can rally.” Growing conditions were generally good in North and South America, so after peaking, Corn spent the next six months falling to a low of 368.75 in August 2025. This was 8.25 cents above the August 2024 low of 360.50 and was likely a successful retest of this long-term bottom. Since bottoming, Corn has caught a bid, retracing about 50% of the decline off the February high. Corn Cycles Start/Progress as of 1/1/26 Next Due 18-year April 2020 or August 2016, 6th year or 10th year 2038 +/– 3 yr or 2034 +/– 3 yr 9-year April 2020 or August 2024, 6th year or 2nd year 2029 +/– 2 yr or 2033 +/– 2 yr 4.6-year August 2024, 2nd year (17th month) May 2028–January 2030 33-month August 2024, 17th month November 2026–November 2027
  1458→
  1459→## THE 18-YEAR CYCLE
  1460→
  1461→The longest cycle we measure in Corn is the 18-year cycle. It has a range of 15–21 years and last bottomed in April 2020 at 300.25. This low was 20 years after the previous 18-year cycle low in August 2000, so it was on time. The year 2026 will begin the sixth year of this current 18-year cycle, which is not due to bottom again until 2038 +/– 3 years. The high so far for this current 18-year cycle occurred in April 2022 when Corn reached 827.00. This was a gain of 175% from the start of the cycle. While impressive, it is still a little short of the average trough-to-peak gains of previous 18-year cycles, which are 308% when throwing out obvious outliers. Because we are still relatively early in this 18-year cycle, there is still plenty of time for Corn to mount another substantial rally. In fact, in the last three 18-year cycles, the crest formed beyond the halfway point of the cycle (right translation) in two of them. In the third case, the high occurred in the first half of the cycle, but that high was tested (forming a double top) during the second half. This implies that Corn has a good chance of at least revisiting the all-time high of 827.00 at some point in the future. While we are using 2020 as the starting year for this current 18-year cycle, I think an alternative starting year should be entertained. Since 1912, every 18-year cycle in Corn has bottomed within 0–2 years (usually 0–1) of Wheat’s 18-year cycle. Wheat’s last 18-year cycle bottomed in 2016, so the 2020 low in Corn would have been four years later. This does not fit the historical cycle relationship between these two grains. However, Corn did have a low in August 2016 when it fell to 301.00. This is extremely close to the April 2020 low of 300.25—close enough to be considered a double bottom to the August 2016 low and not the start of this current 18-year cycle. The implication here is that instead of Corn being in the sixth year of its 18-year cycle, 2026 would be the 10th year measured from the August 2016 low. The magnitude of the decline from the 2022 high would argue that this labeling might be a better fit. In fact, as time goes by, this is more and more becoming my preferred bias.
  1462→
  1463→<!-- PAGE 168 END -->
  1464→
  1465→## THE 9-YEAR CYCLE
  1466→
  1467→The 18-year cycle traditionally breaks down into two 9-year cycle phases. The 18-year cycle can also break down into a three-phase pattern of 6-year cycles, but these can be hard to distinguish from the 4.6-year half-cycle to the 9-year cycle. Depending on the correct starting year for the 18-year cycle (this would also be the starting year for the 9-year cycle, as shorter cycles reset when longer cycles culminate), 2026 will either begin the sixth year of the first 9-year cycle phase measured off the April 2020 bottom or the second year of the second 9-year cycle phase measured off the August 2024 bottom. My bias at the moment lies with the latter. If my bias is correct and we are indeed two years into the second and final 9-year cycle phase, then there are historical criteria to watch out for. First, these second 9-year phases rally for only 2–4 years before topping out. This makes 2026 an early candidate for a 9-year cycle crest to form. Second, the percentage gains in this crest have ranged from 119% to 193%. A 119% gain from the 360.50 low would equate to about 790.00. Reaching this price target would satisfy the third cri terion of Corn, at least testing and even exceeding the crest that occurred in the first 9-year cycle phase (827.00 in this case). To be fair, this would be a substantial move if it were to all occur in 2026, so this may be something that we will need to revisit in Forecast 2027. However, the move higher has to start somewhere, so we may see a nice surge in Corn prices this year with the geocosmic and fundamental backdrop in play.
  1468→
  1469→## THE 4.6-YEAR AND 33-MONTH CYCLES
  1470→
  1471→If the 9-year cycle is breaking down in a three-phase pattern, it typically consists of three 33-month cycles. If the 9-year cycle is breaking down into a two-phase pattern, then we usually see two 4.6-year cycles (55 months) form. The orb of this 55-month cycle is a little wide at 14 months, but that is what you get when analyzing a commodity largely dictated by the weather. In the last few instances, the 9-year cycle has been showing a preference for deploying in a two-phase pattern, so we will go with the idea that this is going to continue in the current cycle.
  1472→
  1473→<!-- PAGE 169 END -->
  1474→
  1475→If we assume the 18- and 9-year cycles bottomed in 2016, then the April 2020 low would have occurred 44 months later and in the time band for a 55-month bottom to form. Measuring from the April 2020 low, the August 2024 bottom was 52 months later—again, right on time for a 55-month low, and since it was the second 55-month cycle phase, August 2024 was probably a 9-year low as well. After an initial rally to the 27-month (half the length of the 55-month cycle) moving average, Corn came back to test the 2024 low in August 2025. This is tracing out a similar pattern seen at previous 9-year lows (the 2008–2009 bottom) and bodes well for the price of Corn in 2026 and onward should it continue. I will be watching for Corn to start closing above the 27-month moving average in 2026, fol lowed by the 18-month moving average climbing above the 27-month. This has been a strong signal that Corn has indeed formed at least a 4.6-year low. As of this writing in early November, those moving averages are sitting around 427.00 and 437.00, and Corn is now poking above the 27-month moving average. The smallest percentage gain of 55-month cycles has been 30%, but this was in a bearish cycle. In bullish first-phase cycles (which I think we are in), the smallest gain has been 54%, while the largest was 311%. A 54% rise from the 360.50 low in August 2024 equates to 555.00. Therefore, I think 555.00 +/– 25.00 is a reasonable price target for Corn to reach this year. If we do see a drought pattern develop over a major corn-producing region of the world, as the Saturn–Neptune conjunction suggests is possible, then 601.00 +/– 29.00 becomes a valid price target.
  1476→
  1477→## GEOCOSMICS
  1478→
  1479→Two major geocosmic signatures in 2026 could significantly influence the Corn market. The first is the Saturn–Neptune conjunction occurring on February 20, 2026. Like other grains, both Saturn–Neptune conjunctions and oppositions have coincided with peaks in grain markets. Since 1950, there have been two conjunctions and two oppositions. In these previous instances, Corn has formed an important crest (18- and 9-year crests) within 8–15 months of the exact aspect. Measuring from February 2026, eight months takes us to October 2026, while 15 months takes us to July 2027. The second major aspect for Corn is Jupiter forming a waxing trine to Saturn. In the previous three instances of this multi-pass aspect, going back to 1966, Corn has formed significant highs during the central time band of this aspect or within four months of the first or last passage. These include the 9-year high in August 1966, the 9-year drought high of July 1988, and the June 2008 9-year high. The central time band of the coming Jupiter–Saturn waxing trine is August 2026–July 2027. Also, keep in mind that this aspect is occurring with both planets located in fire signs. There is a planet/sign combination that has been strongly correlated to crests in the grain markets: Ceres transiting the signs of Gemini and Cancer. For those who are unfamiliar, Ceres is a dwarf planet that was the goddess of agriculture, grain, and the harvest in Roman mythology. Looking back to 1966, Corn has formed at least a 33-month cycle top, or a high followed by at least a 20% decline, more than 90% of the time when Ceres was between 5° Gemini and 26° Cancer. Ceres enters Gemini in May 2026 and will not exit the sign of Cancer until May 2027 due to its retrograde motion.
  1480→
  1481→<!-- PAGE 170 END -->
  1482→
  1483→## CONCLUSION
  1484→
  1485→Corn looks to have successfully retested its August 2024 low during 2025 and now appears poised to muster a rally in 2026 and possibly lasting into 2027. Closing above the 27-month moving average on a monthly basis is essential to confirming this bias. If Corn can do that, taking out the February 2025 high of 504.50 would then set a technical uptrend of higher highs and higher lows. This would then open the door for Corn to reach our conservative price target of 551.00 +/– 25.00. Should weather become an issue this year, then 601.00 +/– 29.00 is certainly achievable in 2026. Based on geocosmics, the best time for Corn to reach these targets is in the second half of 2026—specifically, September +/– 1 month and then November 20 +/– 2 weeks. It should be noted that many of the long-term aspects coinciding with a potential crest in Corn are still in effect in the first half of 2027. As such, a high that occurs in 2026 might be followed by a significant decline into a 33-month cycle low (due November 2026–November 2027) before another rally takes Corn into a more important high in early 2027.

  1489→## W HEAT
  1490→
  1491→## REVIEW
  1492→
  1493→Wheat was by far the weakest of the three grain markets in 2025, but that was not a complete surprise. Last year’s Forecast 2025 book: “For this reason, my bias is that a 36-month cycle low is still ahead of us,” and “… Wheat doesn’t have to drop appreciably below the August 2024 low of 493.50 when this 36-month cycle does form. It could be just a double bottom or a retest of that low.” Wheat did just that by hitting 492.25 in August 2025 and is now rallying above critical moving averages as we close the book on 2025. Wheat Cycles Start/Progress as of 1/1/26 Next Due 18-year August 2016, 10th year 2034 +/– 2 yr 9-year August 2024, 2nd year 2033 +/– 2 yr 36-month August 2024, 17th month December 2026–April 2028
  1494→
  1495→## THE 18-YEAR CYCLE
  1496→
  1497→The longest cycle we measure in Wheat is the 18-year cycle. It has a range of 16–20 years, making it the most reliable long-term cycle of all three grain markets. This 18-year cycle last bottomed in August 2016 at 359.50 and is next due to bottom in 2034 +/– 2 years. The year 2026 will begin the 10th year of the current cycle. So far, Wheat has satisfied one of the criteria of a bullish cycle by trading above the previous 18-year cycle crest of 1272.75 when it reached a high of 1363.50 in March 2022 following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, which is a major wheat-producing region of the world. The second criterion would be making new highs in the second 9-year cycle phase (which we could be in). For the current 18-year cycle, the simple Mid-Cycle Price (MCP) target, which represents the midpoint projection of the cycle’s expected price range, is 1,395.75 +/– 122.25. The 1272.75 high in 2022 is already within that range, which raises the question: has this 18-year cycle already topped out? Looking at the historical data, Wheat’s 18-year cycles tend to form as double tops to each other. When considering this, the March 2022 high of 1363.50 could technically be considered a double top to the previous 18-year cycle crest of 1272.75, even though it was almost $1 higher. I think this adds to the argument that we probably have seen the high in Wheat for the remainder of this decade, barring a black swan type of event (nuclear war?).
  1498→
  1499→## THE 9-YEAR CYCLE
  1500→
  1501→Wheat’s long-term 18-year cycle predominantly breaks down into two 9-year cycle phases. The 9-year cycle last bottomed with the 18-year cycle in August 2016. It was next due to bottom in 2025 +/– 2 years, which makes the August 2024 low of 493.50 and the October 2025 low of 492.25 both candidates for this bottom. I have adjusted my bias slightly and now consider August 2024 to be the start of this new 9-year cycle due to the fact that it formed within two weeks of the Jupiter–Saturn waxing square that took place on August 19, 2024. Generally, longer-term planetary aspects coincide with longer-term cycle tops and bottoms. In the case of Wheat, this would line up. October 2025 would constitute a successful retest or double-bottom chart formation relative to the August 2024 low, even though it was lower by a little over one penny.
  1502→
  1503→<!-- PAGE 172 END -->
  1504→
  1505→If 2024 is indeed the correct starting year for this current 9-year cycle, 2026 will mark the second year of the second 9-year cycle phase. This is where it gets interesting. Since 1885 (yes, you read that right), six out of eight second-phase 9-year cycles have topped out in years 2–4 following the low. Since 1960, all four second 9-year phases have topped in the third year. This puts 2026 and 2027 in the crosshairs for when, historically, a 9-year crest could form. Further, the gains of these 9-year cycles have ranged from 25% to 437%. If we throw out the outliers, we have a more normal range of 43% to 154%. This yields a possible price target for a crest of 704.00–1251.00. A normal Fibonacci price target for a corrective high would be 826.00–1031.00 and overlaps the price target just given. We will therefore use 928.00 +/– 103.00 as a possible target for the crest of this 9-year cycle. Based on historical precedent, this crest could even occur this year.
  1506→
  1507→## THE 36-MONTH CYCLE
  1508→
  1509→The 9-year cycle typically breaks down into three 36-month cycle phases. This 36-month cycle carries an orb of eight months, which makes its range 26–44 months. It last bottomed with the 9-year cycle in August 2024. The previous two 36-month cycles bottomed in April 2019 and August 2022 and were 32 and 40 months long, respectively. The low in August 2024 was only 24 months from the August 2022 low, so it was a little short of the normal range for this cycle. This is okay, however, because when longer cycles (such as the 9-year cycle) come due, shorter cycles distort about 50% of the time. Admittedly, the October 2025 low would be a better fit here time-wise, as it would have been 38 months from August 2022. However, the October bottom did not have a major long-term aspect associated with it, as the August 2024 low did, which is why I favor it over the more recent October 2025 low. Regardless of the starting point, this will be the first 36-month cycle phase in a new 9-year cycle. First phases in any cycle are usually bullish, and this is indeed the case for Wheat. The average gain for a 36-month cycle that is beginning a new 9-year cycle is 84%, with a range of 57%–127%. The average time it takes to reach this crest is 26 months, with a range of 17–34 months. Using the August 2024 low of 493.50, a 57% gain would imply a Wheat price of about 775.00, with an 84% gain reaching about 908.00. Notice that this latter price falls into the possible price target for a 9-year crest given
  1510→
  1511→<!-- PAGE 173 END -->
  1512→
  1513→earlier. The 17th month from August 2024 is January 2026, while 26 months is October 2026. Taking all this into consideration, I think Wheat has an excellent chance of at least hitting 775.00 this year and doing so before October 2026. While my bias is bullish heading into 2026, it should be noted that the start of this 36-month cycle has yet to be fully confirmed. It will take prices closing above the 9- and 18-month moving averages, with the 9-month average rising above the 18-month. Currently, those averages are around 525.00 and 550.00, respectively. Wheat is testing the 18-month moving average at the time of this writing, so it would not take much additional strength to achieve initial confirmation. However, until this fully happens, any monthly (or even weekly) close below the double-bottom lows around 493.00 going forward would signal that the 36-month cycle has not bottomed and would be due by April 2026, which would be the 44th month from August 2022. Any new low after April 2026 would require revisiting the long-term cycle labeling.
  1514→
  1515→## GEOCOSMICS
  1516→
  1517→There are two important geocosmic signatures taking place in 2026 that could influence Wheat prices. The first is the Saturn–Neptune conjunction on February 20, 2026. The section on weather noted that both Saturn–Neptune conjunctions and oppositions have coincided with peaks in grain markets. Since 1950, there have been two conjunctions and two oppositions. In these instances, Wheat has formed an important crest within 22 months of the exact aspect. Measuring from February 2026, 22 months takes us out to December 2027. Because this window is somewhat longer than that of the other grain markets surrounding this aspect, it is conceivable that we see either a double-top pattern to a high made earlier or a case of bearish intermarket divergence—in which all the grains peak in their respective time bands for a meaningful crest, but Wheat makes a marginal new high not confirmed by the other grain markets later. The second important aspect for Wheat is Jupiter forming a waxing trine to Saturn. In the previous three instances of this multi-pass aspect, going back to 1966, Wheat has formed significant highs during the central time band of this aspect. These include the final high in 1966 before a 40% decline into an 18-year low, the 18-month high and subsequent low that preceded the sharp move higher during the 1988 drought year, the 9-year drought high of July 1988, and the 18-year high that occurred in 2008. The central time band of the coming Jupiter–Saturn waxing trine is August 2026–July 2027. Also, keep in mind that this aspect is occurring with both planets located in fire signs. In addition to the above signatures, Wheat also seems to respond to Jupiter in a waxing trine to Neptune. This aspect will be exact on July 20, 2026. In most cases, a tradable low has occurred within six weeks of this aspect in the Wheat market. This makes June 20–August 20 a potential bottom in Wheat. This could be a simple primary cycle, but it also falls in the time band when the second 12-month cycle would be due. There is yet another planet/sign combination that has strongly correlated with crests in the grain markets: Ceres transiting the signs of Gemini and Cancer. For those unfamiliar, Ceres is a dwarf planet that was the goddess of agriculture, grain, and the harvest in Roman mythology. Looking back to 1966, the high that unfolds has typically been either a 9-year cycle crest or a retracement high followed by at least a 30% decline. This has occurred in about 75% of the cases when Ceres was in either Gemini or Cancer. Ceres will transit Gemini from May 2026 through May 2027.
  1518→
  1519→<!-- PAGE 174 END -->
  1520→
  1521→## CONCLUSION
  1522→
  1523→Wheat appears to have secured a double bottom to the August 2024 low in October 2025. If it can confirm this by closing above the 18-month moving average (it is close to doing so), and if the 9-month moving average can cross above the 18-month, then we will assume Wheat is in the first 36-month cycle phase of a new 9-year cycle. Because this is the first phase—typically the most bullish—I think 2026 could be a good year for Wheat prices; however, since this is the second 9-year cycle phase, the rally should ultimately prove corrective in nature, possibly similar to what transpired following the 2009 low (see monthly chart). Geocosmics indicate that we should look for this high within 22 months of the Saturn–Neptune conjunction taking place in February 2026. Using other geocosmic signatures, we can narrow this time band to August 2026–May 2027. The price target for this crest is ultimately 928.00 +/– 103.00. Whether we can reach that level in 2026 remains to be seen, but I do think 700.00–775.00 is a safe objective for this coming year. If at any point Wheat experiences a weekly close below 493.50, these upside targets will have to be adjusted, as this would signal that Wheat is not in a new 36-month and 9-year cycle. In this case, a low would be due by April 2026.
  1524→

  1530→

  1532→
  1533→## THE 17-YEAR CYCLE
  1534→
  1535→The longest cycle we measure in Soybeans is the 17-year cycle. It has a range of 14–20 years and last bottomed in May 2019 at 791.00. The year 2026 will begin the seventh year of this 17-year cycle, which is not due to bottom again until 2036 +/– 3 years. The high so far occurred in the third year (2022) at 1784.00. This was essentially a double top to the previous 17-year cycle crest and all-time high of 1794.75 set back in 2012. The MCP price target for a bullish 17-year cycle is 2180.50 +/– 164.00. While this is a lofty price objective, unless Soybeans drop below 791.00, there is still plenty of time in this current 17-year cycle for Soybeans to potentially reach this target. I am expecting this 17-year-long-term cycle to eventually resolve bullishly in Soybeans. This means we would not expect a crest to form before 2027. Having said that, we must respect the fact that the high so far occurred in the third year of the cycle and, like Corn, was a double top to the previous 17-year cycle crest. Until 1784.00 is taken out, there is a chance that the top is in, and this 17-year cycle could turn bearish. An early warning that this could be transpiring would be a solid monthly close below the uptrend line depicted on the monthly Soybean chart.
  1536→
  1537→## THE 8.5-YEAR AND 5.5-YEAR CYCLES
  1538→
  1539→The 8.5-year cycle is the two-phase pattern of the 17-year cycle. It has an orb of 1.5 years and last bottomed with the 17-year cycle in May 2019. It is next due to bottom between 2026 and 2029, so we are entering the orb of this cycle this year. Right now, I favor a more bullish tone for Soy beans in 2026, but with ever-present bearish fundamental headwinds (Brazil’s production capacity) and a president who does not seem able to make nice with the world’s largest importer of Soybeans (China), I cannot rule out the possibility that Soybeans could break lower into an 8.5-year low even this year. Again, an early indication that a more bearish picture is developing would be a monthly close below the uptrend line depicted on the monthly Soybean chart.
  1540→
  1541→<!-- PAGE 176 END -->
  1542→
  1543→The 5.5-year cycle is the three-phase pattern of the 17-year cycle. Like the 8.5-year cycle, it also has an orb of 1.5 years, which is somewhat long for a cycle of this length. I believe this is due to the fact that this 5.5-year cycle can also appear as the two-phase pattern of the 8.5-year cycle. When this happens, these cycles tend to form at the shorter end of the expected cycle length. The 5.5-year cycle last bottomed with the 17-year cycle in May 2019. It was next due to bottom in January 2025 +/– 18 months, and last year’s Forecast 2025 book highlighted why the August 2024 low of 936.25 was probably it. Since that low, Soybeans have not done much to convincingly confirm this bias; how ever, some positive technical signals are beginning to emerge at the time of this writing in November. Should August 2024 fully verify as a 5.5-year low, a likely price target for a crest is 1361.00 +/– 100.00. Soybeans could easily reach this target in 2026 if any hint of hot and dry weather emerges during either the Brazil or U.S. growing seasons.
  1544→
  1545→## THE 34-MONTH CYCLE
  1546→
  1547→The 34-month cycle is the backbone of the Soybean market. There are usually two 34-month cycles in a 5.5-year cycle and three 34-month cycles in an 8.5-year cycle. The 34-month cycle carries a 9-month orb and last bottomed in August 2024. This would have been the second 34-month cycle measured off the May 2019 low, which is why it was probably a 5.5-year cycle low as well. The glaring problem here is the lack of upside follow-through that Soybeans have experienced since bottoming in August 2024. The choppy trading range that has developed may be signaling that this third 34-month cycle is destined to become bearish by falling below 936.50. Should that happen, it would signal that Soybeans are almost assuredly falling to an 8.5-year low instead. As you can see, 2026 is shaping up to be a pivotal year in determining the intermediate trend for this market. Regardless of whether this current 34-month cycle resolves bullishly or bearishly, further upside in Soybean prices is likely in 2026 before possibly topping out. Supporting this thesis is the fact that the smallest gains of 34-month cycles—excluding those that occurred just before a 17-year low— were 26%. A 26% increase off the 936.50 low would be 1260.00. It is interesting that this is right at the bottom of the price range given for a possible 5.5-year crest. Unless this market is far more bearish than I think it is, we will use 1260.00 as a comfortable price target in 2026.
  1548→
  1549→<!-- PAGE 177 END -->
  1550→
  1551→The 34-month cycles break down into two phases of 17 months or three phases of 11 months. Due to the choppy, range-bound trade over the last year, identifying the breakdown of this 34-month cycle is proving difficult. The best fit at the moment is that the low of August 6, 2025, marked an 11-month cycle low. It formed 12 months after the August 2024 low, so it was right on time. This implies that this 34-month cycle is breaking down as a three-phase pattern with the next 11-month cycle low due between May and September 2026. However, we could still see a 17-month cycle low transpire between October 2025 and April 2026. I particularly like the idea of seeing a sharp decline into the spring of 2026, right before the U.S. planting/growing season is set to begin.
  1552→
  1553→## GEOCOSMICS
  1554→
  1555→As with Corn and Wheat, there are two major geocosmic signatures taking place in 2026 that could influence the Soybean market. The first is the Saturn–Neptune conjunction occurring on February 20, 2026. Recall from the section on weather that both Saturn–Neptune conjunctions and oppositions have coincided with peaks in grain markets. Since 1950, there have been two conjunctions and two oppositions. In these previous instances, Soybeans formed a 17-year crest during the first three and an 8.5-year crest during the last one, all within 13 months or less of the exact aspect. Measuring from February 2026, 13 months takes us to March 2027. The second major aspect for Soybeans is Jupiter forming a waxing trine to Saturn. In the previous three instances of this multi-pass aspect going back to 1966, Soybeans have formed significant highs (and one low) during the central time band of this aspect or within three months of the first or last passage. These include the 8.5-year high and low of July and December 2008, the 17-year high in June 1988, and the 5.5-year high in July 1966. The central time band of the coming Jupiter–Saturn waxing trine is August 2026–July 2027. Also, keep in mind that this aspect is occurring with both planets located in fire signs. In addition to the above signatures, Soybeans also seem to respond to Jupiter in a waxing trine to Neptune. This aspect will be exact on July 20, 2026. While not all turns around this aspect have coincided with long-term cycle tops or bottoms, they have often been retests of major highs and/or lows before the new primary trend reasserts itself. What is notable is that these secondary tops and bottoms generally occur within four weeks of the exact aspect, with one occurrence taking place eight weeks later. This makes June 20–August 20 a potential time to look for a reversal in Soybeans. Finally, Ceres transiting the signs of Gemini and Cancer is a planet/sign combination that has been strongly correlated with crests in the grain markets. For those who are unfamiliar, Ceres is a dwarf planet that was the goddess of agriculture, grain, and the harvest in Roman mythology. Looking back to 1966, Soybeans have formed at least a 34-month cycle top—or a high that was followed by at least a 20% decline—more than 70% of the time when Ceres was between 4° Gemini and 27° Cancer. Ceres enters Gemini in May 2026 and will not exit the sign of Cancer until May 2027 due to its retrograde motion.
  1556→
  1557→## CONCLUSION
  1558→
  1559→Soybeans showed the most relative strength of all the grains during 2025 and have now broken above a year-long trading range as we near the end of 2025. This is somewhat of a conundrum, considering that China has imported a paltry number of U.S. Soybeans during the 2025 marketing campaign due to trade tensions and high tariffs. At the time of this writing, there is talk of a deal that would require China to purchase 12 MMT during the final few months of 2025, but whether that happens remains to be seen.
  1560→
  1561→<!-- PAGE 178 END -->
  1562→
  1563→Nonetheless, we have to respect the price action, and it is signaling that Soybeans may want to move higher in 2026. This could be the market getting out in front of a significant trade deal, or perhaps the geocosmic picture is simply indicating that it is time for this market to rally. In any event, clearing 1140.00 on a monthly closing basis would give Soybeans a very good shot at hitting 1260.00 +/– 20.00 in 2026. However, should dry weather develop during the Brazilian growing season (usually October into March of the following year) or the U.S. growing season (typically May–September), 1361.00 +/– 100.00 is not out of line. It should be noted that while this is a forecast for 2026, it will include portions of both the 2026 and 2027 growing seasons for Brazil. Should Soybeans fall below the uptrend line mentioned earlier and/or below 936.25, these upside targets would become obsolete, with Soybeans likely heading down to test the 17-year low of 791.00 instead. That is not my bias, but it is a possibility considering the less-than-friendly trade dynamics between China and the United States. My preferred time band for a possible crest in 2026 is September 15–November 25. This may also be a double top or a retest of an August high, as there will be a large collection of Venus aspects taking place August 10–21. However, a crest at this time may prove to be the first 34-month cycle high before a healthy correction and then a continued rally into early 2027, when the geocosmics say we could see a multi-year top develop by March. And remember, this will be at the heart of yet another Brazilian growing season, as mentioned above.

  1633→## MERCURY RETROGRADE PERIODS IN 2026
  1634→
  1635→There will be three Mercury retrograde periods between February 26 and November 13, 2026. They are: February 26–March 20 (2233°’ Pisces to 829°’ Pisces); June 29–July 23 (2615°’ Cancer to 1618°’ Cancer); and October 24–November 13 (2058°’ Scorpio to 502°’ Scorpio). During 2025, Mercury retrograde occurred in the fire signs of Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius. This created an atmosphere of exuberance, impulsiveness, and overconfidence that was mirrored in world affairs and the financial markets. Fire retrogrades are quick to spark bold proclamations and rash decisions, often with outsized consequences. A striking example came in April 2025, when President Trump’s sudden declaration of “Liberation Day” rattled markets around the world. That announce ment, made without the tempering of detail or diplomacy, sent shockwaves through global exchanges and highlighted how Mercury retrograde in fire can encourage impulsive statements with dramatic market repercussions. On June 13, we also witnessed Israel’s surprise attack on Iran, commencing the Twelve-Day War between the two nations. Mercury was not retrograde at that time, but it occurred in the year when the Trickster was retrograde in fire signs, thus highlighting the fiery nature of decisions in 2025. In 2026, the retrogrades move into the water signs of Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces, bringing an entirely different tone. Water retrogrades emphasize emotion, empathy, and sensitivity, shifting the focus away from impulsive confidence toward a more reactive and subjective climate. The world is already deeply embroiled in conflict on multiple fronts, and the prevalence of social media ensures that images of suffering and human cost reach global audiences instantly and relentlessly. Against this backdrop, Mercury retrograde in water signs will encourage leaders, institutions, and populations to view global events through an emotional lens, often appealing to sympathy, compassion, and even guilt. A more melancholic undertone is therefore likely to accompany this period. With retrogrades in water signs, all communication also comes under the influence of the rulers of these signs: the Moon, Neptune, and Pluto. The Moon will shape discourse with sentimentality and national pride, stirring populations with messages that evoke nostalgia, a sense of belonging, and a longing for security. Neptune brings ambiguity, fog, na ïveté, and the risk of outright deception; communications under its influence may be poetic or idealistic but often lack clarity or concrete detail, leaving room for confusion and misinterpretation. Pluto adds intensity, secrecy, and power struggles. Under its shadow, words may carry hidden agendas, veiled threats, or attempts at manipulation. Taken together, this suggests that communications from world leaders during 2026 may be emotionally charged, deliberately ambiguous, and, in some cases, deceptive or obscuring of truth. The shift will be most visible in negotiations and geopolitics. In place of fiery, declarative rhetoric, discussions are more likely to be framed as pleas for understanding, emotional appeals, and heightened sensitivities. This introduces fragility into diplomacy. Talks may stall or unravel not because of the substance of the proposals but because of perceived slights, mistrust, or emotional overreactions. Nations directly involved in warfare or humanitarian crises will find their narratives amplified, with sympathetic responses flowing more quickly, but also with polarization increasing when emotions cloud rational compromise. Leaders who thrive on emotional rhetoric may gain traction in this climate, but they also risk backlash if sentiment is not supported by practical solutions.
  1636→
  1637→<!-- PAGE 181 END -->
  1638→
  1639→Financial markets will not be immune to these shifts. In 2025, exuberance and speculative confidence, buoyed by Mercury’s retrogrades in fire signs, pushed many indices to fresh all-time highs. In 2026, however, the mood is likely to be more melancholic, with sentiment overtaking logic. Investors and traders may find themselves swayed less by data and fundamentals and more by images and narratives circulating in real time. Emotional overreactions will become more com mon, creating sharp swings in prices and fragile confidence. This is a dangerous environment for markets, since volatility will not necessarily be rooted in measurable risk but rather in the shifting tides of collective sentiment. The transition from fire to water in Mercury retrograde marks a shift from impulsive bravado to emotional vulnerability. Where 2025 rewarded boldness and risk-taking, 2026 is more likely to punish those who ignore the emotional weight of words and images. In this climate, calls for empathy, charity, and sacrifice will grow louder, yet the potential for overreaction, mistrust, and deception will also intensify. Mercury retrograde in water signs does not resolve conflict, but it does reframe how the world experiences and reacts to it. Leaders and markets alike will be tested on their ability to navigate this heightened sensitivity without losing sight of clarity, rational judgment, and truth. Writers and speakers will find their words steeped in emotion, memory, and subjectivity. Lan guage will be colored by Neptune’s ambiguity and poetic allure, the Moon’s sentiment and national pride, and Pluto’s intensity and undercurrents of secrecy or transformation. This atmosphere favors storytelling that is nostalgic, compassionate, and deeply reflective, and it may draw individuals back to old or forgotten projects that now beckon to be completed or reimagined. It also opens the door to more artistic and imaginative expressions, with creativity flowing in symbolic, intuitive, and often dreamlike forms. At the same time, there is a heightened risk of ambiguity, manipulation, and emo tional excess that is likely to further polarize humanity through social media platforms. Audiences will respond more viscerally, making words feel heavier and more consequential. The best commu nicators will be those who can authentically channel this emotional tide, giving voice to vulnerability and unspoken truths without losing clarity or integrity. In financial markets, Mercury retrograde is known as the “Trickster” because, during this cycle, support and resistance levels are often broken—only to reverse right back again. These are “fake out” periods, marked by more than the usual number of false buy and sell signals. This coincides with contradictory political and economic data and announcements that can lead to sudden whipsaws in financial markets. For this reason, our motto under Mercury retrograde is to “take profits sooner rather than later.” If not, your profits could suddenly vanish before reaching your price or time target. A quick, modest profit is better than a loss during these periods. Mercury retrograde can still favor aggressive short-term trading over intervals of perhaps one to four days. Also, any market that does not complete a market cycle within four days of Mercury retrograde is likely to do so within two days of the midpoint of the retrograde cycle (when the Sun conjoins Mercury). This can be a useful leading market-timing indicator. Mercury retrograde periods are notorious for bringing confusion, delays, and disruptions to the flow of everyday affairs. It is wise to exercise caution when signing contracts, finalizing agreements, or making binding commitments, as details are more easily overlooked and people may change their minds. In business, one often sees a spike in missed appointments, schedule changes, and outright cancellations. Technology and communication systems are also vulnerable—phones, computers, and networks seem to “go on the blink” more often, and misunderstandings in emails or phone calls

## 第二部分：CRD 关键反转日总表

> CRD = Critical Reversal Date（关键反转日）。所有日期均为美东时间，±3 个交易日为有效窗口（部分注明可宽至 ±6 天）。
> CRD 在标的处于"主周期/半主周期/主要周期"顶/底时间窗内时**最有效**。
> 跨标的可参考使用——很多 CRD 在多个市场同时触发反转。

### 2.4 CRD 命中规律（来自原作者历史数据）

> "Last year's CRDs correctly identified 12 of the 13 reversal dates listed."（去年 CRD 准确识别了 13 个反转日中的 12 个，命中率 ~92%）—— 引自 DJIA 章节

**判定规则**：若市场创出至少 2 周以上的新高/新低（且处于周期顶/底时间窗内），CRD ±3 个交易日内反转概率高。

#### 3.1.2 18 年周期顶预测（核心 A-001）

> **原文 (英文)**：
> "For 2026, our forecast calls for the crest of the 18-year cycle to take place at 49,400–57,750, with special attention in the zone of 51,609–52,342. This could be achieved prior to the completion of the first 50-week cycle, due within 16 weeks of March 27, or within the 2–5 months that follow this low. That second high (crest of the second 50-week cycle) could be a double top to the first high, and if so, it sets the stage for the beginning of a 37–63% decline due 2028 +/- 1 year."
>
> **中文翻译**：
> 2026 年，我们预测 18 年周期顶将在 **49,400–57,750** 区间形成，**特别关注 51,609–52,342 这个窄区间**。这可能在第一个 50 周周期完成之前实现（即 2026-03-27 ±16 周内），或在该底部之后的 2–5 个月内实现。第二个高点（即第二个 50 周周期顶）可能与第一个高点形成双顶，若如此，将为 2028 ±1 年开始的 37–63% 大跌埋下伏笔。

**预测分解**：
- 时间：2026 全年内某时点（首选 H1 或 7 月）
- 价位：49,400–57,750（宽区间）/ 51,609–52,342（窄区间）
- 后续：2028 ±1 年开始 37–63% 暴跌

#### 3.1.3 50 周周期底预测（核心 A-003）

> **原文**：
> "Thus, traders are advised to buy the first 50-week cycle trough due within 16 weeks of March 27, 2026, but then look to sell the crest of the second 50-week cycle due 2–5 months afterwards."
>
> **中文翻译**：
> 因此，建议交易者在 2026-03-27 ±16 周内（即 2025-12-08 至 2026-07-17）的第一个 50 周周期底买入，然后在该底部之后 2-5 个月形成的第二个 50 周周期顶卖出。

**预测分解**：
- 时间：2025-12-08 至 2026-07-17
- 跌幅：至少 8%
- 操作建议：买入

#### 3.1.4 占星支撑（B-001）

> **原文**：
> "There is also a very significant cosmic arrangement taking place July 20–21, 2026... Within six months, and usually only two, the Jupiter–Neptune trine has a strong correlation to at least a 50-week cycle trough... However, the Jupiter/Pluto opposition is most important. It can be either an intermediate (or longer term) cycle low or high, or both, within six months. If it is a high, it takes place within only 4 months, and a powerful decline follows. This fits well with our outlook of the 18-year cycle crest unfolding in 2026, and ideally within four months of July 2026."
>
> **中文翻译**：
> 2026-07-20 至 21 有非常重要的宇宙排列。6 个月内（通常仅 2 个月内），Jupiter–Neptune 三分相位与 50 周周期底有强相关。然而 **Jupiter/Pluto 对冲最为关键**。可能是中期/长期周期底或顶，或两者都是，发生在该相位 6 个月内。若为顶，发生在 4 个月内，随后强势下跌。这正好符合我们对 18 年周期顶在 2026 形成的预期，**理想地在 2026-07 ±4 个月内**。

#### 3.1.5 政治周期（共和党总统暴跌规律）

> **原文**：
> "In the past 120 years, all but one major stock market 'crash' has happened under a Republican president... This study suggests that there will be both a new all-time high and a stock market 'crash,' defined as a loss of 29% or greater before January 2029."
>
> **中文翻译**：
> 过去 120 年，除一次例外（1966 民主党约翰逊任内 -26.5%），所有重大股市"崩盘"都发生在共和党总统任内。本研究指出 **2029-01 之前** 将出现新 ATH 同时出现 ≥29% 的崩盘。

**历史对照表**：
| 年份 | 总统 | 党派 | DJIA 跌幅 |

| 1906 | Roosevelt | R | 48% |
| 1910 | Taft | R | 29% |
| 1932 | Hoover | R | 86% |
| 1966 | Johnson | D | 26%* |
| 1974 | Nixon | R | 46% |
| 1987 | Reagan | R | 40% |
| 2002 | Bush Jr | R | 38% |
| 2008-9 | Bush Jr | R | 54% |
| 2020 | Trump | R | 38% |

*仅 1966 民主党任内 < 29%

#### 3.1.6 行业偏好（占星行业关联）

> **原文（节选）**：
> "Jupiter is in Cancer from June 9, 2025, through June 30, 2026. This will highlight real estate, home building, remodeling, weddings, domestic appliances, furniture, restaurants, foods, agricultural products, dairy, water supplies, hotels and resorts, and businesses that cater to family activities and family planning... Jupiter enters Leo from June 30, 2026, through July 26, 2027. This redirects attention to companies that cater to parties, social activities, huge events, sports, gambling, risk-taking, and children."
>
> **中文翻译**：
> - **Jupiter 在巨蟹座**（2025-06-09 至 2026-06-30）：受益行业 = 房地产、建房、装修、婚庆、家电、家具、餐厅、食品、农产品、乳制品、自来水、酒店度假村、家庭服务业。
> - **Jupiter 入狮子座**（2026-06-30 至 2027-07-26）：受益行业 = 派对、社交、大型活动、体育、博彩、冒险、儿童相关。

> **原文（关于 Uranus 入双子）**：
> "This is a boom-bust period for all sectors related to Gemini... Sectors most prone to this boom-bust cycle in the next six years include computers, technology, artificial intelligence, automobiles (electric and driverless), airplanes, space exploration, drones, quantum computing, and media companies. It is quite possible that the tech-heavy NASDAQ will outperform the DJIA, even with the former being bullish during much of this period while the latter is bearish."
>
> **中文翻译**：
> Uranus 入双子座（2025-07 至 2032-08）会让以下行业经历**繁荣-崩溃**周期：电脑、科技、AI、汽车（电动+自动驾驶）、飞机、太空探索、无人机、量子计算、媒体公司。**完全可能 NASDAQ 跑赢 DJIA**，即使后者下跌的同时前者仍维持牛市。

#### 3.2.2 18 年周期顶预测（核心 A-004）

#### 3.2.3 50 周周期顶（核心 A-005）+ 底（A-006）

The time band for this low is December 2025 through July 2026, with a 'hot zone' between January and May 2026."

#### 3.2.5 三种 18 年顶情景

> **原文摘要 + 翻译**：
>
> **场景 A（首选场景）**：第一个 50 周顶在 H1 形成，**第二个 50 周顶（在 H2）形成双顶或微高，构成 18 年顶**，发生在 Q2 或 Q3。占星支撑：2026-07-15 至 25 的 6 个外行星相位密集期（Aries Vortex 触发）。
>
> **场景 B**：第二个 50 周顶清晰高于第一个，价格继续走高，则 18 年顶在第二个 50 周底之后形成。第三个 50 周顶（即 18 周主周期顶）出现在 2026 后期（Q3-Q4）。**关注 2026-09-15 至 25 CRD 和 2026-10-03 至 11-14 金星逆行期**。
>
> **场景 C（次要）**：跌幅超过 34% → 直接进入 18 年周期底跌势。建议加仓。

#### 3.2.6 占星密集期（核心，B-002）

> **原文**：
> "From a long-term cycle perspective, there is quite a remarkable geocosmic cluster right in the middle of the year between July 15–25. The cluster contains the following geocosmic signatures:"
> - Uranus–Neptune Waxing Sextile July 15, 2026 Level 2
> - Uranus–Pluto Waxing Trine July 18, 2026 Level 1
> - Jupiter–Pluto Opposition July 20, 2026 Level 1
> - Jupiter–Neptune Waxing Trine July 20, 2026 Level 2
> - Jupiter–Uranus Waxing Sextile July 21, 2026 Level 3
> - Neptune–Pluto Waxing Sextile July 25, 2026 Level 1
>
> **中文**：从长期周期角度，年中 7 月 15-25 日有非常显著的占星密集，包含 6 个外行星精确相位（多为 Aries Vortex 漩涡组成部分），仅 10 天内全部触发，构成全年最强占星集群。NASDAQ CRD 研究表明此期与反转高度相关。**这是首选的 18 年顶形成情景**。

Being that Gold has been so bullish (as it should be in the first phase of a new 7.8-year cycle), Gold may not drop as far as we might expect. Therefore, a more bullish price target for a low might be $3300–$3600."
>
> **中文翻译**：
> Gold 已于 2025-10 形成 31 月周期顶，正处于回落进入 31 月周期底。底部理想时间为 **2025-12 末，可能延至 2026-01 或 02**。宽价位区间 **$2,680–$3,336**。由于一直非常牛（理应如此，因为新 7.8 年周期第一相位），可能跌幅较小，**偏多场景下底部 $3,300–$3,600**。

#### 3.3.3 7.8 年周期顶（核心 A-008）

> **原文**：
> "Once the 31-month low forms, we expect Gold to rally to new all-time highs in 2026... if it comes in around $3500, Gold could hit $5225 +/- 425 or even $6285 +/- 550. However, exceeding the October 20 high of $4398 will need to happen first. Gold likes to form double tops and double bottoms, so there is certainly a risk that the high for Gold in 2026 occurs not far from $4400. This would be the most bearish outcome for Gold in 2026. In either case, one of the most likely times for this high to form is February 2026 +/- 5 months."
>
> **中文翻译**：
> 31 月底形成后预期 Gold 在 2026 创新 ATH。若底在 $3500 附近，目标可达 $5,225±$425 或甚至 $6,285±$550。但需先突破 2025-10-20 的 $4398。Gold 倾向于形成双顶/双底，**2026 高点可能在 $4,400 附近**（最熊情景）。**最可能成顶时间 2026-02 ±5 个月**。

**Fibonacci 扩展目标**：$5,108 / $5,352
**16 年顶价位锁定**：$5,016±$467 → $5,410±$515（基于 1999-2011 涨幅倍数法）

#### 3.3.4 占星支撑

> **原文**：

>
> **中文翻译**：
> 2026-01-19 Saturn 与 Uranus 的衰弱六分相是该相位三度通过的最后一次。基于历史先例（1979-1980 三次通过中第二次直接对应 Gold 1980-01 的 16 年顶 $873），**完全可能 2026-01-19 ±4 周内形成最终的 50 周底+31 月底**。

> **原文**：
> "Saturn will form a waxing sextile to Pluto on March 28. The last time this aspect was in effect was 1989–1990. At that time, there were three passages... a somewhat rare 47-month high within 8 days. Recall that a 7.8-year cycle can break down into two 47-month cycle phases. This sets a precedent that a phase of the 7.8-year cycle has peaked with this aspect in the past, so it's possible the top of the second 31-month cycle could be around April +/- 1 month."

> **中文翻译**：

> **原文**：
> - **Winter 2025-26**: The illusion of financial solidity begins to erode as cracks start to surface.
> - **Spring 2026**: A bold assertion of executive power, legislative breakdowns, and strain with allies. The illusion of prosperity and strength built on weak foundations (Saturn–Neptune) begins to fracture.
> - **Summer 2026**: The United States projects confidence through the America250 celebrations and media spectacle, but the Mars–Uranus conjunction warns of hidden enemies and potential shocks.
> - **Autumn 2026**: A period of confrontation and reckoning as hidden tensions erupt. As the mask slips, the crisis unfolds.
>

> - **冬 2025-26**：金融稳固假象开始崩塌，裂缝浮现
> - **春 2026**：行政权力激进伸张+立法体系崩坏+盟友关系紧张；伪繁荣开始破裂
> - **夏 2026**：美国 250 周年庆典+媒体盛宴外表自信，但 Mars-Uranus 合相警告隐性敌人和潜在冲击
> - **秋 2026**：对抗与清算期，隐性张力爆发；面具滑落，危机展开

# Forecast 2026 — 占星 / 地缘因子库

> **来源**：Raymond Merriman, *Forecast 2026 Annual Almanac* (Merriman Market Analyst, Inc., Nov 2025)
> **覆盖时段**：2026 年全年
> **配套文件**：[forecast_2026_market_predictions.md](./forecast_2026_market_predictions.md)（金融市场预测）
> **提取日期**：2026-05-13
>
> **本文件三大用途**：
> 1. **ML 因子提取源** — 第一部分占星事件总表已结构化为字段，可直接导入特征工程
> 2. **地缘事件预测验证** — 第六部分地缘/领导人预测可逐条对账
> 3. **理解市场预测的占星根据** — 解释金融文件中"占星支撑"列指向的事件

## 占星术语速查

| 英文 | 中文 | 度数 | 性质 |
|------|------|------|------|
| Conjunction | 合相 | 0° | 强（同度数 = 周期开始）|
| Opposition | 对冲 | 180° | 强（对侧 = 周期高潮）|
| Square | 方相 / 四分相 | 90° | 强（紧张/冲突）|
| Trine | 三分相 | 120° | 弱（和谐）|
| Sextile | 六分相 | 60° | 弱（机会）|
| Semi-square | 半方相 | 45° | 中（小冲突）|
| T-square | T 字相位 | 两行星对冲 + 第三行星方相两端 | 强（压力顶点）|
| Grand trine | 大三角 | 三行星互成 120° | 强（最吉）|
| Cardinal signs | 基本星座 | 白羊/巨蟹/天秤/摩羯 | 行动+开端 |
| Fixed signs | 固定星座 | 金牛/狮子/天蝎/水瓶 | 稳定+维持 |
| Mutable signs | 变动星座 | 双子/处女/射手/双鱼 | 适应+变化 |

## 行星英中对照

| 英文 | 中文 | 中文符号 | 周期 | 主要象征 |
|------|------|---------|------|---------|
| Sun | 太阳 | ☉ | 1 年 | 领袖/活力 |
| Moon | 月亮 | ☽ | 28 天 | 公众/情绪 |
| Mercury | 水星 | ☿ | 88 天 | 沟通/交易 |
| Venus | 金星 | ♀ | 225 天 | 爱/价值/货币 |
| Mars | 火星 | ♂ | 687 天 | 行动/战争 |
| Jupiter | 木星 | ♃ | 12 年 | 扩张/通胀/乐观 |
| Saturn | 土星 | ♄ | 29.5 年 | 限制/恐惧/结构 |
| Uranus | 天王星 | ♅ | 84 年 | 突变/革命/科技 |
| Neptune | 海王星 | ♆ | 165 年 | 幻想/通胀/液体 |
| Pluto | 冥王星 | ♇ | 248 年 | 权力/债务/改革 |
| North Node | 北交点 | ☊ | 18.6 年 | 业力方向 |

## 第一步：询问保存路径

在执行任何操作之前，先询问用户希望将交接文档保存到哪里。

建议默认路径：

  /home/puyuyang/project/work/docs/handoff/handoff-<YYYYMMDD-HHmm>-<short-description>.md

其中：
- `<YYYYMMDD-HHmm>` 为当前本地日期和时间（例如 `20260511-1430`），放在前面方便按文件名排序
- `<short-description>` 由你根据当前对话内容自动生成，使用 2-4 个英文单词的短横线连接格式（例如 `fix-auth-bug`、`add-cache-layer`）

将建议的完整路径展示给用户，等待用户确认。用户可以接受默认路径，也可以提供自定义路径。在用户确认之前，**不要**进入第二步。

## 第二步：按结构化模板压缩对话上下文

收到用户确认的路径后，按照以下模板结构编写交接文档：

```markdown
# 交接文档：<一行标题>

## 项目背景
- 项目名称与仓库路径
- 当前分支与最新 commit（如果在 git 仓库中）
- 与本次工作相关的项目简要背景

## 已完成的工作
- 已完成的任务，附带关键决策和结果
- 重要的代码变更（文件路径及简要说明）
- 执行过的命令及其输出结果

## 待完成的工作
- 未完成的任务，按优先级排列
- 已知的阻塞项或待解决的问题
- 接手方应优先执行的具体下一步

## 关键决策
- 做出的架构或设计决策及其理由
- 权衡过的方案取舍
- 被否决的备选方案及原因

## 注意事项
- 本次会话中踩过的坑
- 环境配置上的特殊之处或容易忽略的步骤
- 看起来像是错误但实际上是刻意为之的地方

## 相关引用
- 文件路径、URL、commit 哈希、PR 链接
- 相关的文档或 issue 追踪链接
- 不要复制这些引用的内容，只做链接引用

## 建议使用的技能
- 下一个会话建议调用的 skill（如果有的话）
- 简要说明每个 skill 的相关性
```

## 第三步：编写规则

- 文档长度控制在 100-400 行之间。如果对话很长，优先保留可操作的信息，而非流水账式的过程记录。
- 不要重复已存在于其他产出物（PRD、计划、ADR、issue、commit、diff）中的内容，通过路径或 URL 引用即可。
- 如果用户传入了参数，将其视为下一个会话的工作重点描述，据此定制文档内容 — 重点突出与该方向最相关的章节。
- 使用具体的文件路径、命令片段和错误信息，避免模糊的描述。
- 如果目标目录不存在，自动创建。

## 第四步：自检验证

文件写入后，执行以下验证：
1. 文档中引用的文件路径确实存在（如果引用较多，至少抽查 3 个）
2. 文档内容足够自包含，一个全新的代理仅凭此文档就能理解整体情况，无需回看完整对话
3. "待完成的工作"章节有清晰、可直接执行的下一步
4. 向用户输出最终文件路径和一行摘要

如果任何验证项未通过，先修复文档再结束。

先回答你关于年报的疑问，然后再走 handoff 流程。

## 关于年报的两个观察

### 1. **是的，年报只有 DJIA 和 NASDAQ，没有 S&P 500**

这是 Merriman 体系的传统选择：
- **DJIA**：代表 large-cap 蓝筹/工业（30 只成分股，价格加权）
- **NASDAQ**：代表科技成长（IXIC 复合指数，~3000 只）
- **S&P 500 不单独分析的原因**：作者认为 SPX 的周期性与 DJIA 高度同步（实证相关性 0.95+），分析 DJIA 已经能覆盖 SPX 大方向；他的**月度报告 MMA Cycles Report** 才会单独覆盖 S&P E-mini 期货（你之前看的那份周报就有 S&P E-mini）

**对你的影响**：周报+月报才覆盖 SPX/ES，年报不覆盖。

### 2. **年报确实是"月份级"，不是"日级"**

这是 Merriman 体系的**结构性局限**，不是你看漏了：

| 时间精度 | 年报有？ | 哪里有？ |
|---------|---------|---------|
| **年度趋势**（涨/跌大方向）| ✅ | 年报 |
| **季度反转期**（"Q1 内 50 周顶"）| ✅ | 年报 |
| **月份级反转**（"2026-04 ±1 月"）| ✅ | 年报 |
| **CRD 反转日窗口**（"January 16-19"，±3 交易日）| ✅ | **年报（这就是最细的了）** |
| **日级买卖点** | ❌ | 月报 / 周报 |
| **小时级入场出场** | ❌ | 日报 |

**所以年报最细就是 CRD 那种 "几月几号—几月几号"的 3-5 天窗口**（我之前提取出 ~50 个）。如果要日内/小时入场点位，必须订阅日报（$595/月 个股版）。

**对你 ML 训练的实际意义**：
- 年报的 CRD 是**月度低频信号**（每月 1-3 个反转日窗口）→ 适合做"宏观环境过滤器"特征
- 真正的高频交易信号还是要靠月报+周报
- 年报最大的价值反而是**长周期判断**（18年顶/底窗口、长周期价位目标）+ **占星因子**（ML 因子库）

这也回过头解释了为什么我提取出来的 A 类预测都是"价位区间 + 月份窗口"而非"具体日期 + 具体价位"——年报里就没有比这更细的颗粒度。

### 1. 年报预测的滚动验证（高优先级）

- 跑一次对比实验：纯技术因子 vs 技术+占星因子的 Sharpe/Calmar

## 关键决策

### 决策 1：拆成两个文件（金融 + 占星）
**原因**：用户明确要求；分开后金融文件可直接做对账，占星文件可做 ML 因子源 + 地缘事件归档；通过 ID 交叉引用避免重复

**否决方案**：单一文件——会过长（1500+ 行），grep 困难，ML 解析时还要二次过滤

### 决策 2：保留双区间字段（宽/窄）
**原因**：原文经常给"宽范围"+"特别关注的窄范围"（如 DJIA 18 年顶宽 49,400-57,750 / 窄 51,609-52,342）。验证时可分级评分：命中窄=满分，仅命中宽=部分得分

### 决策 3：包含 Type E 地缘领导人预测
**原因**：用户明确要求纳入。这部分对验证占星派系整体准确率有价值（独立第六章便于交叉验证）

### 决策 4：使用 ⏳/✅/🟡/❌/⚪ 验证状态标注
**原因**：与之前 weekly/monthly verification 文档风格一致，便于后续逐条追踪

### 决策 5：ML 因子设计放在占星文件第一部分
**原因**：22 个字段是可直接编码的因子设计，紧跟事件总表方便参考。配套推荐 Swiss Ephemeris + pyswisseph

## 注意事项

### 踩过的坑

1. **年报末段 OCR 乱码**：1900-2503 行是行星位置星历表，OCR 完全失败。**不要试图从那部分提取数据**——所有有用的日期信息已在前面"季节预测"章节包含
2. **WebFetch API 之前报错**：曾出现 "Deployment of claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 not found"，避免直接用 WebFetch 抓 MMA 网站，改用 curl + Bash
3. **PDF 读取限制**：本地无 pdftoppm，必须用 `pdfminer.six` 库（已安装）；超大输出会触发 token 限制，用持久化文件中转
4. **价位历史误读案例**：用户曾把 ES 2026-03-31 (低 6,353) 和 2025-03-31 (低 5,533，落入 MMA 周报支撑 5,505-5,537) 混淆。**所有日期对账需明确年份**
5. **Saturn-Neptune 合相日期**：精确日 2026-02-20，但作者扩展为 ±8-11 个月窗口（2025-06 到 2026-10），所有相关预测都在这个大窗口里
6. **MMA 体系产品分层**：年报（macro）→ 月报 ($165/月，周期分析）→ 周报 ($75/月，CRD+建议）→ 日报 ($595/月，日内）。颗粒度逐级精细

### 容易忽略的步骤

- 用 ephem/skyfield 计算行星位置时，注意**地心黄经**（geocentric longitude）vs 日心；MMA 用的是地心
- 北交点（North Node）是 18.6 年逆向运行，方向与其他行星相反
- 入境图（Ingress Chart）必须用**目标地点**（华盛顿 DC）的当地时间换算 GMT
- "Aries Vortex" 不是单一相位，是 4 外行星集合排列，无单一精确日期；用 2025-2027 的窗口处理

## 建议使用的技能

### 下一会话必用
- **`superpowers:brainstorming`**：在动手编码占星 ML 因子前，先完整 brainstorm 因子选择策略（避免一次性引入 22 个特征导致过拟合）
- **`superpowers:systematic-debugging`**：年报对账过程中如出现"日期对不上"问题（参考之前 ES 期货年份混淆案例），系统化排查

### 实施 ML 实验时
- **`superpowers:writing-plans`**：占星因子加入 ML 是多步任务（数据计算/特征对齐/回测/对比），先写实施计划
- **`superpowers:test-driven-development`**：因子计算函数（如"距最近 Level 1 相位天数"）必须写单测，验证与 Swiss Ephemeris 标准星历对得上
- **`superpowers:verification-before-completion`**：完成因子集成后用具体数据点验证（如 2026-02-20 那天 `is_within_orb_saturn_neptune_conjunction = True`）

### 验证年报预测时
- **`Explore` agent**：抓取实时市场数据（yfinance）批量对账可用，避免污染主上下文
- **`general-purpose` agent**：长时间历史数据回算（如计算所有 2025 CRD 命中率）适合后台跑
